title: Solution Architect
description:
Solution Architect

Location: Remote (98% remote with very occasional travel to London or Manchester)
Rate: £650 per day Inside IR35
Duration: Contract until 30th June 2027


YOU MUST HOLD SC CLEARENCE WITH THE HOME OFFICE & HAVE NPPV3 CLEARANCE




We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to join a major organisational transformation programme focused on aligning multiple organisations, business units, and user communities to a unified Target Operating Model (TOM).
This is an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping end-to-end solution designs that will support large-scale business transformation, service integration, platform onboarding, and operational change. Working across business, technology, service management, and transformation teams, you will be responsible for delivering practical, scalable, and sustainable solutions that align with both strategic business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.
Key ResponsibilitiesSolution Design & Architecture

  • Lead solution design activities across the transformation programme.
  • Develop end-to-end solution designs supporting the implementation of the Target Operating Model.
  • Design solutions spanning people, processes, technology, data, services and governance.
  • Ensure solutions promote standardisation, scalability, supportability and long-term sustainability.
  • Maintain clear traceability between business requirements and solution outcomes.


Organisational Transformation

  • Support the onboarding and integration of multiple organisations and user communities onto common platforms and services.
  • Assess current-state operating models, business processes and technology landscapes.
  • Identify impacts, dependencies, risks and opportunities associated with organisational transition.
  • Contribute to transition planning and implementation activities.
  • Support business readiness and adoption initiatives throughout the programme lifecycle.


Business & Technical Analysis

  • Collaborate with Business Analysts, Architects, Service Integration teams and key stakeholders to gather and refine requirements.
  • Facilitate workshops to capture business, operational and technical needs.
  • Produce and maintain functional and non-functional requirements documentation.
  • Analyse existing processes and identify opportunities for simplification and harmonisation.
  • Ensure solution designs remain aligned to transformation objectives and desired business outcomes.


Platform & Service Integration

  • Define how applications, platforms, services and operational processes integrate within the future-state environment.
  • Ensure consistency of design across business, technology and service management domains.
  • Support the integration of users and services into common governance and support frameworks.
  • Work closely with Service Integration, Infrastructure, Application and Security teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  • Design solutions with operational supportability and service management considerations in mind.


Governance & Assurance

  • Produce high-quality solution documentation, design artefacts and supporting materials.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture standards, design principles and policies.
  • Support design reviews, governance processes and assurance activities.
  • Maintain solution integrity from design through to implementation.


Stakeholder Management

  • Engage with programme leaders, operational teams, technical specialists and business stakeholders.
  • Build strong relationships across multiple transformation workstreams.
  • Present design options, recommendations and analysis to support informed decision-making.
  • Facilitate alignment between programme objectives and stakeholder expectations.


Risk & Dependency Management

  • Identify design risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies.
  • Assess the impact of solution decisions on business operations, users, platforms and services.
  • Support mitigation planning and issue resolution activities.
  • Ensure cross-workstream dependencies are understood, managed and communicated effectively.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Significant experience in Solution Architecture, Solution Design, Systems Analysis or Technical Design roles.
  • Proven track record supporting large-scale organisational transformation programmes.
  • Strong ability to translate complex business requirements into practical end-to-end solutions.
  • Experience designing solutions across people, process, technology and service management domains.
  • Excellent understanding of business process design and operating model transformation.
  • Experience working with diverse stakeholder groups within complex enterprise environments.
  • Knowledge of systems integration, platform onboarding and service adoption activities.
  • Ability to balance strategic objectives with practical delivery requirements.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and workshop facilitation experience.


Desirable Experience

  • Experience working within complex enterprise-scale transformation programmes.
  • Knowledge of service management frameworks and governance models.
  • Experience supporting multi-organisation integration or merger-related transformation initiatives.

title: Commodity Indices - Strategic Index Trader – Associate or Vice President
description:
Join our team to build your career in a culture that values innovation, creativity, and excellence. As a n Associate or Vice President Strategic Index Trader, you will help drive strategic initiatives, scale market execution, and enhance risk management processes. You’ll collaborate with sales, structuring, and technology teams in a client-focused, non-proprietary trading environment. This is your opportunity to make a significant impact, develop your expertise, and grow your career in a dynamic and supportive team.

As a Strategic Index Trader – Associate or Vice President in the Commodity Indices team, you will price vanilla and exotic structures on indices, manage daily risk for the Commodity Index book, and participate in strategic initiatives to improve business architecture. You will work closely with traders, operations, and infrastructure groups to support a “one team” approach, and help develop automated tools to enhance the risk management platform. Your role will be central to delivering innovative solutions and driving business growth.

Job responsibilities

  • Price vanilla and exotic structures on indices.
  • Manage daily risk for the Commodity Index book (linear and non-linear).
  • Collaborate with operations and infrastructure groups to support a “one team” approach.
  • Participate in strategic initiatives to improve and evolve processes and business architecture.
  • Work closely with traders to develop automated tools and enhance the risk management platform.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience in pricing and risk management of linear and non-linear payoffs.
  • Extensive understanding of technical aspects of exotics risk management.
  • Good understanding of commodities market structure.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate, explain, and challenge as appropriate.
  • Strong problem-solving, control, and project management skills.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience in managing a risk book in commodities.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with systematic strategies and index trading.

This role encompasses the performance of regulated activity. The successful candidate will therefore be subject to meeting regulatory requirements in the assessment of fitness, propriety, knowledge and competence (as assessed by the Firm) and (where appropriate) approval by the relevant regulatory authorities to carry out such activities

description:

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. About the position:

The API Developer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining backend services and application programming interfaces (APIs) that support RMF business and engineering applications. The role focuses on building secure, reliable, and maintainable backend solutions using Microsoft Azure, .NET, and Python within homegrown web applications. This position works closely with cross-functional teams including product owners, front-end developers, data engineers, and domain specialists to implement well-defined requirements and deliver scalable solutions. The role operates within established enterprise standards, tooling, and deployment pipelines, applies sound object-oriented design principles, and contributes to continuous improvement of system performance, reliability, and code quality. The role also leverages Generative AI (GenAI)–enabled engineering practices to improve development efficiency and solution quality.

Key Responsibilities :

Software & Backend API Engineering

  • Design, develop, test, and support backend services and RESTful APIs in a production environment.

  • Develop internal APIs using C#, .NET, and Python, including OpenAPI / Swagger documentation.

  • Apply sound API design principles including data validation, error handling, and versioning.

  • Write maintainable, readable, and testable code following modern software engineering best practices.

  • Implement and maintain unit tests to ensure code quality, reliability, and regression prevention.

Cloud & Data Engineering

  • Monitor, log, and troubleshoot application behavior in a cloud environment.

Generative AI (GenAI) & Modern Engineering Practices

  • Apply human-in-the-loop judgment to ensure AI-assisted outputs adhere to Chevron standards for security, reliability, maintainability, and compliance.

  • Continuously evaluate and responsibly adopt emerging GenAI capabilities within enterprise guardrails.

Enterprise Tools & Standards

  • Use commonly adopted tools including GHAZDO, DAST, GitHub Copilot (intermediate level), Visual Studio Code, and ServiceNow (SNOW).

  • Ensure solutions align with Chevron engineering standards including CDAS and cvxcontrols.

Differentiating & Desired Skills

  • Experience with Python frameworks and packages such as FastAPI, Pydantic, Pytest, Pandas, or Polars.

  • Basic knowledge of statistics as applied to engineering or analytical workflows.

  • Familiarity with common backend and enterprise application design patterns (e.g., repository, factory, strategy).

Behaviors & Continuous Improvement

  • Owns and closes backlog work items and shows initiative in identifying features aligned with RMF product objectives.

  • Collaborates effectively with cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams.

  • Demonstrates openness to feedback, continuous learning, and improvement.

title: Digital Quality Measures Lead
description:
AIR's Quality Measurement & Improvement (QM&I) portfolio is seeking a part-time Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) / Digital Quality Measures Lead to serve as a senior technical authority on our federally funded eCQM development contracts. This role sets technical direction for FHIR-based digital quality measure (dQM) specification work, serves as the primary technical point of contact with CMS and other clients for topics related to digital quality measurement, including FHIR, and is responsible for mentoring a small team of measure developers and analysts. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience translating clinical quality measures into CQL and FHIR-based specifications and is comfortable operating across the full dQM lifecycle, from measure concept through annual maintenance updates.

This position sits within AIR's Quality Measurement & Improvement portfolio, which supports CMS accountability and quality reporting programs across clinician, hospital, and post-acute/nursing home settings. You will work closely with QM&I leadership to grow the organization's technical capability in FHIR-based digital quality measurement.

Engagements are typically project-based, part-time, and may vary in duration and hours depending on project needs.

Candidates hired for the position may work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of our U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. Mission-focused and evidence-driven, AIR applies rigorous research and technical expertise to close gaps in opportunity and access, improving lives across communities and systems.

Responsibilities:

The responsibilities for the position include:

  • Guide the organization's transition from QDM-based eCQMs to FHIR-based dQMs, including alignment with US Core and QI-Core implementation guides.
  • Represent AIR in relevant HL7 workgroups to stay current on evolving FHIR-based quality measurement standards.
  • Partner with AIR's broader capability to align FHIR/interoperability practices across projects.
  • Oversee quality of work completed by and communicate guidance to subcontractors assigned to create FHIR-based specifications.
  • Lead technical team authoring FHIR-based dQMs in MADiE, including troubleshoot logic, terminology, and value set issues, reviewing MADiE output, and ensuring alignment with US Core and QI-Core implementation guides.
  • Manage the updates of dQMs as a part of the Annual Update cycle.
  • Provide day-to-day technical leadership and mentorship to measure developers and analysts; review work products for accuracy and consistency.
  • Vet and evaluate technical partners and platforms for proposal efforts.
  • Contribute to technical approach, staffing plans, and level-of-effort estimates for standards-based RFPs across a range of federal clients.
  • Serve as AIR’s FHIR standard expert on CMS eCQM contracts, representing AIR in client meetings, technical expert panels, and standards workgroups.
  • Build and maintain strategic partnerships with public agencies, nonprofits, philanthropic organizations, and academic institutions.
  • Contribute to AIR’s organizational learning by sharing insights, innovations, and lessons learned from TA practice.

Qualifications:

Education, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Master’s degree in health informatics, computer science, public health, nursing, or a related field with a minimum of 11 years of or relevant experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in health care quality measurement, with direct, hands-on experience authoring QDM-based eCQMs and FHIR-based dQMs required.
  • Working knowledge of FHIR resources and implementation guides relevant to quality measurement (US Core, QI-Core, Data Exchange for Quality Measures, or similar).
  • Familiarity with the CMS eCQM lifecycle, including annual update processes and value set management.
  • Experience on federal (ideally CMS) contracts, with an understanding of the deliverables, timelines, and stakeholder expectations of government-funded quality measurement work.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead or mentor junior technical staff while still doing hands-on technical work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical CMS and client audiences.
  • HL7 FHIR Foundation certification (or the legacy FHIR R4 Proficiency credential) HL7 FHIR certification or equivalent demonstrated standards expertise preferred but not required.
  • Prior experience at a CMS contractor supporting quality measure development or maintenance.
  • Clinical background or clinical informatics training preferred.
  • Familiarity with federal quality reporting program structures.

Skills:

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to align research with policy and practice needs.
  • Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to synthesize and present complex findings to varied audiences.
  • Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities.
  • Advanced project management skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Skilled in stakeholder engagement, negotiation, and relationship-building.

Disclosures: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis. Employment-based visa sponsorship (including H-1B sponsorship) is not available for this position. Depending on project work, qualified candidates may need to meet certain residency requirements.

title: Director, Clinical Excellence
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Clinical Excellence based in the United States.

This leadership role is designed for an experienced healthcare professional passionate about improving patient outcomes and advancing innovative medical technologies.
The position will lead a regional clinical excellence organization, driving customer success, operational excellence, and adoption of transformative healthcare solutions.
You will build strong partnerships with healthcare providers, commercial teams, and internal stakeholders to support long-term growth strategies.
The role combines clinical expertise, business leadership, and relationship management to enhance care delivery and customer satisfaction.
You will develop scalable processes, coach high-performing teams, and translate clinical insights into measurable business impact.
Working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, you will help shape the future of advanced healthcare solutions while empowering teams and customers.

Accountabilities:

The Director, Clinical Excellence will provide strategic leadership to regional clinical teams while ensuring customer success, operational alignment, and continuous improvement. This role requires strong collaboration across commercial, clinical, marketing, service, and operational teams to drive adoption and maximize the impact of innovative healthcare solutions.

  • Lead and develop a regional team of clinical excellence managers, providing coaching, mentorship, performance guidance, and career development support.
  • Partner with sales teams to support new customer opportunities, expansion initiatives, and long-term account growth strategies.
  • Participate in sales processes by contributing clinical expertise, customer insights, and solution-based recommendations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare providers, professional organizations, and key customer stakeholders.
  • Ensure consistent execution of customer business reviews, success plans, and clinical improvement initiatives.
  • Develop and implement clinical strategies that expand utilization and improve customer outcomes.
  • Support training programs to ensure teams and customers are effectively adopting healthcare technologies and solutions.
  • Drive process improvements, quality initiatives, and best practices across clinical operations.
  • Act as a key escalation point for customer issues, providing strategic solutions and ensuring successful resolution.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align priorities, track performance metrics, and support organizational objectives.
  • Manage vendor relationships and external partnerships that contribute to strategic initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable healthcare regulations, quality standards, and operational requirements.
  • Support the development of policies, procedures, and programs that promote high-quality patient care.
  • Travel extensively, up to 75%, to support customers, teams, and business initiatives.

    • Requirements:

The successful candidate will combine leadership capabilities with a passion for improving care delivery through technology and innovation.

    • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple initiatives.

title: Agil coach – operasjonalisering og overgang til produktorientering
description:
Beskrivelse av oppdraget/bistanden

Bakgrunn

Helse Vest IKT (HV) har vedtatt et rammeverk for produktorientering og skal nå teste det ut gjennom tre samtidige piloter. For å sikre god fremdrift, riktig bruk av rammeverket og reell kompetanseoppbygging internt, ønsker vi å hente inn en ekstern agile coach for en avgrenset periode.

Formål med oppdraget

Coachen skal støtte de tre pilotene praktisk og metodisk, og samtidig bygge opp intern kapasitet slik at HVI kan videreføre arbeidet på egen hånd etter endt oppdrag.

Omfang og varighet

  • 100 % stilling, ca. 6 måneder (september–februar), estimert 900 timer.

  • Mandat gis av operasjonaliseringsgruppen, som sikrer at arbeidet skjer i tråd med rammeverket og øvrige føringer, herunder hensyn til digitaliseringsstrukturen.

Ansvarsområder

  • Bistå pilotene med å definere sitt produkt, avklare roller og ansvar, og velge egnet smidig metodikk.

  • Gi løpende sparring og veiledning til produkteiere, teamledere og teammedlemmer i de tre pilotene parallelt.

  • Bidra i videreutvikling av rammeverket basert på erfaringer fra pilotene.

  • Fungere som del av et enablingteam/tilretteleggingsteam for operasjonaliseringen, ikke som en klassisk «teamcoach».

Konsulentens oppgaver

Hva forventes det at konsulenten(e) skal bistå med?
Å hjelpe de tre pilotene i gang med produktorientert arbeid: definere produktene sine, avklare roller/ansvar, ta i bruk rammeverket og velge egnet smidig metodikk. I tillegg skal konsulenten gi løpende sparring til ledere, produkteiere og team, og bidra til at operasjonaliseringen av rammeverket skjer samordnet på tvers av pilotene – ikke at hver enhet finner opp sin egen løsning.

Hvilke oppgaver skal konsulenten(e) ha ansvar for?

  • Veilede og coache de tre pilotene parallelt (produktdefinisjon, rolleavklaring, metodikk)

  • Delta i et enablingteam/tilretteleggingsteam for operasjonaliseringen

  • Bidra inn i videreutvikling av rammeverket basert på pilot-erfaringer

  • Kurse og lære opp interne ressurser (teamledere, fagnettverk m.fl.) løpende

  • Dokumentere arbeidsmåter og metodikk slik at HVI kan overta selv

  • Rapportere/samhandle med operasjonaliseringsgruppen, som gir mandatet

Hvilken (minimums) kompetanse forventes det at konsulenten har?

  • Praktisk erfaring som agile coach/smidig coach fra en tilsvarende overgang til produktorientert organisering (ikke bare klassisk teamcoaching)

  • Erfaring med å jobbe med flere team/piloter samtidig

  • Evne til å drive kompetanseoverføring, ikke bare utføre selv

  • Kapasitet og tilgjengelighet til tett oppfølging i 100 % stilling over 6 måneder

Hvilken kompetanse/erfaring vil vektlegges ved evaluering?

  • Relevant erfaring fra offentlig sektor eller komplekse virksomheter med mange interessenter (sammenlignbart med forholdet HVI–digitaliseringsstruktur–foretak)

  • Relevant erfaring med overgang fra prosjekt- til produktorganisering, ikke bare drift av etablerte produktteam

  • Dokumentert evne til å bygge varig intern kompetanse (ikke skape avhengighet til seg selv)

  • Referanser fra lignende oppdrag med pilotbasert innføring og skalering

Kompetanse/erfaring

  • Må ha min. 5-7 års erfaring

  • Må ha dokumentert erfaring med tilsvarende overganger til produktorientert/smidig organisering, gjerne fra offentlig sektor eller kompleks virksomhet med mange interessenter.

  • Må ha erfaring med å bygge smidig kompetanse i en organisasjon, ikke bare i enkeltteam.

  • Må evne til å jobbe strukturert med flere piloter samtidig, med god tilgjengelighet og kapasitet til tett oppfølging.

Krav til kompetanseoverføring:

Kompetanseoverføring skal være en integrert del av oppdraget fra dag én, ikke noe som vurderes mot slutten. Konsulenten skal:

  • Kurse og trene teamledere og andre relevante interne ressurser (f.eks. fagnettverk, prosjektledere) i smidig rammeverk og produktarbeid underveis.

  • Dokumentere metodikk og arbeidsmåter slik at de kan videreføres internt.

  • Bidra til en plan for hvem som skal ivareta coach-/tilretteleggerfunksjonen etter oppdragets slutt.

Målet er at HVI etter 6 måneder har egen kapasitet til å drive det videre arbeidet uten varig avhengighet av ekstern bistand.

Personlige egenskaper vi ser etter:

  1. Kapasitetsbygger: Evne til å bygge kapasitet uten å bli avhengighetspunktet selv

  2. Moden: Modenhet i uavklarte situasjoner

  3. Integritet: Grensebevissthet, holder seg til eget mandat

  4. Fasiliterende: Coachende og tillitsbyggende fremfor instruerende stil

  5. Tålmodighet: Forståelse for at produktorganisering er et fremmed begrep for mange

description:

This role focuses on helping organizations unlock sustainable product growth through data-driven strategy, experimentation, and customer insights.
You will work with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention.
By combining analytics, behavioral insights, and strategic thinking, you will influence product decisions and measurable business outcomes.
The position offers the opportunity to collaborate with global brands and solve complex digital product challenges.
You will operate in a remote-first environment that values autonomy, innovation, and continuous learning.
Your work will directly contribute to creating better user experiences and stronger-performing digital products.

Accountabilities

As a Product Growth Strategist, you will own growth initiatives from analysis through execution, partnering with product, design, engineering, marketing, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities and deliver measurable impact. You will translate data into actionable recommendations, lead experimentation efforts, and help teams make informed product decisions.

  • Develop and execute product growth strategies focused on improving acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and customer lifetime value.

    • Requirements:

title: Lead Instrumentation & Control Engineer
description:
Title:

Lead Instrumentation & Control Engineer

"Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR !

The KBR team of teams delivers future-forward science, technology and engineering solutions and mission-critical services that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most important objectives, while also helping achieve their sustainability goals.

KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions provides holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design and engineering capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets."

Job Description - Lead Instrumentation & Control (I&C) Engineer

Title: Lead Instrumentation & Control Engineer

Company: KBR - Inhouse Engineering

Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE - KBR Office

Key Consideration:

Preference will be given to candidates holding valid OPITO-approved T-BOSIET/BOSIET and H₂S certifications with a minimum validity of six months. The selected candidate will be required to travel ADNOC offshore on a rotational basis to conduct site surveys, support brownfield assessments, verify existing installations, and obtain project-specific engineering data necessary for design and execution.

Job Purpose

  • Lead, direct, and oversee all Instrumentation & Control (I&C) engineering activities for onshore and offshore oil & gas developments across the full project lifecycle, including Concept Studies, FEED, and Detailed Engineering.
  • Serve as the discipline technical authority, providing engineering leadership to ensure the delivery of safe, reliable, maintainable, and cost-effective I&C solutions that comply with client requirements, applicable standards, project schedules, and quality expectations. Act as the focal point for instrumentation, automation, control systems, and functional safety matters while facilitating effective multidisciplinary coordination.

Key Responsibilities

  • Function as the Lead Engineer accountable for all Instrumentation & Control engineering deliverables, technical integrity, and discipline team performance.
  • Develop and implement discipline execution strategies, engineering work plans, resource forecasts, and project deliverable schedules.
  • Lead and mentor a team of engineers and designers, ensuring consistency, quality, and compliance across all engineering activities.
  • Interface effectively with Project Management, Engineering Management, Clients, Operations teams, and Vendors to achieve successful project delivery.
  • Review, approve, and monitor engineering deliverables prepared by discipline team members, consultants, and subcontractors.
  • Support proposal preparation, technical bid evaluations, manpower estimation, cost forecasting, and discipline planning activities.
  • Lead brownfield modification projects, debottlenecking studies, facility upgrades, and control system migration initiatives for both offshore and onshore assets.
  • Conduct offshore and onshore site surveys, field verification activities, data collection, constructability assessments, and brownfield feasibility reviews.
  • Develop scopes of work for site surveys, shutdown campaigns, tie-ins, plant modifications, and control system enhancement projects.
  • Assess operational constraints and develop practical engineering solutions that minimize production impacts and optimize shutdown durations.
  • Participate in offshore campaigns, Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), commissioning, start-up, and troubleshooting activities as required.
  • Provide technical leadership in the preparation, review, and approval of all Instrumentation & Control engineering deliverables, including instrument indexes, I/O lists, datasheets, specifications, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, cable schedules, control philosophies, system architecture documents, and engineering drawings throughout all project phases.
  • Coordinate and participate in OEM control system adequacy assessments and review and approve adequacy study reports.
  • Lead Functional Safety lifecycle activities in compliance with IEC 61508 and IEC 61511 requirements.
  • Develop, review, and approve Safety Requirement Specifications (SRS).
  • Participate in SIL determination, verification, and validation studies.
  • Review Safety Instrumented Functions (SIFs) and verify performance and reliability requirements.
  • Ensure implementation and closure of recommendations arising from HAZID, HAZOP, SIL, LOPA, CHAZOP, cybersecurity, and other risk assessment studies.
  • Support independent Functional Safety Assessments (FSA), audits, and regulatory compliance reviews.
  • Ensure full compliance with ADNOC specifications, standards, and project-specific requirements.
  • Interpret and apply relevant international codes and standards, including IEC, ISA, API, IEEE, NFPA, NACE, ISO, and ATEX/IECEx requirements.
  • Perform, review, and verify design calculations for control valves, flow elements, thermowells, relief valves, and associated instrumentation systems as applicable.
  • Facilitate design reviews, technical assurance activities, and value engineering initiatives to optimize project outcomes.
  • Ensure maintainability, operability, reliability, lifecycle performance, and asset integrity considerations are embedded within the design.
  • Coordinate closely with Process, Mechanical, Piping, Electrical, Telecommunications, and other engineering disciplines to ensure seamless integration of design solutions.
  • Monitor discipline progress against approved schedules, budgets, and project milestones.
  • Identify technical and execution risks and implement effective mitigation strategies.
  • Support project planning, forecasting, progress reporting, and resource management activities.
  • Lead interdisciplinary design reviews, technical workshops, and engineering resolution meetings.
  • Provide technical support during procurement, construction, commissioning, pre-commissioning, and start-up phases.
  • Ensure timely resolution of technical issues and effective implementation of Management of Change (MOC) processes.
  • Liaise with Clients, Vendors, OEMs, and third-party stakeholders to ensure technical compliance and resolve engineering challenges.
  • Ensure adherence to QA/QC procedures, engineering standards, calibration philosophies, datasheet quality requirements, and procurement documentation standards.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging I&C technologies, digitalization initiatives, and industry best practices, promoting innovative and value-enhancing solutions where appropriate.

Experience

  • Minimum 17+ years of Instrumentation & Control engineering experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, LNG, or Energy sectors.
  • Minimum 8 to 10 years in a Lead Engineer, Senior Lead Engineer, or equivalent leadership capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering both offshore and onshore brownfield and greenfield projects.
  • Extensive working knowledge of ADNOC Group projects, engineering practices, and technical standards.
  • Proven experience across FEED, Detailed Engineering, EPC, PMC, Construction, and Commissioning environments.
  • Strong exposure to offshore production facilities, wellhead platforms, central processing facilities, and related infrastructure.
  • Experience leading control system migration, modernization, and digital transformation projects is highly desirable.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation or Electronics & Communication Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Professional certifications in Instrumentation, Automation, Functional Safety, or related areas (e.g., ISA, TUV FSE, EXIDA, IEC certifications) will be considered an advantage.

Technical Skills

  • Strong expertise in the design, specification, and implementation of Instrumentation & Control systems and Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS).
  • In-depth knowledge of hazardous area classification, equipment selection, certification requirements (IECEx/ATEX), and installation practices for hazardous zones.
  • Comprehensive understanding of international standards including API, IEC, ISA, ISO, IEEE, NFPA, NACE, BS EN, and operator-specific standards such as ADNOC requirements.
  • Extensive experience with DCS, ESD, FGS, PLC, RTU, SCADA, telecommunications interfaces, and field instrumentation systems.
  • Thorough understanding of FEED and Detailed Engineering deliverables, document management systems, MOC processes, and project controls.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard I&C engineering software and applications, including AVEVA Instrumentation, SPI, INSTRUCALC, and related tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and technical decision-making capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.

What We Offer:

  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
  • Engaging and collaborative work environment with a commitment to safety and sustainability.

title: Principle Engineer-Technical Project Management
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...

We are looking for a visionary, tech-forward Principal Engineer of Technical Project Management to bridge the gap between our business partners and GTS. This hybrid position merges strategic project leadership with deep technical oversight, specifically managing enterprise-scale knowledge systems featuring complex user permissions. You will lead the strategy and development of our future-state learning platforms, architecting initiatives that utilize GenAI and Agentic AI for intelligent content discovery and semantic search.

Your scope includes the full project lifecycle - encompassing everything from initial roadmap creation and business translation to architectural design and data-driven ROI measurement. You will ensure our technology investments drive tangible business outcomes while maintaining high standards for data governance and user-centric access management. The successful applicant will have a background in technical leadership, hands-on development experience, and significant expertise within the Google Cloud Platform ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Project Leadership: Lead the strategy and execution of technology projects focused on creating intelligent, agentic solutions for our learning and content platforms.
  • Business & Technical Liaison: Serve as the primary bridge between business units and GTS, translating business needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and project roadmaps.
  • Agentic Solution Development: Drive the design and implementation of AI-powered systems, including advanced semantic search, automated content assistants, and multi-agent systems, utilizing natural language processing (NLP), machine learning (ML), and LLMs/SLMs. You must understand GenAI and Agentic AI design paradigms collectively, having built at least a functional prototype to showcase your work. You will use this technical depth to ask the right engineering and architecture questions to drive effective project strategy and implementation, ensuring high-quality semantic ingestion and seamless interoperability across highly variable, distributed data sources.
  • Cloud Architecture & Integration: Leverage the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to design, build, and manage scalable infrastructure for data processing, model training, and application deployment.
  • Hands-On Prototyping: Utilize your coding experience (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java) and AI-assisted tools like GitHub Copilot to assist in building proofs-of-concept and front-end customizations. You should have the resourcefulness to set up your own local development environments and possess a foundational understanding of GitHub workflows—including how to write code, test automatically, plug into a cloud repository, and run the application.
  • Data-Driven Measurement: Define and implement robust reporting frameworks to measure the effectiveness and ROI of new technology solutions, using data from weblogs, analytics platforms, and user feedback.
  • User-Centric Design: Champion a user-centered design approach, ensuring that all solutions are intuitive, accessible, and effectively meet the needs of our end-users.
  • Agile Project Management: Manage projects within an Agile framework, facilitating sprint planning, tracking progress in tools like Jira and Confluence, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

What we’re looking for...

You’re great at bringing people together from different functions to work towards a common goal. Driving projects forwards gives you a lot of satisfaction, whatever the obstacles you encounter on the way in a rapidly changing environment. You enjoy facilitating and are an excellent communicator, helping everyone to perform at their best.

You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
  • Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated experience working as a liaison between business and technical teams.
  • Proficiency in a programming language such as Python or JavaScript. Must have solid foundations in development, including the ability to install/configure your own environment and practical experience with GitHub workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including services related to AI/ML, LLMs and SLMs, data analytics, and application hosting.
  • Good understanding of frontier, foundation, and open-source models surrounding GenAI and Agentic AI.
  • Proven ability to manage the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment and measurement/ROI. Expertise in creating and maintaining RACI Matrices, RAID Logs, and Project Charters.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies and tools (Jira, Confluence).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • Workday HCM, Learning, Recruiting and/or Talent Management Experience
  • Experience developing or managing enterprise search technologies.
  • Thorough understanding of transactional (e.g., Oracle) and non-transactional databases (e.g., Cassandra, MongoDB, Redis, pgvector).
  • At least one active Project Management Certification (CSM, CSPO, or PMP).
  • Familiarity with UX/UI design principles and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Knowledge of data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Looker).
  • Experience authoring user stories and conducting needs analysis.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where You'll Be Working

This is a hybrid position based in Hyderabad, India, with the expectation of three days in the office and two days working from home per week. Working hours for this role are 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST.


Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: FCM - VIP Corporate Travel Consultant (Morning Shift) - Remote, USA
description:
VIP Corporate Travel Consultant (Morning Shift)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

Our VIP Corporate Travel Consultants will need to provide a high level of consultation and accuracy during all aspects of the travel experience, including pre-booking consultation, and the reservation process from beginning to end. Candidate must have in-depth travel industry knowledge, exceptional problem-solving skills, while maintaining the highest degree of professionalism and courtesy.

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks training (paid). This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management. You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs.

The schedule for this role will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM ET, Monday – Friday.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional, personalized service to C-Suite travelers and their administrative staff, establishing strong rapport and ensuring all interactions are handled with professionalism.
  • Provide consultative support throughout the booking process, creating unique travel itineraries that meet the specific needs and expectations of high-level executives.
  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of recent experience as a VIP or Executive Travel Agent
  • 5+ years of high-end customer service experience within the travel industry
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.

  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.

  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

title: Software Developer (Python)
description:
Co będziesz robić:

  • Współtworzyć od zera nowy produkt dla klienta z obszaru ochrony infrastruktury krytycznej - realny wpływ na architekturę i kierunek rozwoju.

  • Projektować i budować serwisy backendowe w FastAPI z wykorzystaniem konteneryzacji (Docker) i dobrych praktyk inżynierii oprogramowania.

  • Tworzyć interfejsy użytkownika - pracujemy w Vue 3 + TypeScript, ale jeśli czujesz się mocniej w React/Angular/innym frameworku, to spokojnie, liczy się rozumienie web development.

  • Integrować algorytmy DSP (cyfrowe przetwarzanie sygnałów).

  • Podejmować razem z zespołem decyzje techniczne: dobór narzędzi, wzorców, podejścia do testowania i deploymentu.

  • Dbać o jakość kodu: testy jednostkowe i integracyjne, code review, czytelność, maintainability.

  • Wspierać mniej doświadczonych developerów i rozwój zespołu.

  • Współpracować z PM, zespołem developerów, testerem i klientem: zbieranie wymagań, estymacje, planowanie sprintów.

  • Tworzyć dokumentację techniczną.

Nasze wymagania:

  • Python: Bardzo dobra, poparta doświadczeniem komercyjnym znajomość języka i jego ekosystemu.

  • Doświadczenie na poziomie Senior / Mid+ z ambicjami, min. 4–5 lat komercyjnego doświadczenia w tworzeniu oprogramowania.

  • Frontend & Web: Dobra znajomość technologii webowych (HTML, JavaScript, TypeScript). Nasz stack to Vue 3, ale jeśli masz doświadczenie w React lub innych frameworkach i chcesz wejść w Vue, to dla nas w zupełności wystarczające!

  • Doświadczenie full-stack, czujesz się równie dobrze po stronie API co po stronie przeglądarki. Szukamy kogoś, kto widzi cały obraz.

  • Komunikatywny angielski (min. B2), pracujemy z klientami zagranicznymi, zdarza się daily w języku angielskim.

Mile widziane:

  • C++ , przyda się przy integracji algorytmów DSP i optymalizacji wydajności.

  • Podstawy AWS, w szczególności IoT Core (nasz produkt komunikuje się z urządzeniami w terenie).

  • Linux - umiesz pracować w terminalu, konfigurować środowisko, debugować na produkcji.

  • Cybersecurity - rozumiesz OWASP, bezpieczne kodowanie, szyfrowanie (przy infrastrukturze krytycznej to ogromny plus).

  • Doświadczenie narzędziami IaC.

Drogi Developerze!

Dlaczego warto aplikować na naszą ofertę?

Dołączasz na wczesnym etapie – masz realny wpływ na architekturę, stack i kierunek produktu. Nie odtwarzasz cudzych schematów. Pracujesz w R&D, a tu nie ma gotowych odpowiedzi do skopiowania. Jest przestrzeń na myślenie, eksperymenty i decyzje, które naprawdę mają znaczenie. Tworzysz rzeczy, które lądują w działającym produkcie, nie w szufladzie z raportami.

Jeśli szukasz miejsca, gdzie budujesz od podstaw, a nie tylko utrzymujesz – aplikuj!

Co oferujemy?

  • Realny wpływ na architekturę i kierunek rozwoju produktu od wczesnego etapu projektu

  • Zgrany zespół, w którym wiedza krąży swobodnie i eksperci chętnie się nią dzielą

  • Niekorporacyjną atmosferę i płaską strukturę organizacyjną

Benefity:

  • Prywatna opieka medyczna LuxMed

  • Karta sportowa Medicover Sport

  • Praca zdalna do 2 dni w tygodniu

  • Język angielski z native speakerem

  • Premie powiązane z wynikiem firmy

  • Wspólne śniadania piątkowe co 2 tygodnie

  • Atmosfera współpracy (i maszkety w kuchni!)

title: Legal Director, Commercial (974-SLS)
description:
Our client, a leading provider of cloud-based software solutions, is seeking a proactive and business-minded Legal Director. This is a high-impact role, leading the commercial function and serving as the key legal advisor on commercial transactions and revenue-generating activities. Reporting directly to the Chief Legal Officer, the ideal candidate will bring deep experience negotiating complex SaaS and services agreements, particularly in the public sector, and will thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This is a hands-on role leading a team and will require strong business acumen, excellent judgment, and the ability to balance legal risk with business objectives. The person in this role will work closely with cross-functional teams including Sales, Services, Finance, and Operations to support deal flow and help scale legal processes as the company grows.

Role and Responsibilities

    • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including SaaS, software licensing, professional services, and maintenance agreements.
    • Partner with Sales and Services teams to drive deals to closure efficiently while maintaining compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
      • Provide strategic legal guidance on RFPs, government procurement processes, and contract structures.

      • Support cross-functional initiatives involving legal input, including compliance, sales operations, and risk management.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
The AirHelp mobile app is a travel companion that helps users track flights in real time, stay informed about disruptions, and act instantly when something happens. From live flight tracking and smart notifications to seamless claim submission and status tracking, the app removes the complexity from air travel and passenger rights:

We're evolving the app into a proactive, intelligent travel assistant, one that doesn't just react to disruptions but anticipates them, guides users in real time, and becomes a product people rely on every time they travel.

With nearly one million downloads in under eight months and engagement ahead of projections, we've validated the need. The challenge now is turning this into a category-defining mobile experience.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the premium subscription services that enhance the AirHelp travel experience. This role owns the UX of the full subscription product, from bundles to positioning to monetization to engagement. You'll work closely with product and engineering to define problems, form hypotheses, build and test solutions, and continuously improve the product based on real user behavior and metrics.

Salary ranges:

Berlin: 85 000 - 95 000 Euro annually,

Barcelona 70 000 - 80 000 Euro annually

Gdańsk, Warszawa, Kraków - 18 000 - 25 000 PLN/ monthly CoE

B2B contract (Poland) 20 000 - 27 000 PLN net + VAT monthly

What You'll Drive

  • Own AirHelp subscription product design end-to-end, from problem definition through shipped outcomes and iteration.
  • Operate with a hypothesis-driven mindset. Frame problems clearly, align quickly, and move fast into testing and learning.
  • Prototype early using AI tools (Figma, Claude), building real flows instead of static mocks. Treat prototypes as the starting point for production.
  • Validate through real usage. Talk to users, run quick tests, and use data to continuously adjust direction.
  • Translate validated ideas into production-ready design, with strong attention to clarity, edge cases, and system alignment.
  • Balance speed and craft. Move quickly to explore, then refine in Figma to deliver polished, scalable solutions.
  • Own both day-to-day improvements and larger strategic initiatives, balancing priorities based on evolving business needs.
  • Contribute to product strategy by identifying opportunities and leading initiatives from concept to execution.
  • Raise the bar for design through systems thinking, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.

What You'll Deliver in Your First 12 Months

  • Design and implement new tiers of our subscription product.
  • Drive meaningful engagement by evolving our loyalty program.
  • Increase growth by finding the best moments to upsell the subscription.
  • Improve re-engagement by building habits and triggers that bring users back for their next trip, not just their current one.

What Sets You Apart

  • You operate at the intersection of product thinking and design leadership, bringing a clear point of view and the ability to influence direction, not just execute it.
  • You have deep experience designing B2C subscription products, with a track record of shipping pricing, packaging, and upsell flows that move retention and LTV, not just conversion.
  • You've built and shipped mobile products, and you understand what great mobile UX looks like from first interaction to long-term engagement. You know how to scale quality through strong design systems.
  • You think like a product leader. You focus on the right problems, connect user needs with business impact, and make decisions that move the product forward, not just make it look better.
  • You're comfortable in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. You take ownership and don't wait for perfect clarity, you create it.
  • You work fast and pragmatically. You use tools like AI to explore ideas, validate directions, and accelerate your workflow. You know when to go deep in Figma and when to move on.
  • You're an exceptional communicator. You align teams, influence stakeholders, and articulate product thinking in a way that drives decisions and builds trust.
  • You collaborate closely with engineers, including distributed or external teams, and understand what it takes to turn ideas into production-ready solutions.
  • You have a high bar for quality, but also strong judgment. You know when to refine and when to ship.
  • You're fluent in business English.

Benefits

  • Private life and health Insurance.
  • Flexible benefits: gym membership, personal education, childcare, public transportation, or leisure travel subsidy.
  • Annual travel allowance.
  • Work from anywhere for up to 2 weeks/year.
  • Language classes.
  • Personalized progression plan.
  • Internal training programs and knowledge-sharing events.
  • Unlimited, free use of AirHelp’s services.
  • Pre-paid virtual card.
  • Office commute subsidy.
  • Access to mindfulness and well-being platform (Mindgram).
  • Team days and Parties.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
Application Security Engineer

Parallels is seeking a highly motivated and talented Application Security Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will make security decisions that impact millions of our customers while gaining hands-on experience in exploit development and CVE discovery. The ideal candidate will combine an attacker mindset with the humility and detail-oriented attitude required to coordinate fixes and security architecting with busy engineers.

Your primary responsibility will be to coordinate with more senior members of our team to write exploits and design fixes for existing application vulnerabilities. You will also help search for new critical/high risk vulnerabilities in our codebase. In addition, you will assist in vulnerability disclosure processes and help implement repeatable secure development practices.

As issues are uncovered, you will communicate with the appropriate technical and leadership teams to ensure a focus on risk mitigation – allowing for business continuity, but without negligent risk. Application security engineers are constantly assessing applications for weaknesses and finding resolutions before they can be abused.

Parallels: anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity.Why Parallels, why now?

The top creative and technical minds could sell anywhere. So why are so many choosing Parallels? Three reasons:

This is the moment.It's an exciting time at Parallels — strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to how the world works. The EUC market is shifting fast, and we're at the front of that wave. We want you riding it with us.

We want you to be you.Too many companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Ours is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe being who you are, taking risks, and showing us what you've got.

It's your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it — not all of it. At Parallels, we're serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. Happy sellers mean happy customers. That's why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let's talk about the role

What you'll do:

  • Reproduce and triage incoming vulnerabilities from security automation/bug bounty programs, then propose granular fixes to engineers
  • Discover vulnerabilities and construct exploits for core Parallels applications such as Parallels Remote Application Server
  • Assist in the CVE disclosure process
  • Provide threat models and design reviews for teams throughout the company
  • Assist in tuning existing static analysis, dynamic analysis, and dependency management tools

Desired Qualities:

  • An attacker mindset: engineers will often want proof before fixes are implemented
  • Eagerness to learn – you are not expected to know everything coming in, but you should continuously learn new techniques on the job
  • The ability to communicate clearly, acknowledge mistakes, and disagree when necessary
  • Demonstrable passion for offensive security
  • Experience reading, writing and debugging C++ and Python code
  • Basic experience with memory exploitation techniques
  • Demonstrable experience with web exploitation techniques and tools (e.g. PortSwigger lab scoreboards)
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • BSc/MS in computer science or a related field
  • Previous CVEs in desktop applications
  • Proficiency with reverse engineering tools
  • Significant experience in memory exploitation techniques (e.g. gaining code execution from memory vulnerabilities in modern operating systems)
  • Familiarity with cloud security best practices
  • 3+ years of industry experience
  • OSCP/OSWE/OSED/RET2 certification

What are you waiting for? Apply now. We can't wait to meet you.

(FYI, we're lucky to get a lot of interest and we appreciate every application — please note we'll only reach out if you've been selected for an interview.)

Parallels is a top VDI/EUC product helping businesses since 1999. Whether it's desktop or cloud, on-prem or hybrid, Parallels delivers speed, security, and affordability for the modern work environment.

title: Senior Product Strategy Lead, Digital M&A & Product Launches
description:
The Role

ServiceNow's Digital Experience Strategy team operates at the intersection of product strategy and marketing -- where you define what gets built and why. This is pure product strategy: vision, direction, and strategic thinking that shapes digital experiences for a global enterprise AI leader.

ServiceNow launches new products constantly and acquires strategic companies regularly. This role owns two pillars: establishing how product launches reach buyers across our digital ecosystem, and building the playbook for integrating acquired companies' digital presence.

You write the strategy and requirements that guide how Product Marketing, UX, Engineering and M&A teams execute. You sit between product, marketing, and technology—translating strategic decisions into clear direction. You build organizational muscle around launch and integration discipline through frameworks and playbooks.

Key Responsibilities

M&A Digital Integration (50%)

  • The role is foundational — the playbooks, governance, and operating rhythms you build become how ServiceNow integrates every company it buys.
  • Drive M&A digital integration and marketing technology consolidation, unifying disparate properties into a single ecosystem
  • Partner with teams to assess operational readiness and execution risk: systems landscape, team capacity, process maturity, and the cost and timeline to remediate what you find
  • Develop the digital strategy for post-acquisition (login/portal integration, rebranding, tech stack decisions, customer community migration, portfolio positioning, site presence)
  • Create decision frameworks for integration trade-offs: Which assets stay separate? Which consolidate? How do we migrate customers without friction?
  • Establish integration priorities and sequencing with M&A, Product, and Legal teams
  • Partner on marketing technology decisions—consolidating lead management, CRM integration, analytics stacks
  • Create clarity in terms of sequencing, priorities, trade-offs, and the escalations that keep workstreams unblocked
  • Write requirements and direct Product Managers and teams responsible for execution

Launches (40%)

  • Define horizontal launch strategy—transform how we showcase launches across our digital ecosystem, establishing what gets featured, how it's presented, and what doesn't make the cut
  • Create reusable launch playbooks that enable consistent, high-quality execution without reinventing each cycle
  • Define decision criteria for launch prominence and content refresh sequencing
  • Guide Product Marketing on what to showcase, how to present it, and where it belongs in the buyer journey
  • Use analytics and engagement metrics to validate strategy and refine execution

Site wide Digital Strategy (10%)

  • Make strategic trade-offs based on business impact, buyer experience, and technical feasibility
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Product Management, UX, Engineering, and agency partners to align and execute
  • Influence overall ServiceNow digital strategy and advise leadership on digital implications of acquisition decisions

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, consulting, product strategy, or digital experience strategy (Consulting backgrounds are welcome with a subsequent operating role)
  • Track record of M&A integration experience with ownership of integrations -- you built the plan (for consolidation decisions, product integrations, technical trade-offs), ran the cadence, and held stakeholders accountable
  • Strong operational judgment and ability to move between strategy and execution
  • Experience with product launches and leading major digital initiatives from strategy through execution
  • Strong stakeholder management—ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across product, marketing, and engineering
  • Comfortable managing multiple concurrent integrations and launches at different stages
  • Data-driven approach to strategy validation using analytics, research, and metrics
  • Technical literacy—comfort discussing API architecture, data migration, login/auth consolidation, deprecation trade-offs

Preferred Qualifications

  • UX experience or design sensibility
  • Experience applying AI tools to work
  • Experience leading digital transformation or rebranding initiatives
  • Familiarity with marketing technology stacks and lead management systems

title: Process Chemistry Lead (Small Molecule)
description:
Process Chemistry Lead (Small Molecule)

Location: Dublin College Park, Ireland

Competitive salary and benefits

Opening date: 07/08/2026

Closing date: midnight 23/08/2026

As part of AstraZeneca's API Commercialisation Platform (APICOM), we are building a new model for delivering small molecule medicines. APICOM provides an integrated pathway from late-stage development through launch and early commercial supply, combining process development, manufacturing, analytical science, modelling and digital capabilities within a single end-to-end organisation.

Introduction to role:

We are seeking an experienced Process Chemistry Lead to join our Chemical Development laboratories in Dublin.

This is a highly visible scientific leadership role responsible for providing chemistry leadership across development, industrialisation and commercialisation activities. The Process Chemistry Lead acts as the primary scientific authority for process chemistry within cross-functional project teams and collaborates closely with analytical, process engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and quality colleagues to ensure successful technology delivery into APICOM manufacturing operations.

Unlike traditional development roles that operate through functional handovers, the Chemistry Lead remains accountable throughout the lifecycle of the process, ensuring knowledge continuity, technical rigour and efficient decision-making as projects progress from development through manufacturing and commercial supply.

The successful candidate will be expected to champion scientific excellence, innovation, process understanding and operational delivery whilst helping establish APICOM as a world-class API commercialisation capability.

The Process Chemistry Lead plays a critical role in delivering APICOM's vision of a seamless development-to-commercialisation pathway for AstraZeneca small molecule medicines. The position directly influences manufacturing readiness, launch success, supply continuity, product quality and process innovation, making a significant contribution to patient delivery, business performance and AstraZeneca's future manufacturing strategy.

Accountabilities:

  • Provide scientific leadership for small molecule API manufacturing processes from development through commercialisation.
  • Serve as the Chemistry Lead within integrated project teams, ensuring the process remains scientifically robust, scalable and commercially viable.
  • Own chemistry strategy across process optimisation, robustness, control strategy development and lifecycle management.
  • Drive deep process understanding through data-driven approaches, mechanistic understanding and risk-based development.
  • Support implementation of advanced manufacturing, process analytical technology (PAT) and digital process understanding tools.
  • Provide rapid technical leadership during manufacturing deviations, investigations and process performance assessments.
  • Support process validation activities and continued process verification programmes.
  • Drive initiatives that improve process capability, sustainability, productivity and supply robustness.
  • Work seamlessly across chemistry, analytical sciences, modelling, PAT, manufacturing, engineering, quality and regulatory functions.
  • Build strong partnerships with external suppliers, technology providers and academic collaborators where required.
  • Mentor and coach scientists within Chemistry and wider APICOM teams.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • PhD in Organic Chemistry, Process Chemistry or a related discipline, or BSc/MSc with significant industrial experience.
  • Strong understanding of synthetic organic chemistry, reaction mechanisms and process development principles.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and scaling chemical processes for small molecule pharmaceutical manufacturing.
  • Experience translating laboratory-scale understanding into manufacturing-scale operations.
  • Strong problem-solving capability with the ability to balance scientific excellence and business needs.
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Experience working within a GMP technical space

Desirable Skills/Requirements:
