  • Design, build, and implement AI agents, backend services, APIs and web UIs

  • You’ll also partner with functional leaders across the organization (i.e., GTM, finance, customer support) to design and build internal tools to streamline operations and eliminate manual workflows.

About you 👩‍🚀

  • Likely have 2-4 years of professional full-stack software development experience

  • You’re a heavy user of AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex

  • You stay up to date with the latest in AI, including new LLMs, agent frameworks, and tooling

  • You have strong product and design taste and a clear sense of what “good” looks like

  • You take ownership and are comfortable driving an entire part of a product

  • You manage your own time and priorities well

  • You’re happy moving across frontend and backend when needed

  • You communicate clearly and work well with others, especially when things are ambiguous

  • You’ve built and maintained production systems used by real users

  • You’re comfortable learning new tools and building things from scratch

  • Bonus:

    • Experience at early-stage startups or building your own products

    • Have heard of , Devouring Details, or InterfaceCraft

Why you might be excited about this opportunity 🙌

  • Ship real products that get real usage, from customer-facing features to internal tools

  • Work cross-functionally. Partner with product, design, ops, GTM, data, and CS

  • Use the latest tech. Build with the latest coding tools and infrastructure

  • Move fast. Ship quickly and get rapid feedback from real users and teammates

Why you might not be excited about us 👎

  • Priorities may shift quickly. Oftentimes, we're tackling very ambiguous problems that don't have clear-cut answers. While we make calculated bets, we have a strong culture of experimentation and we'll pivot as necessary based on what we're seeing in the data and what we're hearing from our users.

  • At times, you’ll need to build things in a day: we live and breathe a value called “Calculated Speed”, which involves iterating and shipping weekly, rather than spending months going through complex processes or lengthy builds. Our engineers are some of the best in the world, which means anything you design today may be shipped next week.

  • We don't have structured management (yet!). We don't have the management overhead to provide direction every step of the way and we're looking for someone that gets energized by being able to run with things.

  • We expect more than 9 to 5 — raw hours make an impact at our current stage. That said, we trust each team member to create a flexible work schedule that allows them to be most productive while accommodating other priorities outside of work. We also strongly encourage time off to recharge the batteries: in addition to unlimited PTO, we've implemented a minimum 20 days vacation policy 🌴

title: Power Recovery Center Technician (Shop Technician)
description:
Power Recovery Center (PRC) Technician

Join Our Team

Are you someone who enjoys working with your hands, solving mechanical problems, and takes pride in producing quality work? Carolina Industrial Products (CIP) is looking for a motivated Power Recovery Center (PRC) Technician to join our growing team.

In this role, you will refurbish and rebuild industrial forklift batteries in a fast-paced, production-based environment. These batteries support our sales department as certified used equipment. Every battery rebuilt in our Power Recovery Center is backed by a warranty, making quality workmanship and attention to detail essential.

If you are self-motivated, mechanically inclined, and enjoy seeing the results of your hard work, we would love to hear from you.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

Our most successful team members are individuals who:

  • Take initiative and complete tasks and anticipate what needs to be done
  • Share ideas and contribute to continuous improvement
  • Welcome coaching and feedback as opportunities for growth
  • Care about the quality of their work and the products they produce
  • Think critically and solve problems effectively
  • Maintain a positive attitude
  • Are dependable, punctual, and motivated to succeed
  • Are open-minded and adaptable to new ideas and processes
  • Focus on efficiency while never sacrificing quality
  • Take pride in representing themselves, their team, and CIP
  • Care about both their personal success and the success of the department

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate industrial forklift batteries to determine whether they can be refurbished or should be recycled
  • Refurbish and rebuild batteries according to established quality standards and procedures
  • Maintain a strong focus on quality, safety, and production efficiency
  • Complete assigned work within established timelines
  • Document all inspections and repairs using internal system (training provided)
  • Communicate battery status and production updates with the PRC Production Manager
  • Receive, unload, and stage batteries and materials using forklifts (forklift training provided)
  • Prepare scrap batteries for shipment, including banding, staging, and loading trucks
  • Prepare battery cells, rental batteries, and refurbished batteries for customer shipment
  • Monitor shop inventory and communicate material or parts needs
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and OSHA-compliant work environment
  • Support the continued growth and success of the Power Recovery Center

Qualifications

  • Mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to work with hand and power tools
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong organizational and communication skills
  • Forklift experience is a plus, but training will be provided
  • Industrial, automotive, electrical, manufacturing, or warehouse experience is preferred but not required

Schedule

  • Full-time – 7:30-4:30 M-F
  • 40 hours per week - Occasional overtime may be required based on business needs, production demands, or customer requirements.

Benefits & Paid Time Off

Paid Holidays, Vacation, and Sick Leave

CIP offers a competitive paid time off package that includes nine paid holidays each year, a progressive vacation program based on years of service, and five paid sick days annually.

Growth & Development

At CIP, we value employees who take initiative, are committed to continuous improvement, and take pride in producing quality work. As the Power Recovery Center evolves, team members who demonstrate strong performance, reliability, and a willingness to learn may have opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and grow within the department.

If you're looking for a hands-on career where your work makes a meaningful impact and quality craftsmanship is valued, we encourage you to apply.

title: Principal Solutions Architect, Storage, WWSO Storage SA Team
description:

title: Director, Analytics & Insights
description:
💈 WHO WE ARE

SQUIRE is the leading business management system designed for the needs of barbers, shop owners, and their communities. We believe the pursuit of artistry and autonomy should not be restricted by the complexities of running a business. With SQUIRE, we provide custom-branded tools, resources, and guidance to help barbers of all stages and experience levels attract and retain more customers, efficiently manage their shop operations, and increase their revenue.
Founded in 2015, SQUIRE is trusted by more than 30,000 barbers across 5,000+ shops in more than a thousand cities worldwide. From streamlined booking and opening new shops to real-time earning dashboards and building lasting customer relationships, SQUIRE supports shop owners in seamlessly bridging the gap between their personal craft and business goals. SQUIRE enables barbers everywhere to unlock their full potential both as artists and as entrepreneurs.
For more information, please visit or download the SQUIRE app from the App or Play Store.

🎯 ABOUT THE ROLE

    As SQUIRE continues to grow, so does the need for clean, well-defined, and trustworthy data on how the business is performing. As the Director, Analytics & Insights, you will define the standards, taxonomies, and requirements in our core source systems needed for data to flow and report information properly for the business. Based on the data captured, you will consolidate and uncover the drivers behind churn, retention, and conversion, then apply that same rigor to product telemetry and marketing analytics, and bring those insights directly to the leaders who can act on them.

    Success in this role means the company operates from one consistent and trusted set of metrics built on quality source system data, with leaders able to approach important decisions with a clear understanding of the factors behind them. Your work will directly influence business outcomes with a clear understanding of what matters most, rather than simply report on them. As SQUIRE expands its use of AI, you will bring a thoughtful perspective on where it can add the most value in analytics and ensure our data is prepared to support that work. This role, above all, is central to how SQUIRE makes informed decisions to move faster and scale with confidence.

    Reports To: SVP, Operations
    Location: Remote - US or Canada
    Type: Full-Time
    Compensation: Base ($200,000 - $230,000) + Bonus (15%)

🧰 YOUR CRAFT (Job Duties & Responsibilities)

  • Proactively analyze business performance to identify what is changing and why across churn, retention, conversion, unit economics, funnel performance, product adoption, product telemetry, and marketing analytics
  • Translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations for the leaders and teams positioned to act on them
  • Define and lead the multi-year strategy for SQUIRE’s analytical data, including how it is modeled, structured, and governed to support accurate analysis for scalable business growth and future AI capabilities
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering (which is responsible for the underlying data platform and infrastructure) to develop scalable and reliable analytical models
  • Set the strategy for AI-driven analytics, keep our data clean and AI-ready to power both the AI we build into our product and the AI we use to scale the team, from automating first-pass reporting to building on the AI data assistant already in place
  • Lead Looker as SQUIRE's primary business intelligence platform, including dashboard strategy, reporting improvements, platform cleanup, and self-service reporting
  • Establish the metric definitions, quality standards, and governance practices needed to maintain trust in the company's data as the business grows in scale and complexity
  • Lead the company's OKR process and performance readouts, including the cadence, measurement, and reporting used to create visibility and accountability
  • Lead and grow the analytics function by hiring and developing a team known for quality and reliability across analytics engineering, business intelligence, and analysis

    • The duties and responsibilities outlined above are not a comprehensive list, and additional tasks may be assigned from time to time based on business needs.

⚙️ YOUR FOUNDATION (Experience & Skills)

  • 10+ years of experience in an analytics or data function, including 4+ years of people management, with a track record of setting strategy, building analytical data models, and developing teams beyond day-to-day reporting
  • Demonstrated experience translating data into insights that influence leadership decisions and measurable business outcomes
  • Experience building analytical models, systems, and practices that create lasting organizational value beyond individual dashboards
  • Technical fluency across SQL, data modeling, statistics fundamentals, dbt or similar transformation tools, and Looker
  • Technical judgment and hands-on experience to guide how analytical data is structured and maintain consistent definitions across the business
  • Thoughtful and clear perspective on AI in analytics, including where it can add meaningful value and where human judgment remains essential
  • Genuine curiosity about the business, with the ability to move from understanding why something happened to identifying why it matters and what should happen next
  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to develop a team and translate complex analytical concepts for executive audiences

✂️ EXTRA CUT (Nice to Haves)

  • Experience within a multi-product, marketplace with direct and secondary customers, or SaaS business during a period of scaling or expansion into new verticals, particularly in Salesforce- and Snowflake-based environments.
  • Experience partnering closely with a Data Engineering function on data platforms and infrastructure without having directly led the infrastructure function.

    • Don’t let this list stop you from applying - If you are interested in the role, we’d love to hear from you!

🚀 WHY SQUIRE?

    This is the first role of its kind at SQUIRE and an opportunity to shape how the entire company understands and uses its data. You will lead the Analytics & Insights function, establish the trusted metrics that teams and leaders rely on, and define how data and AI can become lasting assets for the business. By partnering directly with company leaders on the decisions shaping SQUIRE's future, you will play a central role in how the company measures performance, identifies opportunities, moves faster, and scales with confidence.

🎁 WHAT WE OFFER

  • Base Salary ($200,000 - $230,000) + Bonus (15%)
  • New hire stock grant
  • 100% employer-paid medical/dental/vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • 401K plan with company contribution
  • Generous PTO and Parental Leave policies
Interview Accommodations
SQUIRE is committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to and someone on our team will respond to your request.
Equal Employment Opportunity
SQUIRE provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision
SQUIRE will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information.

title: Associate / Sr Associate – AR (RCM)
description:
NEOLYTIX
Associate / Sr Associate – AR (RCM)
Accounts Receivable & Denials · US Healthcare
LEVEL
Associate / Sr Associate		EXPERIENCE
1+ Yr / 3–4 Yrs		LOCATION
Gurugram (Onsite)		SHIFT
Night (US Hours)
Two openings, one team — Associate requires a minimum of 1 year in US healthcare AR calling; Senior Associate requires 3–4 years with denials depth. Apply to the level that matches your experience.
About the Role
Neolytix is a US-headquartered healthcare MSO serving 270+ provider organizations. Our AR team works US insurance receivables end-to-end — following up with payers, resolving denials, and driving collections for physician groups and specialty practices.
Associates own payer follow-up and claim-status resolution on assigned buckets. Senior Associates handle complex denials, appeals, and aged AR, and act as first-line quality support for the pod.
Key Responsibilities
Core (Associate & Sr Associate)
  • Work assigned AR buckets — call US payers on claim status, underpayments, and non-payment, and document actions clearly in the billing system.
  • Analyze EOBs/ERAs, identify denial reasons (CARC/RARC), and take corrective action — rebill, reprocess, or escalate.
  • Meet daily productivity and quality targets (claims worked, resolution rate, call quality).
  • Maintain HIPAA-compliant handling of PHI at all times.
Additional (Sr Associate)
  • Own complex denials and appeals — draft appeal letters, track appeal TAT, and follow through to overturn.
  • Work aged AR (90+/120+) with root-cause notes that feed prevention, not just recovery.
  • Support the TL on quality — spot-check documentation, coach new associates on payer-specific nuances.
Skills & Experience
Must-Have
  • Associate: minimum 1 year in US healthcare AR calling (provider side). Sr Associate: 3–4 years with hands-on denials and appeals work.
  • Working knowledge of the US revenue cycle — claim lifecycle, EOB/ERA reading, denial codes (CARC/RARC), and timely-filing rules.
  • Experience on practice-management / EHR platforms — Epic, AdvancedMD, or Athena Health preferred; similar platforms considered.
Preferred
  • Multi-specialty physician-group experience.
  • Exposure to both government (Medicare/Medicaid) and commercial payers.
Eligibility Criteria
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (any discipline) is mandatory and must be completed — candidates currently pursuing a degree, or with an incomplete/dropped graduation, are not eligible.
  • Communication: Voice-facing role — excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent and confident US payer-call handling, plus good written English for accurate documentation.
  • Work mode & shift: Onsite at Gurugram, 5 days a week, on a fixed night (US-hours) shift — reliable attendance, punctuality, and roster adherence are essential.
  • Systems: Comfortable working in billing/EHR platforms and MS Office; good computer proficiency and clear note-writing.
  • Notice period: Immediate joiners or candidates on short notice strongly preferred.
Performance Expectations
You will be measured on clear, role-specific metrics:
  • Claims worked per day (productivity target).
  • Resolution / collection rate on assigned buckets.
  • Call and documentation quality score (from QA audits).
  • Aged-AR (90+/120+) reduction and denial-overturn rate (Sr Associate).
Hiring Process
  • HR Screening
  • 2 Technical Interviews
  • Assessment Round
  • HR discussion (fitment, shift, salary).
Why Join Neolytix
US Healthcare Depth
Live US provider accounts across 270+ client organizations — real RCM, not a training bench.		Clear Growth Path
Associate → Sr Associate → QA / SME / TL → AM: progression tied to performance.
Multi-Platform Exposure
Hands-on across Epic, AdvancedMD, AthenaHealth, and more — skills that travel.		Stable, Growing MSO
A fast-growing US-headquartered organization with centres in Chicago, Gurugram, and Manila.

title: Senior Counsel, Business & Legal Affairs
description:
Job Posting Title:

Senior Counsel, Business & Legal Affairs

Req ID:

10155345

Job Description:

We are looking for a Senior Counsel to join our UK Business and Legal Affairs team here in London!

Join us in shaping the magic behind the scenes!

The Senior Counsel will support the Disney+ Originals Legal and Business Affairs team across the development, commissioning, production and exploitation of original content commissioned from and for the UK and which will be exploited globally on the D+ SVOD service and other Disney services.

This role sits within a highly collaborative Business & Legal Affairs team and combines both legal and commercial responsibilities. The successful candidate will provide pragmatic, solutions-oriented business and legal advice while actively supporting deal-making and relationship management with production partners, talent representatives, licensors and other rights owners and internal stakeholders.

Working across scripted and non-scripted content, the role will help ensure that all original productions align with Disney’s business and legal requirements, commercial objectives and brand standards, while contributing to the continued development of best practices across the UK and EMEA business.

The Senior Counsel will be expected to work autonomously, have commercial awareness and a forward-looking perspective to structure production (and co-production or licensing) and commissioning (or co-commissioning) agreements to the maximum benefit of Disney’s Businesses. The Senior Counsel will work closely with Disney’s Creative executives (Production and Development), Production Management, Finance and specialist Corporate Legal (as required) teams based in the UK office and will foster a relationship-building and supportive team culture. Further, liaising with and assisting to support Disney’s business and legal executives throughout EMEA, the role will also contribute to business and legal best practice and consistency in SVOD/television production initiatives throughout EMEA.

Please note: This role will be based in our London Hammersmith office, 4 days a week, with Friday working from home.

Values

You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values — acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day.

What You Will Do

  • Act as key advisor to Production/Development creative executives and Production Management teams in negotiations of development projects, productions and co-productions commissioned from and for the UK.

  • Demonstrates strong awareness of deal-making terms, market expectations and commercial direction.

  • Advises on current legal updates and industry terms and market conditions for the engagement of production companies, writers, directors, talent and crew. Possess detailed knowledge of Guild/Union agreements in the UK.

  • Ability to work closely with business partners, taking instructions and providing advice across a range of projects.

  • Assisting with and as applicable, leading the update and preparation of templates for production company’s engagements including talent, literary options, location, post-production and other production agreements.

  • Advising on and reviewing production welfare and where applicable, Duty of Care protocols, production clearance processes including script reviews, set visits and artwork clearance.

  • Advising on use of AI tools in production and managing Disney’s corporate requirements for the appropriate use of approved AI tools in production, including managing talent issues and Legal and Business risks.

  • Contributing to a continuous improvement culture, ensuring consistency of processes, policies and procedures in order to protect the Business from risk.

  • Building strong internal and external relationships to benefit the Business.

  • To perform other related business and administrative duties as assigned.

Commercial Terms Advice

  • Works side by side with the Business and Legal Affairs team and senior stakeholders in the Production Business to develop negotiating strategies and deal structures, optimizing potential rights structures. This involves:

  • Developing a solid understanding of the Business’s expectations and negotiating position through effective research and utilization of industry expertise.

  • Provide clear, practical advice on deal structures, rights strategies and risk management in line with Disney’s policies and standards.

  • Leading or supporting negotiation strategy to achieve optimal commercial outcomes

Development, Production & Rights Management

  • Provide end-to-end business and legal support across the lifecycle of productions, including development, greenlight, production and post-production.

  • Advise on underlying rights acquisition, including option and purchase agreements, format licences and other rights arrangements.

  • Supervise and advise on chain of title, intellectual property, and compliance with Disney policies and production standards, applicable legal and regulatory requirements and where applicable, Guild and union obligations.

  • Working closely with and collaborating with Production Management, Publicity, Marketing, Brand Solutions and Ad Sales, Content Operations & Delivery and Programme Compliance teams to ensure alignment with Disney’s internal frameworks

  • Ability to assess and advise on finance structures and tax credits, including review and approval on behalf of Disney of finance plans and third-party finance arrangements. Familiarity with completion guarantors and banking agreements.

  • Support the structuring of production, co-production and pre-buy arrangements across EMEA

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • UK/European industry experience at senior level, preferably both private practice and in-house, of scripted/non-scripted SVOD/television programme development, commissioning and production.

  • Senior industry level experience working in television and/or film development, commissioning and production

  • Complex production business and legal negotiation and project management

  • Demonstrable knowledge of relevant law and regulatory issues eg relating to copyright and tax incentives.

  • Production, Contract, Commercial and Intellectual Property Law experience.

Qualifications:

  • LLB or Degree/LPC

  • Qualified as solicitor or barrister

Plus:

  • At least 7yrs Contract, IP and/or Media Law specialization/expertise (in-house or private practice)

  • Understanding of Contract Administration Process

  • Self-starter and self-supporting

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks

  • Ability to manage and prioritize instructions from multiple sources, and work under pressure and to deadlines on multiple projects at the same time

  • Methodical and meticulous, focusses on accuracy at all times in drafting.

  • Communication of Legal matters to non-legal audience

The Perks

  • 25 days annual leave

  • Private medical insurance & dental care

  • Free Park Entry: You will have the opportunity to enter any of our parks with your family and friends for free

  • Disney Discounts: you are entitled to discounts on designated Disney products, resort F&B and ticketing

  • Excellent parental and guardian leave

  • Employee Resource Groups – WOMEN @ Disney, Disney Mosaic, Disney PRIDE, our disability & neurodiversity focused group - ENABLED, and our Mental Health & Wellbeing Group, TRUST.

The Walt Disney Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to be a diverse workforce that is representative of our audiences, and where all can thrive and belong. Disney is committed to forming a team that includes and respects a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Chatbot Developer (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord) - Freelance
description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Bot Developers (WhatsApp Business API, Telegram Bot API, Discord API) to join the Tendem project () and build conversational bots and messaging-platform integrations for real-world applications. In this role, you'll use your bot engineering expertise, conversational design skills, and quality-focused approach to build reliable, useful bots and messaging integrations that deliver a great user experience. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience building messaging bots, working with platform APIs and webhooks, and implementing conversational logic.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Bot Developer, you'll design, build, and refine messaging bots for one or more messaging platforms, including WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and similar platforms — for use cases such as customer service, appointment booking, order taking, content delivery, moderation, and automated notifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bots for one or more messaging platforms, such as WhatsApp (Business API / Cloud API), Telegram (Bot API), Discord, Slack and similar messaging platforms.
  • Design and implement conversational flows, dialogue state, and fallback handling.
  • Integrate bots with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for natural language responses where appropriate.
  • Connect bots to backend services, databases, CRMs, and third-party APIs (booking systems, payment, content sources).
  • Handle webhooks, rate limits, and platform-specific message formats (interactive messages, buttons, media, templates).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor bot implementations to improve correctness, reliability, maintainability, and graceful error handling.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and recovery so bots stay healthy in production.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience backend, integration, automation, or bot development experience (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in bot development, messaging platform integrations, and building reliable conversational workflows. We are looking for specialists who can design and maintain production-ready bots, work confidently with APIs, webhooks, and backend services, and build stable, user-friendly bot experiences. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience building bots for at least one major messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or similar) is required
  • Strong command of Python or Node.js for backend bot logic.
  • Solid experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and async request handling.
  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases for storing conversation state and user data.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt design for conversational use is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of platform-specific limits, message templates, and approval flows (e.g., WhatsApp template messages).
  • Experience with hosting and deployment (Docker, serverless, VPS, or PaaS)

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to bot reliability — no silent failures, no broken flows.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to design and ship complete bots independently.
  • Portfolio or examples of bots you've built (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $35 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

title: FW Control Management - Controls Room Quant Analytics  - Bangalore
description:
Control Management
Control Management maintains a strong and consistent control environment across the firm. With Control Managers appointed for each Line of Business, Function and Region, there is a comprehensive coverage and joint accountability model with the business executive that promotes early operational risk identification and assessment, effective design and evaluation of controls and sustainable solutions to mitigate operational risk.

Controls Room
The Controls Room Team within Control Management works collaboratively with other control disciplines and oversees existing control functions as well as the development of new control functions and protocols. The team’s objective is to empower the three lines of defense with risk-based information to manage their control environment. We achieve this by collecting, analyzing and monitoring firmwide risk-based intelligence into all lines of business and corporate functions.
The Controls Room gathers information from key business and technology partners in order to:

  • Facilitate better decision making and actionable insights across the Firm.
  • Create cost-effective and automated reporting; and
  • Provide views into risk and issues.

The Analytics team is an integral part of the Controls Management group and is dedicated to provide data insights and strong analytical solutions of Operational Risk data to the Control Management organization. Our mission is to furnish insightful management information that empowers informed decision-making, strengthens control oversight, and enhances operational efficiency.

Job Summary

  • Drive analytics initiatives end-to-end by framing the business problem, forming testable hypotheses, defining success criteria and KPIs, and establishing measurement and ongoing monitoring plans.
  • Develop and productionize advanced analytics solutions (e.g., forecasting, prediction, segmentation, anomaly detection, optimization) with strong validation, documented assumptions, and reproducible results.
  • Translate insights into business outcomes by communicating findings in plain language, quantifying impact, recommending actions, and supporting execution through implementation.
  • Ensure data readiness for each use case by identifying required sources, partnering with data owners and stakeholders, improving data quality (completeness, accuracy, timeliness), and maintaining clear lineage and traceability.
  • Design and integrate analytics tooling and pipelines to retrieve and transform data, validate inputs/outputs, automate quality checks, and enable scalable operational decisioning.
  • Apply LLMs to improve performance by shaping behavior and reasoning, and by evaluating outputs using defined rubrics, test suites, and measurable quality metrics.
  • Create reusable analytics assets (templates, feature stores/sets, evaluation frameworks, pipelines, and playbooks) to accelerate delivery and improve consistency across use cases.
  • Produce clear, audience-appropriate documentation covering solution design, assumptions, data definitions, and runbooks for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Embed governance and controls by building audit-friendly artifacts, enforcing traceability, and implementing appropriate safeguards throughout analytics workflows.
  • Continuously evolve methods and standards by staying current on emerging tools and techniques and strengthening experimentation, validation, and evaluation practices in line with industry best practices.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

title: Hydroblast/Field Technician
description:
Hiring Event: Tuesday, August 25th from 8:30AM-4:30PM

Location: Marriott St. Lewis Airport- 10700 Pear Tree Ln. St. Louis, MO 63134

HPC Industrial, powered by Clean Harbors, is looking for a Hydro blaster/ Field Technician to join their safety conscious team! This Technician will be responsible for the safe & proper execution of HPC-Industrial jobs across all services lines. Transitioning Military, this is a great opportunity to leverage your skills and training as you return to civilian life.

Why work for HPC-Industrial?

  • Health and Safety is our #1 priority and we live it 3-6-5!

  • Competitive wages

  • Comprehensive health benefits coverage after 30 days of full-time employment

  • Group 401K with company matching component

  • Own part of Clean Harbors with our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (U.S. Only)

  • Generous paid time off, company paid training and tuition reimbursement

  • Positive and safe work environments

  • Opportunities for growth and development for all the stages of your career

  • Act as safety representative responsible for safety policies & procedures of both the company & the customer, including hands-on information regarding operations, safety, equipment, emergency response & administrative functions.

  • Hands-on operation, when required, of manual and automated hydro-blasting equipment.

  • Operation of special equipment, such as ultra-high-pressure pumps.

  • Operate equipment by energizing the pumping equipment and/or any specialized hydro-blasting and/or chemical cleaning equipment, vacuum trucks & cutting equipment being used on the job.

  • May be required to examine surface cleaned to ensure conformance to company & customer specifications.

  • Perform routine maintenance on company equipment being used on the job.

  • In the case of personnel in a supervisor capacity: Interface with customer representatives regarding job setup and scope, ensure performance & customer requirements are met or exceeded and company policies & procedures are implemented at the job site. Report to the branch manager or the designee and implement procedures to obtain results specified by the branch manager.

Physical demands:

  • See, read, distinguish, & understand signs in the work area.

  • Hear & distinguish emergency signals while on duty.

  • Execute a 180-degree rotary motion of the cervical spine to allow complete movement of the head & neck.

  • Must be able to extend arms above head.

  • Frequently bend at waist stoop, squat, kneel, reach & crawl.

  • Tolerate being wet from head to toe for an unlimited amount of time.

  • Climb ladders & work from scaffolding & stationary platforms up to heights of 200 ft.

  • Tolerate & function in confined spaces of a minimum of 5 ft inside diameter.

  • Hold the back thrust of 50lbs on a straight 66” pipe for a minimum of 1 hour.

  • Must be capable of working up to 16 hours per shift.

  • Must be physically capable of using both negative pressure and air supplied respirators.

  • Must be able to wear protective clothing and/or equipment. This includes, but is not limited to, Nomex coveralls, a back belt, slickers, rubber boots, a fresh air breathing mask, an escape pack, and a hard hat.

  • Work under extreme climate conditions (excessive high heat index of 95 degree Fahrenheit, 98% humidity; and sub-zero weather conditions) relative to geographical location.

  • Exposure to dust (chemical & environmental), fumes, (chemical & fluids). Exhaust & highly pressurized fluids. (A respirator will be provided when required.)

  • Noise levels exceed 85 dBA (hearing protection is provided and required.

  • Lift & maintain a minimum of 40lbs.

What does it take to work for HPC-Industrial?

  • Specific vocational preparation including classroom safety training, on-the-job training & essential experience gained on other jobs.

  • Language proficiency: understands English at a level to comprehend safety training & respond to instructions in emergency situations.

  • Valid driver’s license and other requirements of company’s driving policy required when driving company vehicle or using personal vehicle on company business.

  • Must be knowledgeable in the operation of emergency equipment, such as fire extinguishers.

  • Provide Federal Transportation Workers Identification Credential (TWIC).

About HPC-Industrial:

HPC-Industrial, powered by Clean Harbors, is the premier industrial cleaning and environmental services company in North America supporting the upstream, downstream, and utility sectors. HPC-Industrial offers an exceptional three-pronged safety system, innovative career development platform, committed customer service, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology and automation. We are committed to safety, people, growth, service, and performance. We provide the safest, most efficient operational experience for our customers and the most comprehensive training and career development for our employees.

40-years of sustainability in action. At Clean Harbors, our mission is to create a safer, cleaner environment through the treatment, recycling, and disposal of hazardous materials. Clean Harbors is the leading provider of environmental, energy and industrial services throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico and Puerto Rico. Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. We are solving tough problems through innovation and proven methodology – come be part of the solution with us.

Join our safety focused team today! To learn more about our company, and to apply online for this exciting opportunity, visit us at https://careers.cleanharbors.com/.

Clean Harbors is an equal opportunity employer.

Clean Harbors is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact ect@cleanharbors.com or 1-844-922-5547.

Clean Harbors is a Military & Veteran friendly company.

title: Associate Director, Patient Safety Scientist
description:
Would you like to use your drug safety or pharmacovigilance experience to make a difference to the lives of millions of patients across the world? If you would, please read on!

At AstraZeneca, we work together to deliver innovative medicines to patients across global boundaries. We make an impact and find solutions to challenges. We do this with integrity, even in the most difficult situations, because we are committed to doing the right thing.

This is an opportunity to further develop your pharmacovigilance (PV) experience in safety programmes, spanning the entire life cycle of drug development and peri-/post-submission. Our Scientists and Physicians play a strategic role in developing our medicines and the safety science of the programme. AstraZeneca’s oncology pipeline, which includes novel combinations and modalities, provides an intellectual challenge to the safety teams, requiring a broad portfolio and scientific management approach to projects. Our teams’ experience develops as our portfolio does.

We are looking for an experienced Associate Director, Patient Safety (PS) Scientist to join our Patient Safety department, working in the Oncology Therapeutic Area. In this exciting and challenging role, you will work collaboratively with the Global Safety Physician (GSP) and other PV Scientists and physicians, including coaching junior colleagues. You will play a leading role in delivering the safety strategy and requirements for your assigned drug project(s). Your ability to work collaboratively will facilitate cross-functional interactions with colleagues from across AstraZeneca and externally, including counterparts within Clinical Project Teams, Global Regulatory Affairs, and Global Commercial teams.

As an Associate Director, PS Scientist, you will provide leadership in aggregating, reviewing, analysing and interpreting safety-related data to generate information to support safety decision-making by prescribers, patients and payers, with the ultimate goal of protecting patients. You will apply your strong PV, oncology and scientific experience, knowledge and skills to lead in all aspects of safety documentation, including authoring and / or providing strategic safety input to regulatory documents, e.g., regulatory reports, health authority responses and the safety content of marketing authorisation applications.

Patient Safety sits within the Chief Medical Office, where we have a crucial role to play. This is an exciting period for us, as well as for those poised to join us. Our strategy and ability to transform our medicines portfolio means we have a drug-development pipeline that presents incredible opportunities to push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines. Faced with complex disease challenges, we focus on exceptional performance to drive the best and most transformative drug development programmes ever.

Essential Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s in sciences/pharmacy/nursing degree or related field with relevant experience or an advance degree with relevant experience

  • Patient Safety and/or Clinical/Drug Development experience working in or leading safety &/or scientific activities in at least 3 of the following areas:

  • Clinical drug development (Early and/or Late Phase: develop programme level safety strategy, including proactive risk identification & mitigation planning)

  • Post-Marketing Surveillance (including signal detection & evaluation)

  • MAA/BLA submissions (setting strategy; preparation and authoring of the safety related aspects of the Common Technical Document)

  • Periodic Safety Reports (establish and lead strategy, preparation and authoring)

  • Risk Management Plans (establish and lead strategy, preparation and authoring)

  • Governance board interactions and communication across a range of activities

  • Good knowledge of PV regulations

  • Demonstrated ability to handle more than one project simultaneously, prioritizing well and recognizing key issues

  • Ability to work effectively in an advanced matrix structure

Preferred Requirements

  • MSc/PhD/PharmD in scientific discipline

  • Advanced understanding of epidemiology

title: Junior Consultant Programma Management
description:
Als Junior Consultant binnen het Major Programs-team houd je je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het ondersteunen bij de analyse, structurering en prioritering van projecten en programma’s binnen grootschalige verandertrajecten (portfolio management);
  • Het bijdragen aan het opstellen van projectplannen, roadmaps en management deliverables die richting geven aan succesvolle transformaties;
  • Het voorbereiden en samen met ervaren collega’s faciliteren van workshops en stakeholder sessies;
  • Het ondersteunen van het Program Management Office (PMO) bij het monitoren van voortgang, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en waardecreatie binnen complexe programma’s;
  • Het samenwerken in multidisciplinaire teams van Deloitte en externe partners, waarbij je direct leert van ervaren professionals uit verschillende expertises;
  • Het ontwikkelen van sterke consultancy-, stakeholdermanagement- en probleemoplossende vaardigheden in een dynamische en internationale omgeving.

Bij Deloitte krijg je vanaf het begin veel verantwoordelijkheid én de juiste begeleiding om snel te groeien. Je werkt intensief samen met ervaren collega’s en senior consultants, waardoor je in korte tijd een steile leercurve doormaakt. Daarnaast krijg je vanaf dag één een buddy en persoonlijke coach toegewezen die je ondersteunt in jouw professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Via een uitgebreid aanbod aan learning & development-mogelijkheden, waaronder trainingen, certificeringen, kennisdelingssessies en learning on the job, blijf je jezelf continu ontwikkelen.

Naast persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling, vinden wij cultuur en team-gevoel minstens zo belangrijk. Binnen ons team draait het niet alleen om uitdagend werk, maar ook om samenwerken, verbinding en plezier. We investeren actief in een open, inclusieve en energieke teamcultuur met onder andere team-offsites, borrels, interne events en onze jaarlijkse skireis. Zo bouw je niet alleen aan impactvolle projecten, maar ook aan een sterk netwerk en hechte collega-relaties.

Wil je meer weten over Deloitte, het Major Programs-team of de projecten waaraan we werken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je tijdens een oriënterende koffie-afspraak met één van onze (junior) consultants. Zo krijg je een goed beeld van het team, de werkzaamheden en de mogelijkheden binnen Deloitte.

Stuur gerust een e-mail naar onze recruiter Niels; hij brengt je graag in contact met iemand uit het team.

Beoogde startdatum voor de rol is vanaf 1 september 2026.

Je kunt je binnen ons team in verschillende richtingen ontwikkelen en zelf jouw carrière pad vorm te geven. Of je nu energie krijgt van strategisch adviseren op bestuursniveau, het vertalen van strategie naar concrete programmalevering, het succesvol realiseren van complexe transformaties of juist het verbeteren van programma-efficiëntie met behulp van automatisering en AI, jij bepaalt waar je de meeste impact wilt maken.

Voor deze functie is het vereist dat je vloeiend Nederlands en Engels spreekt en schrijft.

De wereld verandert snel. Organisaties staan voor complexe uitdagingen en moeten continu transformeren om relevant, wendbaar en toekomstbestendig te blijven. Binnen Deloitte helpen we toonaangevende organisaties om grootschalige transformaties succesvol sneller, slimmer en met maximale waardecreatie te realiseren.

Als Junior Consultant binnen ons Major Programs-team werk je mee aan impactvolle veranderprogramma’s bij uiteenlopende organisaties, van publieke instellingen tot internationale consumentenbedrijven en financiële dienstverleners. Je speelt een actieve rol in het ontwerpen, aansturen en realiseren van complexe programma’s waarin strategie, technologie en executiekracht samenkomen.

Je ondersteunt klanten bijvoorbeeld bij het versterken van risicomanagement, het implementeren van strategische (IT) veranderingen of het verbeteren van programmasturing binnen grote transformaties. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met verschillende stakeholders, help je structuur en overzicht aan te brengen in complexe omgevingen en zorg je ervoor dat acties, afhankelijkheden en deliverables effectief worden gemanaged.

Vanaf dag één draai je mee in uitdagende trajecten met zichtbare impact. Je werkt intensief samen met collega’s uit verschillende expertises binnen Deloitte, waardoor je snel leert schakelen tussen strategie, operatie, technologie en stakeholdermanagement. Zo draag je bij aan geïntegreerde en toekomstbestendige oplossingen voor onze klanten én ontwikkel je jezelf razendsnel als consultant.

Binnen het Major Programs-team kom je terecht in een ambitieus, energiek en hecht team waarin samenwerking, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en plezier hand in hand gaan. Hier krijg je de kans om jezelf uit te dagen, veel verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en direct impact te maken op de grootste transformaties van vandaag.

Daarnaast breng je als Junior Consultant het volgende mee:

  • Een afgeronde universitaire masteropleiding, aangevuld met extra curriculaire activiteiten waarin je leiderschapsvaardigheden hebt ontwikkeld, zoals commissiewerk, een bestuursjaar, stages, bijbanen of andere nevenactiviteiten;
  • Sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en het vermogen om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor werkzaamheden en deze succesvol af te ronden;
  • Sterk analytisch vermogen en in staat om onderbouwde beslissingen te nemen op basis van data, feiten en logisch inzicht;
  • Goede planning- en time managementvaardigheden, met het vermogen om effectief te werken in een dynamische omgeving en meerdere prioriteiten te managen;
  • Ervaring met project- en programmamanagementmethodologieën zoals PRINCE2, MSP, Scrum/Agile of SAFe, of de ambitie om jezelf hierin verder te ontwikkelen;
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, met het vermogen om professioneel te schakelen tussen verschillende stakeholders en organisatieniveaus.

You will define strategic roadmaps, deploy advanced automation capabilities, and improve service quality, productivity, and customer outcomes.
Working across engineering, delivery, operations, and product teams, you will shape how enterprise technology services are delivered globally.
The role offers the opportunity to influence large-scale digital transformation initiatives and build innovative AI-powered capabilities.
You will combine technical expertise, operational leadership, and business vision to create measurable improvements in efficiency and service excellence.

Accountabilities:

The Sr. Director, AI Powered Service Delivery & Automation will lead the development and execution of AI-driven managed services strategies while building scalable capabilities that improve operational performance and customer value.

  • Define and execute the roadmap for AI-powered service delivery transformation across enterprise applications and cloud platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to automate service processes including diagnostics, triage, resolution workflows, documentation, knowledge creation, and customer communications.
  • Establish governance frameworks, business cases, and measurable objectives for AI adoption, automation rates, service quality, productivity, and cost optimization.
  • Build and lead an AI and automation Center of Excellence focused on intelligent service operations, innovation, and next-generation delivery models.
  • Design and deploy AI assistants, copilots, agentic workflows, enterprise knowledge systems, and automation solutions that enhance support effectiveness.
  • Drive AIOps, observability, predictive analytics, and self-healing operational capabilities to prevent and resolve service disruptions.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to integrate automation, AI capabilities, and operational improvements into daily service delivery.
  • Transform support models from reactive case management toward predictive, proactive, and autonomous service operations.
  • Develop scalable automation frameworks across ERP and cloud environments, improving diagnostics, monitoring, integrations, configuration validation, and operational visibility.
  • Lead global teams through technology transformation initiatives, ensuring adoption of AI-powered processes and best practices.
  • Establish performance metrics to measure improvements in resolution speed, productivity, service margins, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with business leaders to create AI-enabled service offerings that deliver differentiated value to customers.

    • Requirements:

title: Product Design Intern (f/m/d)
description:
LiveEO turns satellite data into business-ready risk intelligence. Using Earth observation and AI, we help businesses detect and act on critical risks across infrastructure networks and global supply chains, earlier, at scale, and with less manual effort.


You'd be joining the team behind Treeline, our vegetation management solution for utilities. Treeline shows grid operators where vegetation threatens power lines.


You'd work on a new capability within it: wildfire prevention and storm. Wildfire is about where fuel and clearance risk concentrate ahead of a season, and where mitigation crews should go first. Storm is about which parts of the network are exposed when a front is forecast, and where restoration should be prioritised afterwards. Same underlying picture of the vegetation, two very different decisions built on top of it.

This is an internship with real ownership. You'll take real problems from our roadmap and carry them through the full design process — framing the problem, ideating, validating solutions with customers, handing over to development and iterating on them. The people using them are utility vegetation planners and grid operations teams making decisions about where to send crews.


You'll do that with the support and mentorship of our Senior Product Designer for Treeline, who will review and guide your work throughout — a weekly 1:1, twice-weekly design reviews with design team on live work, and a structured handover in your first month of everything she knows about the product and its users. You'll have someone experienced alongside you at every stage, and increasing independence as you go. Day to day you'll sit with the wildfire and storm PM and engineer, part of the squad from week one.


This is an onsite role in Berlin. We're looking for someone who can commit to 5 days a week, 40 hours, for the full 6-month term, working in person with the squad.


We're hiring this role with the intention of making a permanent offer if it's the right fit on both sides.


What you'll do

  • Take real problems and work them through end-to-end: framing, ideation, exploration, and high-craft UI, with a senior designer reviewing and guiding along the way.

  • Understand how these customers actually work today: under real users’ needs and use that to frame the problems worth solving. Including validating your designs with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Hand over and iterate with development: working with engineers through build and release, learning how to handover to development and seeing your work live and reviewing that it’s up to spec.

  • Contribute to our design foundations: learn new processes as tools change, but not to miss out on the fundamentals that are important for our work. Being able to contribute components and patterns with proper states, variants, and documentation, built pragmatically rather than exhaustively.

  • Work fast and iteratively — prototype, test, and refine, we move quickly and can iterate as we deliver

We're hiring for how you think and how you work, not for experience you haven't had time to accumulate yet.


  • A genuine willingness to learn, and openness, you will not know everything and receiving and applying feedback as well as picking things up quickly are key for success on our team

  • You speak up and bring ideas. We want your perspective in the room from the start, not once you've settled in.

  • Open to feedback — you take critique well, iterate fast, and treat a review as useful rather than personal.

  • Curiosity about a scientific domain. Vegetation, wildfire behaviour, and storm exposure are genuinely interesting problems, and we're looking for someone who finds them so and asks questions.

  • Strong visual craft — components, states, spacing, and typography that hold up without constant correction.

  • Systems thinking: you see patterns and reuse, not one-off screens.

  • Judgement with reference material — you adapt an established pattern with reasoning behind it, rather than reproducing it because it's there.

  • Self-direction: you take the initiative to organise and validate your own work rather than waiting to be handed a plan.

  • You raise blockers early and aren't afraid to ask questions. Going quiet when you're stuck is the one thing that genuinely doesn't work here.

  • Final-year or recently completed studies in design, HCI, or an equivalent self-taught path, with at least one project involving real users, however small.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken — all documentation, critique, and collaboration run through it.


Nice to have

  • HTML/CSS to read code and communicate with the development team.

  • Curiosity about AI tools and how they fit into a design workflow.

Not required: any satellite, remote-sensing, utility, or wildfire background. We can teach the domain in six months — we can't teach curiosity about it.

  • Real design ownership from week one — not a shadow internship, you'll take actual roadmap problems through to shipped features
  • Direct mentorship from our Senior Product Designer, with weekly 1:1s and twice-weekly design reviews on live work
  • A small, high-trust team where your work actually matters — you'll sit with the wildfire and storm PM and engineer as part of the squad
  • Exposure to how satellite data and AI translate into real business decisions for enterprise customers
  • BVG ticket subsidy
  • Urban Sports Membership
  • A spacious, lively office in the heart of Kreuzberg

title: Environmental Reporting Analyst
description:
This position ensures compliance with environmental regulations through data collection, analysis, internal reporting and preparation of external reporting, while providing support to internal teams on environmental issues specific to Shale & Tight Operations Assets. The role supports various environmental media, including air, water, waste, and biodiversity. The Environmental Reporting Analyst reports to the Environmental Team Lead in Chevron ENGINE in Bengaluru, India.

About the Company

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

Key Responsibilities

  • For Upstream Oil and Gas Shale & Tight regulations, perform data analysis on environmental regulations for air, water, and waste, and evaluate alternatives to meet compliance requirements, articulate recommendations.

  • Ensure data collection methods and practices comply with local, state, and federal environmental regulations and standards.

  • Prepare reports to demonstrate compliance with environmental permits and regulations.

  • Record and organize collected data systematically, ensuring accuracy and completeness.

  • Facilitate communication and coordination between internal teams to ensure timely and accurate reporting and compliance.

  • Partner with internal customers, such as operations, maintenance, capital projects, technical, and HSE teams, to compile data for assurance and reporting.

  • Develop and maintain systems for tracking and reporting on environmental performance and compliance metrics.

  • Identify communicate and implement opportunities to embed and streamline environmental compliance activities within process data systems, for example, automated alarming and notification systems.

  • Perform quality reviews of environmental data and report out on issues and gaps.

  • Manage multiple projects/activities and competing priorities, including the tracking and delivery of key actions assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in environmental reporting, compliance, or permitting in the oil and gas industry.

  • Consistent demonstration of communicating areas of concern or identification of compliance concerns with regional business contacts.

  • Strong understanding and experience working in data analysis tools and software; including Excel, SEEQ, and PowerBi. Able to provide environmental guidance and support to internal customers, such as operations, maintenance, capital projects, technical, and HSE teams.

  • Develop and maintain systems for tracking and reporting on environmental performance and compliance metrics.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets to ensure compliance with environmental dataset/calculations regulations and standards.

  • Able to conduct quality reviews of environmental data and reports including identification and resolution of issues or gaps.

  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present and simplify findings clearly to stakeholders.

  • Capable of developing an understanding of local and state environmental regulations and reporting requirements.

  • Experience communicating internally regarding compliance actions, permit application preparation, and various regulatory submittals.

  • Strong communication skills and capable of working effectively in teams and across functions to deliver results.

  • Strong attention to detail, project management, and prioritization skills needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficient understanding of Shale and Tight process and operations. Proficient understanding of United States environmental quality regulations (air, water, waste) with demonstrated knowledge of state regulations in Colorado, New Mexico, North Dakota, and/or Texas.

  • Working knowledge of Upstream Shale and Tight Asset Oil and Gas regulations.

  • Preference for candidates with knowledge of SEEQ and Power BI as well as specialized environmental reporting software (specifically Cority / LOCUS).

  • Proficient in the design and support of Low Code solutions and ability to apply technical skills across HSE and IT to minimize technical debt.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1.30pm to 10.30pm

What we can offer you

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.

  • Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.

  • Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.

Corporate Travel Consultant

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks in training (paid).This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management. You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM ET Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM ET once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.

  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

description:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Group Delivery Lead to join our Conventional Trust Deal Administration team. This role is located in Pittsburgh, PA or Lake Mary, FL.

The Vice President, Group Delivery Group Lead is an experienced individual contributor responsible for leading complex delivery initiatives across the Conventional Trust Deal Administration portfolio. This role is central to advancing a multi-year transformation agenda across products, processes, and operating models, with a strong focus on simplifying execution, modernizing workflows, reducing operational risk, and improving the client and employee experience.

The role requires a delivery leader who is energized by change, comfortable operating in a dynamic environment, and motivated by the opportunity to create tangible impact. This is not a steady-state maintenance role; it is suited to someone who wants to help shape the future state of the Conventional Trust organization by driving execution across strategic initiatives, challenging existing ways of working, and embedding more scalable, disciplined delivery practices across the group.

The position drives disciplined execution across a defined portfolio, aligning delivery plans to strategic priorities and promoting scalable practices. The role supports BNY’s strategic pillars by improving quality, resilience, efficiency, and speed to market for clients and internal stakeholders. Acting as a subject matter expert and cross-functional delivery focal point, the individual models the BNY Principles through accountability, collaboration, curiosity, and a strong focus on client outcomes.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of complex delivery initiatives across the Conventional Trust Deal Administration group, with emphasis on transformation, modernization, and process improvement.

  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Product, Risk, and other partner teams to ensure delivery outcomes are integrated, timely, and aligned to target-state objectives.

  • Build collaborative relationships across engineering, product, business, risk, finance, operations, and delivery teams to support alignment and execution.

  • Assist in maintaining roadmaps, backlogs, and planning activities by helping coordinate demand, capacity, timelines, and cross-functional dependencies.

  • Partner with stakeholders to provide visibility into key programs and initiatives, including tracking priorities, dependencies, milestones, risks, and action items.

  • Translate strategic direction into actionable plans, ensuring initiatives are clearly documented, tracked, and progressed to completion.

  • Coordinate leadership meetings, status reviews, decision forums, and follow-up activities to help drive transparency and operational effectiveness.

  • Contribute to governance, delivery excellence, and process improvement efforts through reporting, analytics, metrics, and risk tracking.



To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline (e.g., Business, Engineering, Operations, or related field).

  • 5-8 years of experience leading delivery of large-scale technology initiatives within Agile environments, including experience coordinating work across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.

  • Advanced delivery and program management skills, including planning, coordination, risk management, and execution in complex, cross-functional environments, with working knowledge of agile methodologies and tooling, backlog management, dependency tracking, milestone planning, and delivery reporting.

  • Demonstrated ability to organize complex initiatives, manage competing priorities, and drive follow-through in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to build effective relationships across a matrixed organization and collaborate with stakeholders at varying levels through clear communication, sound judgment, and a proactive approach.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and presentation skills, with the ability to distill complex information into clear recommendations and actionable next steps.

  • Proven experience managing cross-team dependencies, release planning, delivery governance, risk management, and executive stakeholder communications within complex enterprise technology organizations.

  • Experience preparing reports, business updates, and presentations for leadership audiences.

  • Professional certification in project, program, or portfolio management (e.g., PMP, SAFe, Agile/Scrum) preferred.

title: GAME PRESENTER with Japanese

A Game Presenter is a person who opens, maintains, and closes card games, dealing cards and broadcasting live to online players in front of the cameras in an our studio. The job of a Game Presenter does not require previous work experience, we will teach you everything you need to know and make you a star! What we expect from you is a positive attitude, cooperation, precision, and respect for the simple rules that you will quickly master. You will start your new job with professional training provided by your future colleagues in our studio in Toronto, in a pleasant, modern, and technologically advanced environment. The online gaming platform operates 24 hours a day, every day of the year, making the Game Presenter position organized into 3 shifts with rotations.

You’ll host iconic casino games like Baccarat and Roulette, with unlimited virtual players from all around the world. Best of all, no experience is required!   • Conduct live games for online players in accordance with company policies and procedures.
  • Interact with players in a professional and friendly manner, while providing them with excellent customer service.
  • Deal cards, spin a wheel, announce various winning bets as well as card shuffling.
  • Perform Floor Supervisor responsibility on a rotating basis.
  • Quick and accurate handling of cards and other gaming equipment.
  • Follow strict security procedures and protocols to ensure the integrity of the games.
  • Assist players with the rules of the game and effectively answer any questions related to winnings, or other concerns.
  • Escalate any disputes accordingly to the company’s policies in an efficient and timely manner.
  • Attend training sessions and stay up to date with new games and industry trends.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.
WHAT WE ASK OF YOU
  • Fluency in Japanese and English.

  • Have excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Must be comfortable with technology and have basic computer skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while remaining calm under pressure, maintaining accuracy and discretion.
  • Flexible working hours and shift work suits you.
  • Basic casino games knowledge would be an asset.
  • Must be able to comply with the gaming licensing directive upon hire date.
WHAT WE OFFER IN EXCHANGE
No experience required – we will train you!
Join our team and elevate your career with enhanced earnings and benefits!
Grow with ARRISE | Learning Hub—personalized learning, gamified growth, and endless career development at your fingertips.

Our night shift premium adds an additional +10% per hour, rewarding those who keep our games lively during the twilight hours.
Comprehensive benefits post-probation:
Your well-being is our priority. Following a 3-month probation period, you’ll gain access to our comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans.
Performance bonuses:
Our new performance bonus structure is based on clear and achievable KPIs. You have the power to boost your earnings. Top performers can see an increase added to their monthly income. It’s our way of saying thank you for your hard work and dedication.
For more information, check out our ‘why join us’ section below.
Highly recommended by employees, with a strong preference to refer friends.
ABOUT US
ARRISE sets the benchmark for service delivery and excellence in the iGaming industry.
