title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
Introduction to role:Are you ready to engineer the AI platforms that turn cutting-edge science into real patient impact? In this role, you will build and operate the cloud-native foundations that power advanced image processing and model workflows, enabling product and research teams to move from idea to impact quickly, safely and at scale.

You will design, automate and run platforms using Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, and modern CI/CD to remove bottlenecks and harden reliability. Your work will help our teams deliver faster with higher quality, unlocking insights that accelerate the development of life-changing medicines. Do you thrive on turning fragile, manual steps into elegant automation that others trust?

Accountabilities:- Image Processing Platforms: Develop and maintain robust environments for high-performance image processing in collaboration with internal teams and external partners, ensuring reliability, scalability and security.- Kubernetes Orchestration: Operate and optimize container orchestration, standardizing deployments and scaling services to meet demanding workloads.- Cloud Infrastructure Automation: Define and implement automated infrastructure deployments in AWS, codifying environments for repeatability, speed and compliance.- CI/CD at Scale: Shape and implement company-wide CI/CD practices and tooling to cut lead times, increase release frequency and improve recoverability.- Architecture and Reliability: Contribute to future-state architectures that elevate availability, performance and operational efficiency across platforms.- Product Collaboration: Work closely with product engineering to diagnose design issues, remove bottlenecks and eliminate manual configuration through automation.- Tooling Ownership: Manage core automation toolchains, including configuration management, version control and build/release systems, keeping them secure and current.- Engineering Evangelism: Educate and coach teams to adopt infrastructure-as-code and automation best practices, raising engineering standards across the organization.

Essential Skills/Experience:- Experience with utilizing cloud infrastructure and platform services (e.g AWS, Google Cloud, Azure)- Good knowledge of scripting languages, such as Python or shell scripts- Linux administration- Experience in configuration management and infrastructure automation systems, preferably Terraform- Experience in version control systems, preferably Git- Experience in CI/CD platforms (e.g. Github Actions, Jenkins, GitLab)

Desirable Skills/Experience:- Practical experience it dealing with complex IT processes and applications- Experience in handling self-managed or provided as a service (EKS, GKE) Kubernetes- Good knowledge in IT networking- Experience in monitoring tools and log management solutions (e.g Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, Splunk etc)- Experience in case tracking system (e.g. Jira, Zendesk)- Self-learner who'll seek and find knowledge needed for new concepts/solutions/technologies- Strong communication skills on a technical and professional level as well as with service oriented- Ability to organize self and others including effective scheduling, prioritization and time management skills, completing tasks to tight deadlines

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

Why AstraZeneca:Here, purposeful science meets high-powered technology with the investment to win. You will work with modern platforms, from Kubernetes to data and AI, alongside diverse specialists who challenge assumptions and move fast together. We combine experimentation with high standards, pairing hackathon energy with enterprise scale, so your engineering choices can unlock scientific breakthroughs and reach patients sooner. We value kindness alongside ambition, giving you the freedom to take ownership, learn continuously and shape the technologies that drive the future of digital healthcare.

Call to Action:Step into a role where your engineering will accelerate breakthroughs for patients—seize this opportunity to build the platforms that define what’s next!

title: Education Research Analyst 1/2/3-AAA
description:
About this Job


**This position is located in Baton Rouge, LA**

Office of Assessment, Accountability, and Analytics

Job Focus Area
The Division of Assessments, Accountability, and Analytics leads the collection, analysis, and strategic use of data to inform decision-making at all levels of birth-12 leadership to drive student success. If we believe that all students can achieve, then we must measure their progress to ensure they remain on track for the next grade level and, ultimately, for college and professional careers.

This Education Research Analyst (ERA) position is located within the Office of Assessments, Accountability and Analytics - Data Strategy & Governance division as part of the Data Quality team. The ERA will engage in advanced research, evaluation, and data analysis projects that influence the Louisiana Department of Education (LDOE) policy, initiatives, and strategic planning, as well as support the LDOE systems data collection and data consolidation activities required for educational planning. This includes oversight and management of multiple LDOE Statewide systems and assisting with application enhancements and modifications to given systems, communication and training with all of the Local Education Agencies (LEAs) and associated contacts, and ensuring that the data is as error-free and correct as possible once a system collection closes. This position provides highly technical assistance and advice to LDOE staff and LEAs regarding relevant data and data submissions. This position also acts as a Departmental data representative, as necessary, through written and oral communications.

Applicants with the following experience are encouraged to apply:
The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding and practical application of SQL, SAS, R, and Python programming, as well as experience with Microsoft Access, data analysis, and dashboard development.

Minimum Qualifications

A master's degree in education, statistics, mathematics, or in a data analytics, data management, information technology, or social sciences field.

Job Specification

The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here.

Job Duties and Other Information

Job Duties:
As an Education Research Analyst 1, 2, or 3, you will:

  • Serves as a technical liaison for the Department for Education and recommends new and emerging development strategies, data collection methods, and products as relates to Departmental goals and strategies. Provides technical consulting on data collection and cleansing approaches, procedures, and polices.
  • Collaborates with staff and administration to design, test, pilot, and implement statewide data collections.
  • Serves as a technical consultant to various management levels within the Department for various educational, financial, and institutional programs.
  • Extracts and summarizes mission and/or program critical data for information analysis, verification, and/or interpretation.
  • Distillates data from key databases for use in PC-based software systems as required.
  • Participates in quality assurance reviews of LDOE systems, data, and documentation. Works collaboratively with Data Systems and Reporting teams to develop and implement edit checks, ensuring better data at the point of entry.
  • Develops technical training materials, system user guides for LEAs and non-public schools, and data element dictionaries.

Position-Specific Details:
Appointment Type: Probational, Promotional, or Job Appointment. The person hired for this position is expected to report to the Baton Rouge office as requested. Current permanent classified state employees may be required to accept a probationary appointment, if selected.

Career Progression: This position participates in a Career Progression Group. As part of a Career Progression Group, vacancies may be filled from this recruitment as an Education Research Analyst 1/2/3, depending on the level of experience of the selected applicant.

Work Schedule: Workdays are Monday - Friday; work hours will be determined.

Compensation: The salary offered will be determined based on qualifications and experience.

The maximum amounts listed are the maximum salary amounts a person can make over their career and not the maximum amount we are allowed to pay a new hire.

description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled Dell Boomi Developer to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Dell Boomi Developer
Job Title: Dell Boomi Developer
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Experience: 5+ years
Sponsorship: No new H1B sponsorship available. H1B transfers welcomed for qualified candidates.
Employment Type: Full-time, direct W2 with Bright Vision Technologies (no C2C, no 1099, no third-party)
Engagement: Long-term, multi-year, aligned to the Bright Vision SOW delivery roadmap
Compensation: Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, plus benefits.
Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.
We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.
BUT STRICTLY NO C2C/1099/3RD PARTY COMPANIES. ALL OUR ROLES ARE W2 AND NO 3RD PARTY BROKERING PLEASE.
Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.
No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.
However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.
For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Dell Boomi Integration Engineer to design, build, and operate enterprise integrations using the Boomi AtomSphere platform. In this role you will own the full integration lifecycle — from analysis and design through development, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support — and will partner with application teams, enterprise architects, and integration partners. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on Boomi expertise with broad knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, API management, and event-driven architectures. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop Boomi integration processes, including connectors, data maps, decisions, branches, and exception handling.
  • Apply Boomi’s low-code patterns alongside custom scripting (Groovy, JavaScript) for complex transformations.
  • Build connectors and use the Boomi Connector SDK where required.
  • Configure and manage Atom and Molecule runtimes appropriate to workload needs.
  • Design and operate API management strategies using Boomi API Management.
  • Implement secure authentication patterns including OAuth2, mTLS, and certificate-based authentication.
  • Build event-driven and pub/sub patterns using Boomi Flow, Event Streams, and external messaging platforms.
  • Develop CI/CD pipelines for Boomi processes using Boomi’s deployment APIs, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.
  • Lead migration efforts to retire legacy integrations from other middleware platforms to Boomi, planning phased cutovers, building backward-compatibility shims where needed, and ensuring each migration step is reversible and well-monitored.
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and operational dashboards, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Profile and optimize performance of high-volume Boomi integrations, applying systematic measurement, targeted improvements, and data-driven validation to deliver quantifiable gains in throughput, latency, or resource efficiency.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to internal integration patterns and standards.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of integration experience with strong focus on Dell Boomi AtomSphere.
  • Hands-on experience with Boomi processes, connectors, and Atom/Molecule runtimes.
  • Solid scripting skills (Groovy, JavaScript) for Boomi customization.
  • Working knowledge of Boomi API Management.
  • Experience with API security standards (OAuth2, mTLS, certificate-based).
  • Familiarity with event-driven integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience integrating SAP, Salesforce, Workday, NetSuite, or similar SaaS platforms.
  • Experience with CI/CD tooling for Boomi.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Boomi Professional or Architect certifications.
  • Exposure to Boomi Flow and Boomi DataHub.
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant integration patterns.
  • Experience with related platforms (MuleSoft, OIC, SAP CPI).
  • Working knowledge of FinOps and integration cost management.
How to Apply

For immediate consideration, please send your resume to venkat.r@bvteck.com or contact us at (908) 505-3899. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

title: AI Consultant
description:

title: Critical Operations Technician I
description:
SUMMARY

The Critical Operations Technician I is responsible for the installation, repair, and maintenance of IT, electrical, mechanical, plumbing/piping equipment, machinery and controls located in the interior and exterior of building. This role monitors operations and conducts a routine and ongoing assessment of the building systems, operations, and performance. This role performs tests, rounds and analyzes data to ensure the proper functioning of departmental equipment. The role is also responsible for assisting customers on the Data Center floor both in person and via the telephone, performing customer equipment installs, managing tickets within the ticketing system, communicating and escalating alerts and customer requests to systems engineers for resolution, and completing tasks pertaining to computer hardware, software or operation systems. This role requires on-site work hours to support a 24X7X365 data center environment and is not eligible for remote and/or hybrid work.

RESPONSIBILITIES, other duties may be assigned.

  • Applies learning, knowledge, skills, and company policies to a wide range of tasks pertaining to IT, electrical and mechanical equipment, controls, and operating systems.
  • Leads, maintains, monitors, and performs preventive maintenance on mechanical and electrical equipment; records readings and adjusts where necessary to ensure proper operation of equipment.
  • Provide remote hands and eyes services for customers.
  • Provide high level computer hardware and software configuration support. Install suite wall, cage material, ladder rack, fiber tray, cabinets, cabling, and customer equipment based on documentation provided by provisioning documentation and established Data Center Operation procedures.
  • Installs and repairs IT, mechanical, and electrical equipment as required; assists other team members with major repairs and maintenance of building and equipment.
  • Process work orders for preventative and corrective maintenance on critical, building, and site infrastructure. Consults with supervisor or team lead to order necessary tools and equipment as required to complete all maintenance and perform necessary work.
  • Create and/or update tickets within the established ticketing system to address customer calls, data center facility, network and/or system related alerts.
  • Operates and monitors critical and non-critical system equipment and components to ensure safe and compliant operation.
  • Responds as required to building emergencies and customer requests.
  • Complies with departmental policy for the safe storage, usage, and disposal of hazardous materials.
  • Uses the Change Management Process to get approval for preventative and corrective maintenance. Commences & completes the maintenance along with the necessary documentation using the QTS process and software.

​BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

· Two or more years of technical training, military training, or workplace equivalency

· Background in areas of IT, electrical, and/or mechanical

· Proficiency with MS Office Suite

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

· One or more years of work experience in data center environment, NOC, or equivalent

· BOD OEM (Panduit, Corning), A+, Network+, BICSI Installer I certifications

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

· Customer focus with excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to interface with all levels within the organization.

· Ability to analyze operations of various systems, determine the cause of problems and malfunctions and take corrective action as required.

· Strong written, verbal and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to function in a team environment.

· The ability to pass job-related skills assessments based on pre-determined scoring criteria and time frames.

· Computer skills and familiarity with MS Office, Outlook, and web-based computer applications.

· The ability to acquire and apply job-related knowledge within set guidelines and expectations.

· Position may involve frequent typing, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, bending, reaching and lifting. Lifting requirements may range from <10 lbs. - 50 lbs. on a regular basis, with heavier weights done in conjunction with other individuals or lifting aids.

TOTAL REWARDS
This role is also eligible for a competitive beneﬁts package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; paid time off; paid volunteer days; employee assistance program; tuition assistance; parental leave; military leave assistance; QTS scholarship for dependents; wellness program, and other company beneﬁts.

title: Editor
description:
About Us

We Are Social is a global socially-led creative agency with unrivalled social media expertise. With more than 1,200 people in 15 offices spanning four continents, we deliver a global perspective to our clients at a time when social media is shaping culture.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Editor / Motion Graphics Artist based in We Are Social Indonesia, reporting to our Executive Creative Director in Singapore.

We’re not looking for someone who only knows how to make polished corporate videos. We’re looking for someone who can craft social-first content that feels native to the platforms people actually spend their time on.

You’ll bring ideas to life through editing, motion graphics, typography, sound design and visual storytelling. Whether it’s a TikTok shot this morning, a campaign film, an Instagram Reel or a piece of always-on content, you’ll know how to make it feel fast, current and culturally relevant.

If you instinctively know where the cut should land, can make a static frame feel alive, and understand how the right piece of motion design can make someone stop scrolling, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Take scripts and raw footage and turn them into scroll-stopping short-form content across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
  • Edit a wide variety of social-first content across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn and emerging platforms, balancing speed with craft.
  • Create motion graphics, typography, supers, transitions and graphic systems that feel native to the internet.
  • Collaborate closely with creatives and producers to elevate ideas through pacing, rhythm, animation and visual treatment.
  • Develop editing styles that suit different brands, understanding that every client has their own visual language while keeping the work platform-native.
  • Work across everything from reactive content with same-day turnarounds to larger campaign films, adapting your workflow to the pace of social.
  • Experiment with emerging editing techniques, internet aesthetics and platform behaviours, helping keep our work fresh, relevant and far from formulaic.
  • You’ll also work with stills and other visual assets where needed, bringing consistency across different content formats.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • 3–5 years of experience editing digital, social or branded content, whether in an agency, production company, publisher or as an independent creator.
  • Fluent in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator, with strong working knowledge of CapCut and Canva.
  • An exceptional eye for pacing, rhythm and storytelling. You know that sometimes the funniest joke lands one frame earlier.
  • A strong understanding of the visual language of social media. You know why some edits feel authentic while others feel like traditional advertising trying too hard.
  • A solid understanding of animation principles, typography, layout, colour and composition, allowing you to create motion graphics that enhance the story rather than distract from it.
  • Comfortable working with audio, including dialogue clean-up, music editing, sound effects and subtle sound design.
  • Comfortable working at pace and adapting to tight, sometimes same-day turnarounds without compromising on craft.
  • Curious about culture, trends and the way people actually use social platforms.
  • Most importantly, you have taste. You know the difference between editing that simply looks impressive and editing that makes people feel something.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At We Are Social, we celebrate diverse perspectives and experiences, believing the best ideas come from unique voices and talents, including those not traditionally represented in advertising. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people from all backgrounds. We review every application fairly against the requirements of the role and strive to ensure everyone feels valued, included and empowered to contribute to our shared success.

Mental Demands:

title: Senior Global Planner
location: EMEA > CHE > Stabio > VF Campus NES
description:
Smartwool & icebreaker are looking for an exceptional Senior Global Planner to join our SWIB Global Brand Planning team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Driven by the belief that nature has the answers, we provide natural performance alternatives to synthetic-based apparel, to create a healthier and more sustainable future for our species and the planet. We're passionate about connecting people to natural alternatives.

We continue to launch campaigns and activities to enable people to better understand how their clothes are made, what they are made of and how moving to natural alternatives can make a positive impact. The constant pursuit of better is what drives our progress. We're not perfect, but we're looking for solutions that make a positive difference.

Let’s Talk about the Role

You as Senior Global Planner will play a critical part in strengthening the global demand planning process across the SWIB portfolio, ensuring accurate collection, consolidation and analysis of demand data across regions, channels, brands and product categories.

You will support the translation of regional commercial inputs, financial targets and product strategies into a clear global demand view for our portfolio of brands. You will partner closely with regional planning teams, commercial stakeholders, finance, merchandising and global supply planning to provide reliable insights, highlight risks and opportunities, and enable better decision-making across the end-to-end planning cycle.

How You Will Make a Difference

You will achieve this by:

  • Coordinate the global demand planning data collection process across regions, channels, brands and product categories, ensuring timely and accurate input submission.

  • Consolidate regional demand inputs into one global demand view, identifying key variances versus financial targets, prior submissions and seasonal assumptions.

  • Analyse demand trends, forecast changes, style-color productivity, regional performance and channel mix to support strategic planning decisions.

  • Prepare clear reporting, dashboards and executive summaries to communicate demand movements, key drivers, risks and opportunities to senior stakeholders.

  • Partner with Regional Planning, Finance, Merchandising, Commercial teams and Global Supply Planning to ensure demand data is aligned with business priorities, financial guardrails and supply chain feasibility.

  • Support monthly and seasonal demand review milestones, including global forecast submissions, buy reviews, demand handover, long-range planning and inventory-related analysis.

  • Drive continuous improvement of demand planning tools, templates, processes and data governance, with a focus on simplification, consistency and decision-ready insights.

  • Proactively highlight forecast risks, data gaps, demand volatility and potential service or inventory impacts, recommending practical actions to mitigate business exposure.

Skills for Success

Join our team and be a part of a company that values professionalism, flexibility, and high performance. If you are eager for new challenges, and ready to work with structural steel, join our team.

Why Kinsley Steel?

Position Summary

Our Fabrication Shops are looking for experienced welders, fitter fabricators, material handlers and machine operators to join our expanding operations in York, PA. Fabrication Shop position roles are focused on constructing steel frameworks and fabricating metal components.

Successful candidates will have a minimum of 3-years' experience in their respective roles, demonstrate a commitment to safety, be reliable, punctual, and exhibit a strong work ethic.

Responsibilities

Structural Steel Fitter Fabricator

  • Responsibilities include laying out, positioning, aligning, and fitting together fabricated parts according to blueprint and layout specifications.
  • Use cutting and heating torches properly.
  • Performing complex heat corrections, checking camber and sweep tolerances of beams and steel shapes and making necessary corrections.
  • Set up complex jigs or assemblies, identify and correct potential hazards, interpret complex documents.

Steel Welder

  • Responsible for welding structural steel parts according to detailed drawings and marked-up weld symbols.
  • Fit and assemble structural framework, components, and materials such as angle iron, plates, WF sections, and other steel shapes and components.
  • Safely operate overhead cranes, air arc, grinders, magnetic drills, and other tools of trade.

Machine Operator

  • Select correct machine settings for optimal burning, drilling, and processing operations.
  • Measure materials to ensure conformance with design specifications.
  • Select appropriate material type, stock size and dimensions as required.
  • Transfer data onto materials.

Material Handler

  • Perform rigging work including jacking and staking.
  • Load and unload steel from trucks.
  • Load steel to transfer tables to feed production line.
  • Operate forklift as needed.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Be flexible to work any schedule needed including overtime and Saturdays.
  • Punctuality and dependability are required.
  • Maintain a positive work atmosphere by functioning and communicating in an effective manner with co-workers, clients, and supervisors.
  • Work in compliance with Kinsley's safety policies and procedures.
  • Basic math skills are required.
  • Ability to tolerate hot and cold working environment.
  • Ability able to stand on feet for up to 10 hours.
  • Be organized and can multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

title: Workday Security Administrator
description:
The Workday Security Administrator is the subject matter expert for Workday security administration, operational support, and audit readiness. This role is responsible for maintaining a secure, scalable, and well-governed Workday environment by administering security roles, supporting access requests, troubleshooting complex issues, and partnering with Digital HR Technology, and audit stakeholders to ensure compliance and control effectiveness.

This position blends hands-on configuration with governance and support accountability. The ideal candidate brings strong Workday security expertise, understands how security decisions affect business processes and reporting, and can balance operational responsiveness with disciplined access controls and audit support.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary administrator for Workday security, including user-based security role assignments, role based assignments, and security-related reporting.
  • Administer and maintain Workday security access in alignment with approved governance processes, ensuring requests are reviewed, documented, and executed according to established approval requirements.
  • Configure and support security for core Workday processes across HCM and adjacent modules, ensuring the right balance of access, usability, segregation of duties, and risk control.
  • Support day-to-day operational security activities including access provisioning, access changes, issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution of security-related incidents and defects.
  • Maintain and improve security governance artifacts including approval matrices, role definitions, configuration standards, access procedures, and audit documentation.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing evidence, validating access controls, documenting control execution, and responding to questions related to security design, approvals, and system access.
  • Perform periodic access reviews and help identify inappropriate, conflicting, or excessive access, recommending and implementing corrective actions where needed.
  • Support controlled migrations and deployments of security-related changes across environments, including coordination of temporary elevated access where required for testing and production implementation.
  • Participate in Workday releases, enhancements, and projects to assess security impacts, complete testing, and ensure changes are implemented in line with governance expectations.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify security administration, strengthen controls, improve documentation, and enhance the support model.
  • 3–5+ years of hands-on Workday experience with meaningful depth in Workday security administration, support, and configuration.
  • Strong understanding of Workday security architecture, including Security Administrator and Security Configurator responsibilities, security groups, domain policies, business process policies, and role-based access.
  • Experience supporting enterprise Workday environments, including access administration, issue resolution, testing, and ongoing production support.
  • Experience with audit support, access controls, approval workflows, and security governance documentation.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and communicate resolutions clearly to technical and functional stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a controlled environment.
  • Ability to translate business needs into secure, maintainable Workday configuration and operational processes.

Preferred

  • Experience in a large, complex, global organization with multiple Workday functional domains and regional support considerations.
  • Experience with Workday reporting in support of security reviews, audits, and compliance activities.
  • Familiarity with migration and environment management practices for security-related changes.
  • Workday certification or advanced training in HCM and/or Security.

Success Profile

  • Operates with strong judgment and a control-minded approach
  • Balances service orientation with disciplined governance
  • Communicates clearly across technical, functional, and audit audiences
  • Brings a continuous improvement mindset to support, controls, and documentation
  • Works effectively across teams and through ambiguity in a global environment

Our Benefits

  • Volunteer time off
  • LinkedIn Learning

Description and Main Purpose of Job:

The Hotel Engineer is responsible for the safe, efficient and continuous operation, maintenance and monitoring of hotel and accommodation-related technical systems, ensuring guest comfort and service quality, while supervising the assigned team under the direction of the Staff Engineer.
Main Duties and Responsibilities:
Plan, supervise and carry out maintenance, inspections and monitoring of assigned hotel systems, ensuring safe, efficient and reliable operation in line with operational and guest comfort requirements, in coordination with the Staff Engineer and with the support of assigned hotel engineering personnel. Perform regular inspections of machinery spaces and accommodation areas to verify proper operation, condition and cleanliness of equipment. Supervise and manage assigned hotel engineering personnel, ensuring safe working practices, proper task execution and high housekeeping standards. Manage hotel-related defect reporting and follow-up, including the identification, recording, prioritization, tracking and closure of non-electrical defects in Shipsure, in coordination with the Hotel Department and under the supervision of the Staff Engineer. Ensure all maintenance activities, inspections, defects and work orders are accurately recorded and followed up in Shipsure Maintain high standards of housekeeping and cleanliness in all assigned areas, ensuring a safe and orderly working environment and proper use, care and storage of tools, equipment and materials. Maintain spare parts control for assigned equipment, including stock monitoring, requisitions, consumption tracking and preparation of orders when required. Conduct periodic physical inventories of spare parts and equipment as required by company procedures. Ensure that all operations are carried out in compliance with VMS, MARPOL, SOLAS and all applicable procedures and regulations Ensure compliance with work and rest hour requirements for self and assigned personnel. Maintain a professional appearance and conduct when working in passenger areas, in accordance with Company standards. Remain available to respond to operational requirements or emergencies outside normal working hours, as required. Prepare a comprehensive handover at the end of the contract, including system status, ongoing maintenance, outstanding defects and spare parts. Perform any additional duties as may reasonably be required by the Master, Chief Engineer. Ensure that all operations are carried out in compliance with safety, security, environmental, and quality requirements, including the correct use of PPE, risk assessments, toolbox talks, permits to work, isolation procedures, and pollution prevention measures. All employees have a duty under Company Policies and VMS requirements to: Participate in shipboard emergency duties and drills in accordance with the vessel’s muster list and emergency procedures Take reasonable care for their own health and safety and for that of others who may be affected by their acts or omissions Cooperate with management on health and safety matters Use correctly all work items provided by the Company, including personal protective equipment, in accordance with training and instructions Not interfere with or misuse anything provided for health, safety, or welfare Abide by environmental protection rules and regulations and actively participate in the reduction, reuse, and recycling schemes in place All employees shall participate actively in all HSEQ activities and promote safe practices as part of an integrated management approach.

title: Senior Director, AI Engineering
description:
See yourself at Dataminr

Dataminr is searching for a visionary Senior Director of AI Engineering to lead and inspire the team of engineers building the AI and data engine powering Dataminr’s real-time intelligence platform . This pivotal role demands a leader who can bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and scalable, real-world product deployment. You will drive technical strategies that translate complex AI, Deep Learning and Machine Learning innovations into tangible business impact. We are seeking a candidate with a strong technical foundation and a proven ability to deliver high-quality, end-to-end AI solutions. You are passionate about tackling challenging AI problems, fostering collaboration across product and research teams, and empowering your team to build products that make a meaningful, real-world difference. This US-based role can be remote or based out of our New York City office.

AI Innovation at Dataminr

Working at Dataminr you’ll have the opportunity to tackle the most exciting trends in AI on a daily basis to power a revolutionary product that uncovers critical events around the world as they unfold.

Regenerative AI: our AI technology, ReGenAI, is a new form of generative AI that automatically regenerates real-time Live Event Briefs as events unfold. Learn more here.

Agentic AI: we recently launched our Agentic AI capability, what we’re calling our Intel Agents, that autonomously generates critical context for our clients on real-time events, threats, and risks allowing them to see the clearest, most accurate view of what’s happening on the ground. Learn more here

Multimodal AI:our platform detects events from many different types of data (images, video, sensor data, audio, and text in over 150 languages). Learn more here.

The opportunity

  • Oversee all technical aspects of how different AI models’ outputs impact the quality of content produced by our AI platform. This includes working with PMs and different parts of the business to define proper performance requirements for different Deep Learning and Machine Learning models.

  • Work closely with scientists, engineers, and product managers to drive and deliver state of the art solutions at scale in multiple areas relevant to real-time detection of events in public data sources (NLP, CV, IR, Knowledge Graphs, etc).

  • Define and track quality and cost metrics for models as well as for their integrated end-to-end performance in relation to key business goals.

  • Hands-on modification of workflows, evaluations, and outputs of models.

  • Lead other engineers and scientists, directing changes to technical approaches.

  • Excel in placing a human-centered focus on the work (context, end-user impact, etc), finding solutions that work in practice, and have significant impact.

What you bring
At Dataminr, we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don't meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed. 6 Bullets max

  • Strong technical background required: graduate degree in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering.

  • At least 7 years of industry experience as a software engineer in a cloud-native environment (AWS, Kubernetes).

  • At least 5 years experience leading software engineers in an AI team.

  • Experience with deep learning frameworks, LLMs, agent harnesses, compound AI systems (PyTorch, Langfuse, LangGraph, Weaviate, A2A, etc)

  • Hands-on experience in developing and deploying Machine Learning/Deep Learning/LLMs at large scale in NLP, CV, IR, or a related field, preferably in a real-time setting.

  • Demonstrated track record of driving and delivering on multiple complex AI projects.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Deep understanding of research stages, and the ability to connect multiple complex technologies in end-to-end solutions.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Tech Lead)
description:
Overview

We're looking for a Full Stack Tech Lead with deep expertise across the frontend (React, TypeScript, CSS, HTML) and backend (C# / .NET, Entity Framework (or Java Spring Boot), relational databases) stack to lead our logistics app team. Beyond hands-on coding, you'll own the systems architecture for a scalable data ingest pipeline spanning edge and cloud environments. You'll set technical direction, mentor frontend and backend engineers, and drive systems design decisions across the platform. Working closely with product owners, designers, and fellow engineers, you'll iterate quickly on features, improve performance, and build out a secure, scalable platform for real-world military and government users.

This role blends technical leadership, architectural ownership, and hands-on coding, spanning everything from UI workflows to distributed backend services to deployment automation.

Who We AreWe’re not here to maintain the status quo, we’re here to rewrite it and innovate at the pace of need. Our team is laser-focused on creating cutting-edge RFID solutions for the DoD that bring passive and active RFID tech to life, solving tough integration challenges across global sites. We're a no-bench, get-after-it kind of company where initiative is rewarded, and innovation is our default setting. If you’re ready to dive in, take ownership, and ship real value, keep reading.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end systems architecture for a scalable, resilient data ingest pipeline spanning edge and cloud, built on Redis, RabbitMQ, and custom services.
  • Lead and mentor a team of frontend and backend engineers, guiding technical decisions, conducting code reviews, and establishing best practices and documentation.
  • Drive full-stack systems design decisions, from distributed data flows and message queuing to API architecture, data models, and UI component structure.
  • Lead an AI-enabled development team, owning the guardrails, validation layers, end-to-end tests, and supporting systems that keep AI-assisted output safe, reliable, and production-grade.
  • Break down product and design requirements into clear, workable, well-scoped engineering tasks and distribute them effectively across the team.
  • Build intuitive, responsive front-end experiences using React and modern component libraries, translating requirements into clean, reusable UI components.
  • Write clean, secure back-end services using C# / .NET, with a focus on REST APIs, modular design, and optimized data access layers using Entity Framework.
  • Collaborate across design, product, DevSecOps, and field teams to launch features quickly and securely.
  • Drive rapid prototyping cycles while enforcing production-grade coding standards across the team.
  • Champion automated testing and code quality gates by writing and reviewing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
  • Troubleshoot bugs, squash performance bottlenecks, and help build toward FedRAMP and IL5 deployment requirements.

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including prior experience leading or mentoring engineers.
  • Demonstrated ownership of systems architecture and design for distributed, scalable systems—ideally data ingest or streaming pipelines spanning edge and cloud environments.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed systems components such as Redis, RabbitMQ (or comparable message brokers), and custom service development.
  • Experience leading an AI-enabled development team, including owning the guardrails, validation, end-to-end testing, and support systems needed to safely and reliably ship AI-assisted work.
  • Full stack proficiency across frontend and backend, with demonstrated ability to make architectural decisions spanning both.
  • Strong frontend skills: React (component design, hooks, modern front-end patterns), JavaScript/TypeScript, and a solid grasp of HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles.
  • Strong backend skills: C# and modern .NET, with hands-on experience in Entity Framework and relational databases, plus a solid understanding of SQL, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Familiarity with dependency injection, async/await, and LINQ.
  • Deep understanding of systems design and the relationship between frontend and backend systems, including state management, REST APIs, async data fetching, and event-driven/asynchronous messaging patterns.
  • Experience with testing tools across the stack (e.g., Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library) and a track record of building automated validation and end-to-end testing into delivery.
  • Proven ability to turn product and design requirements into workable, well-scoped engineering tasks.
  • Familiarity with secure software development practices and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, etc).
  • Comfortable leading in Agile or Lean environments, with rapid delivery cycles and direct user feedback loops.
  • US Citizenship with the ability to obtain and maintain a government security clearance. Active Secret or TS clearance preferred

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on work with secure government environments (DoD, IL5+, FedRAMP).
  • Experience building logistics, supply chain, or asset tracking applications.
  • Certifications like Security+ and AWS Developer/Architect.
  • Past experience at a startup or in rapid-growth teams.

Target Salary Range: $130,000 - 200,000

Final compensation will be determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to your skills, experience, education, and/or certifications.

title: Sr. Business Analyst, Sustainability Reporting, WW Sustainability
description:
Join us at the forefront of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements to support Amazon's long term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon’s scale and speed to build a more resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally, and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable.

The Sustainability Reporting, Enablement and Governance (S-REG) team's mission is to build a lasting, scalable and trusted sustainability reporting infrastructure to satisfy regulatory requirements and stakeholder expectations. We translate external requirements into internal needs and build tools and mechanisms that enable Amazon businesses to meet their Sustainability reporting obligations and effectively manage their Sustainability risks and opportunities.

We are looking for a result-oriented, self-starter Business Analyst who is passionate about using data and automation to simplify complex sustainability reporting. You bring a builder mindset, a clear point of view on how AI tools can support and scale analytical work, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity - structuring problems, reaching defensible conclusions, and documenting clearly.

You are the analytical owner for how we validate and make sense of disclosure data across sustainability domains - including but not limited to carbon, energy, water, waste, and workforce. You will build deep contextual knowledge of those measurement and accounting systems and define the completeness, accuracy, correlation, and causality analyses that turn raw, multi-source data into disclosure-ready information; prototype those analyses on real data; ensure data quality through scalable testing; draw correlations across domains (and against financials) in a way that is rigorous and makes business sense; and partner with our internal tech teams to scale the winning solutions. Your work directly determines whether Amazon can produce sustainability disclosures that are accurate, explainable, and defensible under external assurance.

Key job responsibilities
Extract, transform, and present data from upstream systems for internal pre-reviews, statutory reporting, and external disclosures across sustainability domains (carbon, energy, water, waste, workforce).

Develop and implement scalable testing mechanisms for internal pre-review examinations and assurance readiness - completeness, accuracy, and reconciliation checks that flag defects early and prioritize them by materiality.

Evaluate and improve data collection and ingestion processes, proposing solutions that enhance scalability and eliminate redundancies - including the right detection and prevention rules to embed in upstream systems so defects are caught (or avoided) at the source.

Draw correlations across domains (and against financials) in a way that is rigorous and makes business sense, so reported trends are explainable and defensible under external assurance.

Rapidly prototype new analytics and validation approaches (including with GenAI tooling) to prove value on real data, then hand well-specified requirements to internal tech partners to build and scale.

Partner cross-functionally with data providers and measurement teams, report owners, and controllership - translating complex data-quality findings into plain language for non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders.

Own the analytics that validate whether upstream controls are operating as intended (e.g., completeness of automated checks, detection of bypass or override), partnering with controllership teams to specify control requirements for new solutions before they move to production.

US: $126000 - $180000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

title: Distillates Commercial Analyst
description:

Job Description:

The Distillates Commercial Analyst plays a critical role within BP’s Trading & Shipping (T&S) organization, supporting our mission to transform and connect the global energy market. Sitting directly on the trading bench, you will work closely with RPTE traders to ensure accurate, timely exposure reporting, high‑quality deal capture, and strong commercial insight that supports value creation across the portfolio.

This role requires precision, curiosity, and the ability to understand complex trading structures. You will collaborate with traders, commercial teams across London, Chicago, Houston, and Singapore, as well as internal support functions and external counterparties. The position reports to either the Commodity Commercial Manager or Commercial Advisor, depending on the commodity line.

Key Accountabilities

In this role, we support the bench by ensuring the book is accurate, timely, and aligned with trading activity. This includes managing daily exposure, maintaining pricing and valuations, capturing deals correctly, and working closely with traders so positions and strategies are reflected properly throughout the day. We also assist with commercial development by analysing grade values, pricing benchmarks, and supporting the lifecycle of deals as they progress operationally.

Primary responsibilities

  • Managing daily exposure for all trading books, including morning position updates, reconciliations, intraday moves, and end‑of‑day position explanations

  • Conducting timely and accurate deal entry and responding to support‑function queries

  • Managing daily and forward pricing, refreshing curves, and publishing daily prices

  • Post‑deal management including FX hedges, futures expiry, EFPs, and trigger‑price processes

  • Managing pricing options, evaluating structure options, executing rolls, and nominating pricing to third parties

  • Ensuring lifecycle valuation accuracy across operational amendments, blending/regrades, exposure‑modelled deals, and dummy deals

  • Supporting daily P&L accuracy and T0 valuation validation

  • Supporting on‑bench business development and origination, including grade value analysis, pricing benchmarks, and complexity assessments

  • Developing capability to manage daily third‑party relationships with smaller producers

Additional responsibilities

  • Managing the cost‑reconciliation process (freight, demurrage, etc.)

  • Supporting working‑capital funding structures and RAN targets

  • Understanding inter‑regional cargo optimisation

  • Monitoring and clearing failed valuations and ensuring MTM policy alignment

  • Supporting T&S strategic programmes to streamline and simplify processes.

Essential Experience & Requirements

  • Strong analytical and numeracy skills with experience in a commercial environment.

  • Technical understanding of derivatives and physical trading.

  • Ability to prioritise and organise workload autonomously.

  • Open, confident communication style with willingness to challenge and seek clarity.

  • Ability to explain key issues succinctly.

  • Highly effective team player, eager to learn and share knowledge.

  • Self‑starter with a track record of solving business problems.

  • Innovative mindset with interest in technology and analytics.

  • Spanish and/or French language skills are desirable but not essential, given the global nature of stakeholder and counterparty interactions.

Why Join Us?

At BP, we support our people to grow in a diverse and exciting environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity.

There are many aspects of our employees’ lives that are significant, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, excellent retirement benefits, among others.

title: System Engineering Lead - Wired Networking Hardware, eero
description:
As System Engineering Lead, you will drive the technical direction for our next-generation wired networking hardware. You will work with our Product team to align business requirements and industrial design with cost, manufacturability, and technical feasibility constraints. You'll collaborate with electrical engineers owning different hardware sub-systems (networking ASICs, Ethernet PHYs, PoE controllers, power, and SFP module interfaces) and ensure their successful integration into the overall system. Working closely with mechanical engineers, you'll optimize component placement, thermal management, and reliability requirements for rack-mount and desktop form factors. You'll also partner with our software teams to ensure hardware capabilities are fully accessible to customers through simple setup and management interfaces.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:

- Define hardware system architecture and technical requirements for multi-gigabit Ethernet switches, high-port-count PoE PSEs, and wired router/gateway products across rack-mount and desktop form factors
- Drive hardware platform decisions, including selection and integration of networking ASICs, Ethernet PHYs, SFP module interfaces, PoE solutions, power architecture, and thermal management strategy
- Develop and maintain technical documentation across the wired networking product line, including hardware architecture documents, system functional specifications, and performance requirement specifications
- Lead technical design reviews, participate in board bring-up and signal integrity optimization for new designs, and drive resolution of complex system-level issues
- Define design and test strategies to achieve system-level validation requirements, functional certifications (Ethernet, PoE, etc.) and regulatory compliance (EMI/EMC, safety)
- Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across multiple wired networking programs
- Support manufacturing teams during NPI and the transition to mass production

About the team
At eero, we're on a mission to make technology in homes just work. While we began by revolutionizing home wifi, we aim to create comprehensive networking solutions that serve both wireless and wired connectivity needs. Our cross-functional team spanning hardware, software, and manufacturing, develops advanced Ethernet switching and gateway products to complement our award-winning mesh wifi systems.

As an Amazon company, we combine the best of start-up culture with the resources and stability of one of the world's leading technology companies. Our team builds products that customers love - from mesh routers to high-performance wired networking devices - and we’re looking for talented people to join us in shaping the future of the connected home.

To find out more about eero, please visit eero.com.

This is a fully remote position and available if you live in the following states only: AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, ND, NE, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI & WY.

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

Evaluates medical records, provides clinical and surgical abstraction and assigns appropriate clinical diagnosis and procedure codes in accordance with nationally recognized coding guidelines.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Analyzes medical information from medical records. Accurately codes diagnostic and procedural information in accordance with national coding guidelines and appropriate reimbursement requirements. Consults with medical providers to clarify missing or inadequate record information and to determine appropriate diagnostic and procedure codes. Provides thorough, timely and accurate coding in accordance to department specific productivity and quality standards. Codes ICD CM and CPT4 for accurate APC assignment. Addresses National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits as appropriate. Reconciliation of charges as required.

2. Abstracts clinical diagnoses, procedure codes and documents other pertinent information obtained from the medical record into the electronic medical records. Seeks out missing information and creates complete records, including items such as disease and procedure codes, discharge disposition, date of surgery, attending physician, consulting physicians, surgeons and anesthesiologists, and appropriate signatures/authorizations. Refers inconsistent patient treatment information/documentation to coding quality analysts, supervisor or individual department for clarification/additional information for accurate code assignment.

3. Provides quality assurance for medical records. For all assigned records and/or areas assures compliance with coding rules and regulations according to regulatory agencies for state Medicaid plans, Center for Medicare Services (CMS), Office of the Inspector General (OIG) and the Health Care Financing Administration (HCFA), as well as company and applicable professional standards.

4. As assigned, compiles daily and monthly reports; tabulates data from medical records for research or analysis purposes.

5. Works independently under regular supervision. Uses specialized knowledge for accurate assignment of ICD/CPT codes according to national guidelines. May seek guidance for correct interpretation of coding guidelines and LCDs (Local Coverage Determinations).

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge and specialized formal training equivalent to the two year certification course in medical record keeping principles and practices, anatomy, physiology, pathology, medical terminology, standard nomenclature, and classification of diagnoses and operations, or an Associate’s degree in a related health care field.

Requires at least one of the following: Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Specialist – Physician (CCS-P), Certified Coding Associate (CCA), Certified Professional Coder – Apprentice (CPC-A), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), or Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), in an active status with the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) or American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC). Certification may also include a general area of specialty.

Six months providing professional coding services or other related healthcare experience within a broad range of health care facilities.

Must demonstrate a level of knowledge and understanding of ICD and CPT coding principles as recommended by the American Health Information Management Association coding competencies, and as normally demonstrated by certification by the American Academy of Professional Coders.

Must be able to work effectively and efficiently in a remote setting, utilizing common office programs, coding software and abstracting systems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Specialty Certification.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

You still know the work cold — when a complex denial or an angry payer call needs handling, you can take the headset.
Key Responsibilities
Run the Pod
  • Own daily allocation and queue management across assigned AR buckets — the right accounts, worked in the right order, by the right people.
  • Drive daily productivity and quality targets; track per-associate output and intervene early, not at month-end.
  • Run daily huddles — payer updates, error patterns from QA, and priorities for the shift.
Own the Outcomes
  • Answer for pod-level metrics — resolution rate, aged-AR movement, appeal TAT, and quality scores — in weekly reviews with the AM/Manager.
  • Handle escalated accounts and complex denials personally when needed.
  • Partner with QA on calibration and turn audit findings into floor-level fixes.
Build the People
  • Coach associates on payer-specific nuances, documentation quality, and call handling.
  • Manage shift adherence, leave planning, and floor discipline for the pod.
  • Identify and develop Sr Associate potential; give structured input into appraisals.
Skills & Experience
Must-Have
  • 4–5 years of hands-on US healthcare AR (provider side), with strong denials and appeals depth.
  • Minimum 1 year as a Team Lead with formal ownership of team targets, coaching, and performance conversations.
  • Command of AR metrics and the levers behind them — you can explain why a bucket moved, not just that it did.
  • Experience on practice-management / EHR platforms — Epic, AdvancedMD, or athenahealth preferred; similar platforms considered.
Preferred
  • Experience running a pod across multiple clients or specialties.
  • Exposure to workforce basics — shrinkage, occupancy, and staffing math.
Eligibility Criteria
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (any discipline) is mandatory and must be completed — candidates currently pursuing a degree, or with an incomplete/dropped graduation, are not eligible.
  • Communication: Strict — confident spoken and written English for payer calls, floor communication, client notes, and weekly reviews with management.
  • Work mode & shift: Onsite at Gurugram, 5 days a week, on a fixed night (US-hours) shift — reliable attendance, punctuality, and roster adherence are essential.
  • Systems: Comfortable with billing/EHR platforms and MS Excel for allocation, tracking, and pod-level reporting.
  • Notice period: Immediate joiners or candidates on short notice strongly preferred.
Performance Expectations
You will be measured on clear, role-specific metrics:
  • Pod resolution / collection rate against target.
  • Aged-AR movement (90+/120+) for the pod.
  • Pod quality score (QA) and calibration adherence.
  • Productivity vs. target, shift adherence, and pod attrition.
Hiring Process
  • Aptitude & Skill based assessment.
  • Domain & operations interview (RCM knowledge, scenarios).
  • HR discussion (fitment, shift, notice).
Why Join Neolytix
US Healthcare Depth
Live US provider accounts across 270+ client organizations — real RCM, not a training bench.		Clear Growth Path
Associate → Sr Associate → QA / TL → AM: progression tied to performance.
Multi-Platform Exposure
Hands-on across Epic, AdvancedMD, athenahealth, and more — skills that travel.		Stable, Growing MSO
A fast-growing US-headquartered organization with centres in Chicago, Gurugram, and Manila.

title: VP, Growth, Strategy, and Donor Relations
description:
Policy Link

Vice President, Growth, Strategy, and Donor Relations

To apply, please visit:

About the Organization

Short Summary

PolicyLink is a research and action institute working to advance a nation that truly governs for all.

Long Summary

PolicyLink advances structural solutions, shape conditions, build connections, and strengthen the field infrastructure needed to deliver on the promise of a nation where all can thrive. We are relentlessly focused on delivering results at a scale that matches the challenges — and the potential — of this country.

To achieve this vision, we concentrate our efforts in five key arenas that shape how the nation governs and delivers for its people:

  • The legal and regulatory systems that shape our democracy and economy, including amending and advancing the U.S. Constitution
  • Federal agencies, which are the engines of public policy and implementation that must deliver results
  • State and local governments that deliver the benefits of citizenship to our everyday lives in the cities and states where we live
  • We the People — whose collective consciousness and action must be activated toward everyone’s thriving
  • The institutional leaders, decision makers, and capital allocators who hold disproportionate influence over how the nation governs

Across these arenas, we are working to awaken a shared consciousness that embraces the humanity of every person; to shape government to deliver results for all; and to align the full force of our public, private, and civic resources to realize this future.

To learn more about what we do and our mission visit our website.

About the Position

What You’ll Do

As theVice President, Growth, Strategy, and Donor Relations, you will serve as the chief architect of the donor experience during a transformative era for the organization. Joining a high-impact team with a$50 million annual budgetand a staff of70+ professionals, you will act as a chief architect of the donor experience, operating with the autonomy to drive strategy and align internal functions within a high-impact team. Reporting to the Chief Development Officer, you will be instrumental in orchestrating the strategy development and execution for our historic $1 billion, 10-year capital campaign.


This role requires a sophisticated leader who moves beyond functional management to provide high-level stakeholder coordination and the oversight of a donor advisory council. You will lead a dynamic portfolio of initiatives designed to deepen relationships with institutional, corporate, and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) partners, ensuring all internal pieces move in lockstep with our collective campaign goals. This role will be essential in managing complex priorities and transforming the practice of philanthropy into a powerful force for whole-system change.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:


Strategic Philanthropy and Campaign Management

  • Drive the enterprise-wide engagement strategy to deepen multi-dimensional relationships with institutional, UHNW, and corporate partners.

  • Orchestrate the strategic roadmap for the $1B, 10-year capital campaign, ensuring organizational readiness for the early 2027 launch.

  • Co-lead the architecture of campaign infrastructure, including the design of donor recognition levels, gift societies, and long-term stewardship frameworks.

  • Govern a strategic portfolio of principal relationships, ensuring long-term alignment with the organization’s growth and campaign objectives.

  • Design high-level campaign readiness initiatives, including regional salons and leadership briefings, to cultivate and secure foundational lead investors.

  • Conceptualize and oversee signature leadership gatherings that enhance organizational visibility and serve as catalysts for campaign momentum.

  • Steward complex corporate and philanthropic partnerships, ensuring a rigorous match between investor goals and PolicyLink’s systemic change mission.

  • Direct large-scale operational ecosystems, managing multi-million dollar budgets, donor stewardship strategy, and cross-departmental integration.


Engagement Infrastructure and Storytelling

  • Create sophisticated, high-touch stewardship models for the organization’s most significant funders and campaign champions.

  • Provide the strategic vision and executive oversight for PolicyLink events, donor experiences, and other external opportunities, positioning them as premier national platforms.

  • Partner with Communications leadership to oversee the production of high-impact narratives and messaging that resonate with principal-level donors.

  • Drive data-informed decision-making by collaborating with Development Operations to leverage CRM insights and engagement metrics.

  • Equip and mobilize internal and external ambassadors, including the Board and Campaign Cabinet, through high-level training and capacity-building.

  • Oversee the integration of digital storytelling and engagement tools to amplify donor impact and organizational reach.


Team Management and Organizational Integration

  • Lead and mentor a high-performing Engagement & Events team, including staff and senior consultants, fostering a culture of "Love & Accountability."

  • Synthesize outreach and engagement strategies across Institutional Partnerships and UHNW teams to ensure a unified enterprise approach.

  • Serve as a key organizational representative in cross-functional planning related to public affairs, brand positioning, and external relations.

  • Act as an independent strategic lead, managing one’s own priorities and moving all internal pieces to ensure the successful execution of the campaign vision.

title: SEMH Inclusion Practitioner
description:
Organisation: Leicestershire County Council

Work Location: Oakfield North Short Stay Primary School, Forest Street, Shepshed, LE12 9DB and Oakfield South Short Stay Primary School, Auburn Road, Blaby, Leicestershire, LE8 4DA

Salary: £32,070 to £34,359 per annum (pro rata for part-time) (Pay award pending)

Working Hours: 34 hours per week - Term time only- 39 weeks per year

Contract Type: Permanent

Closing Date: 26th August 2026

Interview Date(s): Wednesday 9th &10th September 2026

Are you passionate about supporting young people with Social, Emotional, and Mental Health (SEMH) needs in primary mainstream educational settings? Do you have the expertise to help schools implement trauma-informed strategies to enhance learning and well-being? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to make a real difference!

Due to the expansion of our school-to-school department, we are looking for talented individuals to join our hard working and dedicated team to help pupils within our Local Authority, to successfully access their mainstream provision. Whilst the majority of your time will be spent supporting different schools in locality, our team are based at Oakfield Short Stay School, at Shepshed and Earl Shilton.

About the Role

You can be deployed to either base as demand requires, as well as working with primary and SEMH bases across the county preventing exclusions, preparing, and supporting pupils for reintegration within primary settings, including KS3 pupils as required. The role involves travel across the county for which mileage can be claimed, in accordance with Local Authority policy.

Oakfield Short Stay Primary is a 30 place SEMH pupil referral unit for Leicestershire. As a member of our team, you will be committed to providing high quality inclusive provision and be able to share your skills, expertise, and knowledge across the schools in Leicestershire. You will be expected to advise and support a range of interventions and teaching adaptations to promote reasonable adjustments and make learning engaging and accessible to all. You will be expected to share with teachers and teaching assistants the skills, knowledge and positive attitudes to keep children with SEMH challenges successfully within their mainstream settings.

We are looking for dedicated and caring practitioners, who work well as part of a team, whilst using their initiative when working independently. Staff who have worked in our team are highly sort after by mainstream schools, so this is an ideal opportunity to develop your skills to progress your career.

A DBS enhanced check for a regulated activity is required for this post.

For information on our approach to the recruitment of ex-offenders, please see our policy statement.

About You

We are looking for someone with proven experience of working with young people with SEMH needs in educational settings who has a strong understanding of trauma-informed practices and inclusive strategies. You must have excellent coaching and mentoring skills, with the ability to guide school staff effectively. The post holder must have the ability to work collaboratively with a range of professionals, including senior leaders and specialist staff. A commitment to improving outcomes for young people facing SEMH challenges is essential.

To apply for this post, you must be able to evidence in your application how you meet the following criteria:

  • A HLTA qualification or equivalent with GCSE Grade C or above or equivalent in Mathematics and English Language.
  • Supporting Schools: Work alongside school staff to embed trauma-informed practices, ensuring a nurturing and supportive environment for the young person.
  • Coaching & Modelling Best Practice: Provide guidance to teaching and support staff by demonstrating effective strategies and fostering inclusive teaching methods for children with complex SEMH needs.
  • Collaboration with Senior Leaders and wider professionals: Work with a range of professional teams to advise and promote best practices in SEMH support. Actively contributing advice and recommendations through primary inclusion forums and other local authority sources of support.
  • Regular Drop-ins for Continued Support: engagement with schools, offering regular visits and follow-ups to ensure consistency and progress.
  • Detailed Record-Keeping: Maintain accurate records in line with the school's graduated response framework, tracking progress and documenting key interventions.
  • Can demonstrate emotional resilience, adaptability and has the ability to maintain a positive and professional outlook when working in challenging situations.

In addition, we also expect you to share our commitment to our values and to delivering accessible and inclusive services which meet the needs of all of our residents. You will be asked to demonstrate your understanding of these commitments as part of the selection process.

Reasonable adjustments will be considered for applicants with a disability. We are a Disability Confident Employer.

Interested in Flexible Working?

We are open to discussions about flexible working, which may include part time working, job sharing, term-time working, flexible start and finish times, and hybrid working, depending on the requirements of the role and the service. If you would like to discuss the possible flexible working options that might be applicable to this role, please contact the person named below.

For more information or an informal discussion, please contact:

Georgina Cole Or Christopher Brown - Inclusion Co-ordinator/ SENDCO

Telephone: 0116 2759150

Email: oakfieldprimary@leics.gov.uk

How to Apply

At Leicestershire County Council we’re looking for top talent from all walks of life. Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, and whatever your background - we care about what you bring to our organisation, not just what’s on your CV. That’s why we’ve designed a recruitment process that’s fair, accessible, and focused on potential.
