title: Glazing Estimator
description:
JOB: GLAZING ESTIMATOR

LOCATION: LYMINGTON

SALARY: £40,000 - £50,000


A Glazing Estimator plays a critical role in securing profitable work by accurately pricing glazing and façade projects while ensuring all client requirements, specifications, and commercial risks are considered.


Reports To

Pre Construction Manager


Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and commercially aware Glazing Estimator to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for preparing accurate and competitive cost estimates for glazing, curtain walling, window, door, and façade projects. The role involves analysing drawings and specifications, obtaining supplier quotations, preparing tender submissions, and working closely with clients, project managers, and suppliers to secure new business opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review tender documents, drawings, specifications, and client requirements.
  • Measure and quantify glazing, curtain walling, windows, doors, and associated façade systems from architectural and construction drawings.
  • Prepare accurate material, labour, and subcontractor cost estimates.
  • Obtain and evaluate quotations from suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Produce detailed tender submissions, quotations, and pricing schedules.
  • Identify project risks, value engineering opportunities, and cost-saving solutions.
  • Liaise with architects, contractors, suppliers, and clients regarding technical and commercial enquiries.
  • Attend site visits and pre-tender meetings where required.
  • Maintain an up-to-date database of pricing, suppliers, and historical project costs.
  • Support contract handovers to the project delivery team following successful tender awards.
  • Monitor market trends, material costs, and industry developments.
  • Ensure estimates comply with company procedures, quality standards, and client specifications.


Key Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Experience in estimating within the glazing, façade, curtain walling, windows, or construction industry.
  • Experienced in Logikal, Techdesign & Schucal software
  • Strong ability to read and interpret architectural and technical drawings.
  • Excellent numerical and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and estimating software.
  • Strong commercial awareness and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to prioritise workload and meet tender deadlines.

Desirable

  • Knowledge of aluminium curtain walling systems and structural glazing.
  • Experience working with major contractors and commercial construction projects.
  • Understanding of building regulations and industry standards.
  • HNC/HND or equivalent qualification in Construction, Quantity Surveying, Engineering, or a related field.


Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised and methodical.
  • Self-motivated with a proactive approach.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities.
  • Team player with the ability to work independently.
  • Results-driven with a focus on accuracy and profitability.




This role is ideal for an experienced estimator looking to develop their career within a growing glazing and façade contracting business.

ATS Control Tower
At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step and a day to look forward to new challenges. And today is that day for you. It's your day to be part of something great. A day to make your ideas come to life and your day to join a company that redefines itself every day. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon.

ATS Control Tower Overview
CT is the central control center for Transportation Execution across the Amazon's European Transportation Middle Mile network, supporting both domestic and inter-country transportation movements for European geographies. Control Tower Team is the central owner to manage the sort center capacities in ATROPS and operates with a vision to provide uninterrupted sort center flows by managing the virtual capacities, tracking inbound flows and reacting to network disruptions that impact the Sort Center Flow. CT team plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon's European transportation network and thereby has direct impact on Amazon's ability to serve customers on time.

Purview of a Program Manager
As a program manager in the supply chain management department with reporting function, your role encompasses strategic planning, project management, and process improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing supply chain operations in alignment with organizational objectives, while also monitoring performance metrics and analyzing data to drive continuous improvement. Mitigating risks, ensuring compliance, and fostering cross-functional collaboration are paramount, as is providing leadership and direction to the supply chain team to maintain a high-performance culture focused on efficiency and innovation.

title: Senior Director, Global Clinical Operations Franchise Head, Hematology
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

Leveraging deep Therapeutic Area/Asset expertise, solid global program management skills, global view, and borderless leadership, the GCO Franchise Head is accountable for the strategic operational planning and clinical operational performance to deliver in the Franchise(s)- therapeutic area(s) or asset(s), and acts as point of escalation for resolution of issues of the associated program(s) in the Hematology Franchise(s). The Franchise Head will lead and manage the Global Clinical Program Lead (GCPL)/ Global Clinical Study Manager (gCSM) group in designated Franchise(s)- therapeutic area (s) or asset(s), provides inspirational leadership, facilitate proactive risk and issue management, and provide feedback-oriented mentorship to the GCPLs/gCSMs reports, fostering talent development. As a member of the leadership team of GCO P&SM, participate in shaping P&SM strategy, lead the functional management activities, and apply strategic thinking across franchise(s)-therapeutic area(s) or asset(s) to influence long-term strategy, partner with other Franchise Heads/Functional Representatives in BeOne R&D, drive Therapeutic/Asset strategy and ensure execution excellence by contributing clinical operations insights and expertise at franchise level. The Senior Director may act as a leading representative and spokesperson from GCO for the assigned franchise(s)-therapeutic area(s) or asset(s), the functional area, and the company on matters of critical importance to the company.

Essential Functions of the job:

  • Provide guidance to the CST and ensure timely, quality, and efficient study planning and execution of associated clinical programs/studies

title: Area Director - North East
description:
Area Director

Arriva North East

Shape the Future of Public Transport

Arriva is embarking on one of the most ambitious transformation programmes in UK public transport.

Backed by significant investment, a strengthened executive leadership team and a clear ambition to become Britain's leading bus operator, we're creating a business that is safer, smarter, more sustainable and relentlessly focused on our customers and the communities we serve.

We're now seeking an exceptional Area Director to lead our North East operating company. This is one of the most senior operational leadership positions within Arriva UK Bus and offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of public transport while leading one of the UK's largest and most strategically important regional bus businesses.

This recruitment campaign is being conducted on a strictly confidential basis.

The Opportunity

Reporting directly to the Managing Director - North, you'll have complete responsibility for the operational, commercial and financial performance of Arriva North East.

You'll lead a business generating approximately £85 million in annual revenue, operating a fleet of 366 buses and employing around 1,000 colleagues across our depots in Ashington, Blyth, Darlington, Durham, Redcar and Stockton, together with our Whitby outstation.

As the substantive leader of the North East business, you'll operate with genuine autonomy, supported by specialist UK Bus functions while retaining full accountability for local performance, customer experience and commercial success.

In addition to leading the business, you'll serve as the Statutory Director for Arriva's two North East legal entities and sit on the boards of the Group's regional ticketing companies, ensuring robust governance, compliance and strategic oversight.

What You'll Deliver

You'll be accountable for every aspect of business performance, including:

Strategic & Commercial Leadership

  • Full P&L ownership, driving sustainable financial performance and long-term growth.
  • Delivering the North East business strategy aligned with Arriva UK Bus's wider ambitions.
  • Leading investment decisions, governance and risk management across the operating company.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve commercial performance, revenue growth and operational efficiency.

Operational Excellence

  • Delivering safe, reliable and punctual bus services across the North East.
  • Driving improvements in operational performance, engineering excellence and fleet availability.
  • Ensuring compliance with Operator Licence requirements, regulatory obligations and safety legislation.
  • Creating a culture of continuous improvement across every area of the business.

Leadership & People

  • Inspiring and leading the Arriva North Senior Leadership Team.
  • Creating an engaged, high-performing and inclusive culture where colleagues can thrive.
  • Developing future leaders through effective succession planning and capability building.
  • Building strong, constructive relationships with Trade Unions and employee representatives.

Customer & Community

  • Ensuring customers remain at the heart of every decision.
  • Working collaboratively with commercial and marketing teams to enhance the customer experience.
  • Supporting the development of sustainable transport solutions that meet the evolving needs of local communities.

Stakeholder Engagement

You'll become the senior ambassador for Arriva across the North East, building trusted relationships with:

  • Local Authorities
  • Combined Authorities and Transport Authorities
  • Elected Mayors, MPs and elected members
  • Traffic Commissioner and regulatory bodies
  • Business partners and suppliers
  • Community organisations
  • Trade Union representatives

Working closely with Arriva's Public Affairs and Stakeholder Engagement teams, you'll help shape the future of transport across the region.

Driving Transformation

As Arriva continues its transformation journey, you'll:

  • Deliver large-scale business improvement initiatives.
  • Embed UK-wide programmes across the North East operation.
  • Champion innovation, sustainability and decarbonisation.
  • Collaborate with fellow Area Directors and the UK Bus Executive Team to share best practice and influence future strategy.

About You

We're looking for an accomplished executive leader with the credibility, commercial capability and operational expertise to lead a complex, customer-facing organisation.

You'll bring:

  • Significant senior leadership experience with full P&L accountability within a large, multi-site operation.
  • Strong knowledge of the bus industry, public transport or similarly regulated operational environments.
  • A proven track record of leading large, unionised workforces through change and transformation.
  • Exceptional commercial and financial acumen.
  • Outstanding stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging at board, government and partner level.
  • A passion for delivering operational excellence and exceptional customer outcomes.
  • The ability to balance strategic thinking with visible, hands-on leadership.

Why Arriva?

This is an opportunity to lead at one of the UK's largest public transport operators during a defining period of change.

You'll join a business offering:

  • Executive-level influence within a national leadership team.
  • Significant operational autonomy supported by specialist central expertise.
  • Industry-leading investment in fleet electrification and sustainability.
  • The opportunity to shape transport services that millions of customers rely upon every year.
  • A collaborative culture focused on innovation, performance and continuous improvement.

If you're an inspiring leader with the ambition to transform public transport and deliver lasting impact across the North East, we'd love to hear from you.

Location

This role is based within Arriva North East, with flexibility to be located at one of our regional depots. Regular travel across Northumberland, Tyne and Wear, County Durham and the Tees Valley will be required, together with occasional travel across the wider Arriva UK Bus network.

Ready to Lead the Future?

If you're looking for a career-defining executive opportunity with one of Europe's leading public transport operators, apply today and help shape the future of Arriva North East.

For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.
Job Summary
We are seeking a PLM Engineer with deep experience operating either PTC Windchill or Siemens Teamcenter (preferably both) in large enterprise environments. In this role you will own the technical operation of the PLM platform — installation, configuration, performance tuning, upgrades, integrations, and high availability — and partner with functional, engineering, and manufacturing teams to deliver a reliable, performant, and secure PLM ecosystem. The ideal candidate will bring strong PLM administration fundamentals, hands-on experience with PLM upgrades and migrations, and a measurement-driven approach to platform reliability.
Key Responsibilities
  • Install, configure, and operate Windchill or Teamcenter environments across development, test, and production.
  • Lead PLM upgrades, patches, and platform migrations with minimal disruption.
  • Manage PLM application servers, web servers, database connectivity, and method servers.
  • Operate file vaults, replication services, and CAD data management subsystems.
  • Implement and tune HA/DR strategies for PLM environments, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Optimize PLM performance through query tuning, caching, indexing, and JVM tuning.
  • Manage user provisioning, security configurations, and audit support, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Operate PLM integration brokers and middleware connectors, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Develop automation scripts using shell, Python, or Ansible to reduce operational toil.
  • Monitor PLM health using native tooling and integrated observability platforms.
  • Provide hands-on post-go-live and hypercare support, working closely with operations teams to triage incidents quickly, identify root causes, and drive durable fixes that improve long-term system stability.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the PLM platform, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of PLM platform administration experience.
  • Hands-on experience with either PTC Windchill or Siemens Teamcenter in production.
  • Strong experience with PLM upgrades and migrations.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle and SQL Server database administration.
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration skills.
  • Experience operating HA/DR for PLM environments.
  • Familiarity with PLM integration brokers and middleware.
  • Scripting skills in shell, Python, or Ansible.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience operating PLM on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, OCI).
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code for PLM environments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD patterns for PLM change management.
  • PTC or Siemens PLM certifications.
  • Experience with CAD integration patterns at scale.

description:
We are excited to introduce an exceptional opportunity for an experienced and highly influential Chief Architect to join Downer’s Group Technology team.

This is a pivotal technology leadership role suited to a strategic and hands-on architecture professional who thrives in complex enterprise environment and is passionate about shaping technology direction at scale. As the most senior technical design authority across Downer, you will play a critical role in defining and guiding the future-state architecture that enables the organisation’s transformation, growth and operational excellence.

Reporting to the General Manager, Strategy & Enablement, the Chief Architect is accountable for architecture decisions that influence the entire technology estate including Cloud & Networks, Apps & ERP, Data, AI & Integration, Cyber Security, and Business Unit technology environments. You will provide Group-wide architectural leadership, establish standards and governance, and ensure technology investments align with business outcomes, risk management and long-term strategic objectives.

Working closely with technology leaders, architects, business stakeholders, vendors and strategic partners, you will lead the development of a federated architecture model that balances governance with agility while enabling innovation across the Group.

This is a unique opportunity to drive technology strategy and architecture at enterprise scale while influencing some of the organisation’s most significant investment, transformation and capability-building decisions.

About the Role

In this role you will:

  • Serve as Downer’s most senior technical design authority, providing Group-wide architecture leadership and accountability across the technology estate.

  • Personally author target-state reference architectures for the organisation’s most complex and strategically important domains, including cloud and hosting, integration platforms and enterprise data capability.

  • Establish and maintain architecture standards, patterns and principles that guide technology decision-making across the Group.

  • Lead and govern a federated architecture operating model spanning Cloud & Networks, Apps & ERP, Data, AI & Integration, Cyber Security and Business Unit architecture teams.

  • Chair the Architecture Review Board and provide architectural oversight for strategic initiatives, major programs and technology investments.

  • Provide architecture due diligence and design leadership for significant platform, vendor, consolidation, transformation and M&A initiatives.

  • Drive consistency, alignment and architecture governance across a complex and diverse technology landscape.

  • Act as the escalation point for the organisation’s most complex architectural challenges and technology decisions.

  • Guide and mentor architects across the business, fostering capability uplift and a culture of engineering excellence.

  • Lead architecture direction supporting technology insourcing, operating model transformation and enterprise capability development.

  • Collaborate with senior business and technology leaders to translate strategy into practical, scalable and future-focused technology outcomes.

  • This is a highly visible leadership role where you will influence the strategic direction of technology across Downer while ensuring architectural integrity, scalability, security and business value.

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a respected architecture leader with deep technical expertise, commercial acumen and a proven ability to influence at executive level. You are equally comfortable operating at strategic board-level discussions and diving into complex technical architecture challenges.

You bring:

  • Demonstrated mastery as a practising, hands-on architect across multiple technology domains including cloud, integration and data platforms.

  • Experience holding architecture authority across large-scale enterprise or multi-function technology environments.

  • Proven experience designing and leading enterprise architecture strategies within complex organisations.

  • Strong experience developing and operating federated architecture models that drive alignment without relying on direct authority.

  • Experience leading architecture through technology transformation, insourcing initiatives or capability-building programs.

  • Deep expertise in enterprise architecture, cloud platforms, integration strategy, data architecture and technology governance.

  • Proven capability to evaluate and guide major technology investments, vendor strategies, platform selections and transformation initiatives.

  • Experience establishing architecture standards, principles, reference architectures and governance frameworks.

  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to influence senior leaders across business and technology functions.

  • Strong commercial and strategic thinking, with the ability to balance innovation, risk, investment and business outcomes.

  • A passion for mentoring and developing architecture capability across a broad technology community.

You are recognised for your technical credibility, sound judgement and ability to shape technology direction through influence, leadership and architectural excellence.

Benefits Of Working with Downer

  • Work with an ASX listed company, working with market leaders.
  • Grow your career with us, we are passionate about giving our people opportunities to grow through personal and professional development and continuous learning:
    • Professional development programs
      • Access to professional memberships and industry networks
  • Be part of a team that cares, we foster a work environment built on support that is flexible around our employee’s wellbeing needs:
    • Flexible work arrangements
      • Parental leave
      • Employee Assistance Program
      • Programs promoting diversity and inclusion
  • A range of Corporate Benefits, including:
    • Discounted services (car hires, hotels, insurance, retail stores, gyms)

Why Downer?

As a trusted name in infrastructure, transport, facilities management, and construction, Downer is committed to delivering projects that create a lasting, positive legacy. We’re committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve, and we welcome people of all ages, genders, sexual orientations, cultures, abilities, and lived experiences. We especially encourage applications from those whose voices have traditionally been underrepresented in our industry, including women, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples, Māori and Pasifika Peoples, veterans, people with disability, and neurodivergent individuals.

Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with this role, we’d still like to hear from you. If it feels like the right fit, apply - potential counts, and so do you.

As a WORK180 Endorsed Employer, we support flexibility that works for your life, inclusive leadership that values your voice, and equitable access to opportunity so you can do your best work and bring your whole self to it.

title: Software Engineer – Production Automation & CI/CD - 72096
description:
Software Engineer – Production Automation & CI/CD
Location: London
Contract: September 2026 – March 2027
Pay rate: £55 per hour PAYE

The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to build and maintain the automation that keeps a large-scale user-generated content application healthy in production.

The application operates as one product across multiple platforms, running natively on VR headsets and through cloud streaming on mobile and PC.

Working alongside the runtime and Keep the Lights On team, you will reduce manual operational and on-call work through automation. You will also maintain cloud-rendering and deployment pipelines and ensure CI/CD remains functional as upstream infrastructure and dependencies change.

Responsibilities
  • Build and maintain automation supporting release pipelines, build health, crash triage and incident detection.

  • Maintain and improve an AI-assisted code-repair system that autonomously creates and lands code fixes.

  • Develop tooling that automatically detects broken builds and identifies the root-cause change.

  • Build solutions that recommend or implement fixes for build and production failures.

  • Monitor production quality, reliability, capacity and latency.

  • Investigate and respond to production regressions, incidents and outages.

  • Reduce recurring operational and on-call work by approximately 80–90% through automation.

  • Maintain cloud-rendering, build and deployment pipelines.

  • Complete infrastructure and dependency migrations without disrupting downstream CI/CD.

  • Collaborate with runtime, production engineering and operational teams.

Essential experience
  • Eight or more years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent expertise.

  • Proven experience building and operating CI/CD, build, release and cloud-deployment pipelines at scale.

  • Experience operating cloud services and server-side fleets in production.

  • Strong knowledge of production reliability, capacity and latency.

  • Experience building or operating AI-assisted developer tools or coding agents that generate or repair code.

  • Experience developing tooling that detects broken builds and traces failures to their root-cause change.

  • Production monitoring, crash-triage and incident-response experience.

  • Experience supporting a large-scale application across multiple platforms.

  • A demonstrable record of reducing operational and on-call workloads through automation.

  • Experience completing infrastructure or dependency migrations without breaking downstream pipelines.

Desirable experience
  • Cloud gaming, cloud application streaming or remote rendering.

  • VR or cross-platform application environments.

  • Asset-delivery or CDN pipelines operating at scale.

  • Capacity, latency or session-orchestration monitoring for streamed workloads.

  • Live-service or other large-scale production applications.

  • Large monorepo build systems and dependency management.

  • Self-healing systems or automated remediation.

About you You will be a senior, hands-on engineer with a strong background in production engineering, site reliability, developer productivity, release engineering or infrastructure automation.

You should be comfortable investigating complex failures across build, cloud and deployment systems and developing reliable automation that prevents recurring incidents and reduces manual operational effort.

title: UX Copywriter - Freelance
description:
The Company

Christie’s, the world’s largest Art Business, is an incredibly exciting & enriching place to start or continue your career. Whether you work within one of our Specialist Art Departments, or in one of our more Operational teams, we are all working together with one common goal in mind: to continue the success of this 250 year old company, steeped in history, bringing fresh ideas whilst not forgetting our shared values; Integrity, Excellence, Innovation, Responsibility & Relationships. Colleagues across all departments are truly passionate about what they do and it is inspiring to work with industry leaders across our business.

Why This Role Matters

The UX Copywriter will play a key role in shaping and delivering clear, consistent and on-brand content across our global digital products during this 12-month contract. Working closely with Product Designers, Product Owners and the UX Manager (Strategy), they will ensure that every interaction is intuitive, engaging and aligned to user needs and business goals.

This is a hands-on role, responsible for crafting high-quality product copy while also contributing to wider digital content including emails, web pages and SEO-led content. The User Experience Copywriter will bring a strong understanding of content design principles, using research and data to inform decisions, and ensuring a cohesive voice across all touchpoints.

The role also leverages AI tools where appropriate to support content creation, optimisation and scalability.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Write, edit and optimise product copy across digital journeys, ensuring clarity, consistency and ease of use.

  • Collaborate closely with Product Designers and Product Owners to integrate content seamlessly into user experiences from concept through to delivery.

  • Translate complex processes and requirements into simple, intuitive and user-friendly language.

  • Contribute to the development and evolution of content guidelines, tone of voice and UX writing standards.

  • Support the creation of wider digital content, including emails, notifications, homepage copy and one-off microsites.

  • Review and edit SEO content produced by external freelancers, ensuring it meets brand, UX and performance standards.

  • Use data, user research and testing insights to iterate and improve content performance across journeys.

  • Participate in design reviews, workshops and ideation sessions, contributing a content-first perspective to problem-solving.

  • Work with cross-functional teams to ensure consistency of messaging and experience across all digital touchpoints.

  • Leverage AI tools where appropriate to support drafting, testing and scaling of content.

What you will bring to the team:

  • Proven experience in UX writing, content design or digital copywriting within a product or digital environment.

  • Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to simplify complex information into intuitive, accessible language.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating clear, user-centred product copy and end-to-end journey thinking.

  • Experience working collaboratively within Agile product teams alongside designers and product managers.

  • Good understanding of content design principles, accessibility and usability best practices.

  • Experience working with or editing SEO-driven content, balancing performance with user experience and brand voice.

  • Comfortable using data, research and testing to inform and iterate content decisions.

  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail, able to manage multiple content streams effectively.

  • Collaborative and proactive, with confidence to contribute ideas and challenge where needed.

  • Proficient in using Figma.

  • Experience or interest in the art market preferred.

Hybrid: 4 days in office, 1 day from home

Closing Date: 23rd August

title: Head of Portfolio Architect - Individual Markets
description:
Head of Portfolio Architecture, ‘Individual Markets’

Position Overview:

The Head of Individual Markets Architecture is a senior architecture leader responsible for shaping the end-to-end architecture and portfolio roadmap for Individual Markets, while influencing key investment decisions required to deliver it. This position works closely with the Head of the “Digital & Technology Business Unit Leader” to define, align and drive the architecture needed for the BU. This role requires expertise in end-to-end architecture that includes business processes, data, integration, AI and digital experiences to deliver scalable, secure, and compliant solutions. The role will matrix into the Head of Enterprise Architecture and drive end-to-end architecture for the Business Unit portfolio, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards while actively influencing architecture direction and investment priorities with the Enterprise Architecture team. While accountable for Business Unit, this role operates with enterprise-level influence, shaping cross-business outcomes, informing enterprise standards, and advising executive leadership on technology strategy.

This role operates within a federated Enterprise Architecture (EA) model, partnering closely with business technology and platform teams to shape solutions in real time while improving accountability, speed, and delivery alignment. The architect remains connected to the central EA core through enterprise standards, governance, communities of practice, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure consistent, risk-aware technology decisions across domains.

Key Responsibilities:

Portfolio Architecture Leadership

  • Drive architecture across multiple value streams within the business unit, ensuring cohesive, end-to-end design across platforms, products, and capabilities.
  • Own BU target state, portfolio roadmap, BU architecture priorities, investment influence, and architect leadership within the BU
  • Shape and advance modern platform architecture, including cloud, data, and AI capabilities, to enable scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions.
  • Improve engineering productivity and delivery speed by defining architecture patterns, standards, and operating structures that enable teams to execute effectively at scale.
  • Define and own the BU target-state architecture and portfolio-level roadmap aligned to enterprise architecture standards and insurance business strategy.
  • Work with Solution Architects on scalable patterns for the BU; Principal Enterprise Architect on enterprise alignment and cross-BU tradeoffs
  • Serve as the primary architecture advisor to the BU Head of Digital & Technology, influencing technology strategy, investment decisions, and transformation priorities.
  • Ensure alignment of BU architecture, strategy and technology to Enterprise Architecture and strategy
  • Shapes enterprise architecture direction indirectly by contributing to standards, influencing investment decisions, and advocating for cross-business solutions through architecture governance and leadership forums.
  • Translate insurance business objectives into capability-driven architectures, including product, corporate systems, underwriting, policy, claims, billing, and customer engagement platforms.
  • Ensure architectural alignment across modernization initiatives, new product launches, regulatory programs, and operational efficiency efforts.
  • Manage a team of Solution Architects supporting the BU
  • Available for production incidents with major impact to business operations
  • Responsible for building solutions to support their team

Investment & Roadmap Influence

  • Shape and influence strategic investments across:
    • Core insurance platforms (policy administration, claims, billing)
    • Data, analytics, and AI (pricing, underwriting, fraud detection, customer insights)
    • Digital and omni‑channel customer and distributor experiences
    • Integration, APIs, and ecosystem enablement (partners, reinsurers, vendors)
    • Corporate Systems (HR, Legal, Finance, Investments)
  • Balance near‑term delivery commitments with long‑term architectural sustainability.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, improve platform reuse, and accelerate time‑to‑market for insurance products.
  • Identify opportunities that drive reuse, simplification, and consistency across business units, not just within the portfolio

End‑to‑End Business Unit Insurance Architecture Ownership

  • Drive holistic architecture across:
    • Insurance business processes and value streams
    • Core and surrounding application ecosystems
    • Insurance data domains (policy, claims, customer, product, financial, actuarial)
    • Integration and event-driven architectures
    • AI/ML use cases for underwriting, claims automation, fraud, and personalization
    • Digital experiences for customers, agents, brokers, and internal users
  • Ensure all solutions meet regulatory, risk, security, privacy, and resiliency requirements (e.g., NAIC, SOX, SOC, data privacy).
  • Promote cloud‑native, API‑first, data‑centric, and AI‑enabled patterns where appropriate.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Enforce enterprise and insurance‑specific architecture standards, principles, and guardrails.
  • Lead or participate in architecture review and governance forums, ensuring alignment with regulatory and risk management expectations.
  • Collaborate with security, risk, compliance, and legal partners to ensure architecture supports auditability and operational resilience.

Stakeholder & Leadership Engagement

  • Act as a strategic advisor to Business Unit and senior enterprise technology leadership, influencing decisions that extend beyond the Business Unit Benefits portfolio.
  • Represent Business Unit architecture needs and trade-offs in enterprise forums, shaping outcomes across business units
  • Clearly communicate architectural direction, trade‑offs, and risk implications to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Mentor and develop architects across the portfolio, raising overall insurance architecture maturity.

Team Leadership & Collaboration:

  • Lead a team of technology architects
  • Partner with business and technology leaders to ensure key business initiatives
  • Partner with key enterprise technical domain architects and governance leader to apply the enterprise patterns, platforms and standards within the business unit.
  • Co-create with Enterprise Architecture Team on business unit technology planning

You have:

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in technology and architecture roles, with significant experience in the insurance industry.
  • Proven experience as a Portfolio, Domain, Product or Enterprise Architect in a large, regulated insurance or financial services environment.
  • Deep understanding of insurance operations and systems, including policy administration, underwriting, claims, billing, and distribution.
  • Deep understanding of Corporate system (HR, Legal, Finance and Investments)
  • Strong expertise in end‑to‑end enterprise architecture, including business, application, data, integration, AI, and digital domains.
  • Experience influencing CIO‑level and executive stakeholders on technology strategy and investment decisions.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, modern integration patterns, data platforms, and AI capabilities applied to insurance use cases.
  • Solid knowledge of insurance regulatory, risk, and compliance requirements.

Core Competencies

  • Insurance domain and systems expertise
  • Strategic and systems thinking
  • Portfolio planning and investment influence
  • Executive communication and stakeholder management
  • Architectural governance and design authority
  • Business technology alignment in regulated environments

Leadership Expectations

  • Operates with an enterprise and insurance‑first mindset, balancing BU needs with enterprise outcomes.
  • Champions modernization while respecting regulatory, operational, and risk constraints.
  • Drives architectural consistency without slowing delivery.
  • Develops strong architectural talent and elevates architecture practices.

Location:

  • Three days a week at a Guardian office in Holmdel, NJ, New York, NY or Bethlehem, PA.

Salary Range:

$178,690.00 - $293,560.00

The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate. title: Head of Expert Network & Sourcing
description:
Head of Expert Network & Sourcing

Location: London - 5 days in office
Working Pattern: Full-time, Permanent
Salary: £70,000-£80,000 + flexibility for the right candidate

About the Role

This is not a traditional recruitment or Talent Acquisition role.

Joining a fast-growing AI business, you'll build and lead the expert network and sourcing function responsible for identifying, engaging and growing networks of specialist professionals across a range of industries.

The business works with leading AI organisations to source the specialist expertise and human data required to develop and evaluate increasingly sophisticated AI models.

This is a high-volume, analytical and highly entrepreneurial role, combining expert sourcing, network development, analytics, automation and operations. You'll build scalable processes that enable the business to identify hundreds of relevant experts for multiple projects across constantly evolving sectors and domains.

You'll take ownership of a growing team and help build the function from the ground up, with sourcing directly connected to project delivery and commercial growth.

What You'll Own
  • Build and lead the central expert network and sourcing function, developing scalable processes, systems and best practice.
  • Design and deliver high-volume sourcing strategies across multiple channels, including LinkedIn, digital campaigns, job boards, partnerships and automated outreach.
  • Build, grow and manage networks and communities of specialist professionals across multiple sectors.
  • Rapidly launch new sourcing campaigns for emerging projects and evolving requirements.
  • Own sourcing performance, using data to measure pipeline efficiency, conversion, cost-per-expert and repeat engagement.
  • Develop strategies to maximise the re-engagement and repeat participation of qualified experts, reducing acquisition costs over time.
  • Introduce AI, automation and technology to improve sourcing efficiency, scalability and reach.
  • Develop compelling outreach and engagement strategies that attract specialists to participate in projects rather than traditional employment opportunities.
  • Lead and develop a small central team while supporting multiple concurrent projects.
  • Partner with leadership and project teams to forecast demand and build expert pipelines ahead of project requirements.
What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys building rather than inheriting - someone who can combine commercial thinking, data and hands-on execution to create a scalable expert acquisition engine.

You may come from an expert network, talent intelligence, sourcing, recruitment, marketplace, research, consulting or high-growth technology environment.

You'll ideally have:

  • Experience leading or building a sourcing, expert network, recruitment, talent acquisition, marketplace or similar function.
  • Experience managing high-volume sourcing, acquisition or specialist pipelines.
  • A strong analytical mindset, with the ability to use data to understand performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Experience using AI, automation and technology to improve sourcing or operational processes.
  • Strong understanding of sourcing funnels, conversion, engagement and pipeline management.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • A hands-on, entrepreneurial approach and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  • Experience building teams, processes or functions within a startup, scale-up or high-growth business.
Particularly relevant backgrounds

We'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

  • Expert networks and specialist research
  • Talent intelligence and strategic sourcing
  • Marketplace or supply-side acquisition
  • Community or network building
  • High-volume recruitment/sourcing environments
  • AI, technology or other high-growth businesses

Experience working with specialist professionals in areas such as finance, healthcare, legal, consulting, investment or technology would also be valuable.

Inventum Group is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Vice President, Artificial Intelligence
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Vice President, Artificial Intelligence based in United States.

The Vice President of Artificial Intelligence will define and lead an enterprise-wide AI strategy, building a foundation for responsible innovation and scalable adoption.
This executive role will establish and oversee an AI Center of Excellence, guiding governance, experimentation, and implementation across the organization.
The position will influence business transformation by identifying high-impact AI opportunities that improve operational efficiency, customer outcomes, and decision-making.
Working closely with technology, business, security, and compliance teams, this leader will create frameworks that enable safe and effective AI adoption.
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in AI technologies combined with strong executive leadership and strategic vision.
This is an opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven solutions within a mission-focused organization committed to meaningful impact.

Accountabilities:

The Vice President of Artificial Intelligence will lead the development and execution of enterprise AI capabilities, ensuring innovation is aligned with business objectives while maintaining responsible AI practices. This role will serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership and drive collaboration across technology and business teams.

  • Establish and lead an enterprise AI Center of Excellence focused on strategy, governance, innovation, and adoption.
  • Develop and execute an AI roadmap that supports organizational priorities and creates measurable business value.
  • Advise executive leadership on emerging AI trends, technologies, opportunities, and potential risks.
  • Serve as a thought leader and AI advocate, promoting understanding and adoption among technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Build strategic partnerships with AI technology providers, vendors, and external ecosystem partners.
  • Create frameworks for evaluating, prioritizing, and implementing AI initiatives across the organization.
  • Sponsor high-impact AI programs that improve operational performance, customer experiences, and business outcomes.
  • Develop reusable AI components, frameworks, and accelerators to enable scalable implementation.
  • Drive AI experimentation, proof-of-concepts, and adoption of emerging technologies.
  • Establish enterprise AI governance frameworks covering ethics, privacy, security, compliance, and responsible AI practices.
  • Define standards for AI model validation, testing, monitoring, explainability, and lifecycle management.

As our Employer Brand & Attraction Lead, you'll join an established Centre of Expertise within our People team, a team that has spent the last 18 months building strong foundations and is now focused on scaling impact, maturity and consistency across the business.

Everything we do is rooted in understanding and serving our customers better, guided by our purpose to make good food joyful, accessible and affordable for everyone. In this role, you'll help shape how we attract talent who share that commitment to customer closeness and delivering experiences that truly matter. Your work will be seen, felt and measured, shaping attraction strategies for Professional & Tech talent. This is a role with real ownership: trusted as a subject matter expert, empowered to influence strategy, challenge thinking and elevate how our employer brand shows up in the market for one of the UK's biggest retailers.

What you'll do

At the heart of our Employer Brand & Attraction team, this role leads attraction activity for professional hiring and early careers, helping us connect with the talent that will shape our business today and tomorrow. Acting as a key partner to recruitment teams, you'll translate employer brand and attraction strategies into engaging, targeted campaigns that build awareness, consideration and high-quality talent pipelines. The role has ownership of corporate, commercial and technology hiring, early careers, social channels and events.

From planning through to delivery and optimisation, attraction campaigns are a core focus. Using audience insight, market intelligence and performance data, you'll ensure activity reaches the right people in the right way. Whether promoting professional opportunities, attracting future talent or supporting critical hiring programmes, success comes from balancing creativity with commercial impact to deliver measurable results. Operating in a fast-paced environment, you'll be comfortable managing multiple priorities, adapting quickly to changing business needs and responding confidently to last-minute shifts in hiring demand, timelines and campaign requirements.

Working closely with the Employer Brand & Attraction team, recruiters, stakeholders across the business and external partners, the role provides expert guidance on attraction channels, social media strategy, event activity and recruitment marketing best practice. A strong understanding of inclusive attraction approaches helps strengthen candidate quality, improve diversity outcomes and support evolving business priorities.

The role also leads the planning and delivery of our events strategy, ensuring every activity is aligned to hiring needs, audience insights and employer brand objectives. Alongside external partners and agencies, responsibility sits with identifying innovative ways to engage talent communities, strengthen our market presence and build long-term relationships with future candidates. Success requires a flexible and proactive approach, with the ability to navigate changing priorities, evolving event requirements and short turnaround times while maintaining a high standard of delivery.

Thriving in ambiguity and embracing change will be key, as business priorities, hiring demands and attraction plans can evolve quickly. The ability to remain adaptable, solutions-focused and resilient while delivering high-quality outcomes will be essential to success in this role.

As our employer value proposition takes shape, this is a unique opportunity to help shape and activate our employer brand. You'll play a key role in translating the EVP into authentic experiences that resonate with candidates and colleagues, bringing it to life across campaigns, content, social channels and events. Through this work, you'll influence how experienced and future talent connect with our brand, supporting both immediate hiring needs and longer-term employer brand growth

Who you are

You have a strong understanding of employer brand and recruitment marketing, with experience translating employer value propositions into effective attraction activity. Retail is fast-paced and dynamic, so you're comfortable working autonomously and at speed, taking ownership from idea through to execution.

You bring a thoughtful, data-led approach to decision-making, using insight to improve performance and demonstrate impact. Relationship-building comes naturally, and your clear, confident communication enables effective collaboration and influence across teams, stakeholder groups and external partners.

A genuine commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion informs how you approach employer brand and attraction, ensuring outcomes maximise both impact and return on investment. You're passionate about creating experiences that put customers at the heart of everything, and you model our valued behaviours in the everyday.

You act with integrity, work inclusively and stay curious, while inspiring others to do the same. Naturally inquisitive, you stay close to emerging trends, tools and ideas, applying learning pragmatically to continually evolve how we attract and connect with talent.

Essential Criteria

  • Demonstrable experience in employer brand, talent attraction and recruitment marketing, with evidence of translating business strategies and hiring challenges into effective attraction solutions.

  • Proven capability in leading end-to-end recruitment marketing campaigns, from planning and delivery through to optimisation and measurable outcomes.

  • Evidenced project management skills, with evidence of successfully prioritising and delivering multiple workstreams, and managing stakeholders, budgets and deadlines within a fast-paced environment.

  • Effective stakeholder partnering and influencing skills, with experience collaborating across teams and building credibility with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.

  • Well-developed relationship-building skills, with evidence of establishing and maintaining successful partnerships with agencies, suppliers and key business partners.

  • Analytical and insight-led approach, with experience using data, market intelligence and performance measures to evaluate impact, inform decisions and improve outcomes

Whether that’s making sure nearly 150,000 colleagues are paid on time, or shaping a strategy that helps us attract the right people, put them in the right place, and unlock their potential. title: Solutions Architect
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

At Veeam, Solutions Architects work closely with sales providing solutions to problems.   • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Be a self-starter with the ability to learn new technologies quickly
  • Possess project management skills
  • Demonstrated expert capabilities in focused solutions
  • Demonstrated logical mindset and problem solving skills
  • Fluent English speaker

  • Monthly employer-paid allowance for private healthcare

  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

title: Principal Engineer, Structural Engineering
description:
WSP is looking for Candidate who should hold experience minimum of 15+ years on Structures engineering including design & development on RCC and Steel structures of Transport and infrastructure projects along with Chartership from (MIStructE/HKIE(str))

This role is to work as part of a team to support the delivery of projects. This role will be working under the supervision of a Associate or Hongkong team to carry out the following functions.

  • Analyze and design building structures based on applicable Hong Kong Design Standards and Specifications or equivalent BS EN standards.

  • Perform structural design, analysis calculations, and prepare design reports for foundations and building structures, including piling foundations, footing foundations, superstructures (both steel and concrete), long-span steel truss structures, footbridges, ELS-associated structures, and temporary works.

  • Develop and review structural plans and specifications.

  • Use engineering and design software (e.g., Etabs, SADS, SAP2000, SAFE, Prokon) to create engineering design reports.

  • Coordinate with other disciplines to provide adequate information for effective project progression.

  • Lead and supervise junior team members.

  • Liaise with the Hong Kong office and various stakeholders regarding work specifications.

  • Degree holder in Civil/Structural Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Minimum of 15 years of practical experience in structural design for building structures (Infrastructure, plant, and facilities buildings preferred).

  • Sound knowledge of design and engineering principles, as well as best practices in concrete and steel structural design.

  • Familiarity with Hong Kong/British/European standards.

  • Proven work experience as a Building Structural Engineer or in a similar role.

  • Proficiency in design software (e.g., Etabs, SADS, SAP2000, SAFE, Prokon).

  • Strong command of written and spoken English.

  • Chartered Engineer (MIStructE/HKIE(str)) is a must.

  • A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Project is essential

  • Strong command of written and spoken English. Good management, communication and technical skills and capable of working both within the team and independently, as dictated by workload

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and project management skills.

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD/BIM software preferred.

BGV:

  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.

  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Project Manager, Nurse Practitioner
description:
Compensation Range:

Annual Salary: $63,720.00 - $86,020.00

Position Summary

Under the general supervision of the Senior Director of Community Affairs in Health, the Project Manager Nurse Practitioner (PMNP) is responsible for supporting the day-to-day operations for the Gloria J. McNeal Nurse Managed Clinic (GJMNMC) grant-funded initiatives designed to enhance the quality of care, improving access to behavioral and primary care services.

The PMNP oversees clinic operations across multiple site locations in Los Angeles and San Diego, ensuring efficient clinic workflows and continuity of care. This includes management of the Electronic Health Record (HER) System (Practice Fusion), monitoring remote telemetric patient biometric data, and providing administrative and clinical support to advanced practice nurses, Master of Social Work (MSW) students, and community health administrative staff. The PMNP collaborates closely with faculty and staff from the National University (NU) JFK School of Psychology and Social Services, nurse faculty, and preceptors to ensure high-quality training and care delivery in simulated and live settings.

In their grant role, the PMNP directs grant activities in collaboration with internal and external partners, assists and monitors outcome reporting systems, and assists with communications with federal grant staff and stakeholders. The PMNP will assist with budget, supporting grant objectives across the institution, and supporting the Principal Investigator with additional project duties.

This position also includes scholarly and community engagement responsibilities, including co-authoring publications and reports related to clinic outcomes, collecting data for the federal Uniform Data System (UDS), and building relationships with community leaders, social service agencies, and CBOs to expand clinic services to new community site locations.

Essential Functions:

  • Ensure the successful completion of all grant-funded activities in accordance with Health Resources Services Administrations guidelines.
  • Assist with quarterly and final reports in a timely manner to meet grant compliance requirements.
  • Maintain ongoing, meaningful outcomes assessment related to all grant-funded initiatives.
  • Supervise the Nurse Practitioners and Community Health Administration Coordinator directly.
  • Manage vendor contracts, payments, and the implementation of contracted services.
  • Oversee day-to-day needs related to the coordination and execution of grant project activities.
  • Collaborate with the project evaluator to support quarterly data collection and reporting processes for annual reports.

Clinic Operations

  • Manage and support all aspects of daily clinic operations, ensuring efficient, effective, and patient-centered service delivery.

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in healthcare management and leadership required.
  • At least 5 years of experience in higher education student success programming, grants management, or related work with Hispanic adult learners preferred.
  • Experience coordinating or managing federal grant programs preferred.

Teamwork & Leadership

Technical Proficiency

title: Admissions/Records Assistant I
description:
Position Summary

The Admissions Records Assistant I is responsible for providing entry-level administrative support within the Admissions and Records Office, with primary responsibility for reviewing, validating, and processing admissions applications and supporting documentation. This position utilizes Banner, Axiom, Persona, and other institutional systems to verify applicant information, ensure data accuracy, identify discrepancies, and facilitate timely admissions processing. The Admissions Records Assistant I serves as a key quality control point in the admissions process by ensuring student records meet institutional requirements prior to admission and enrollment.


POSTING DATE: AUGUST 7, 2026

SALARY: Appropriate placement on Salary Schedule E4, 05 (range: $34,298 - $51,793).

ANTICIPATED START DATE: SEPTEMBER 15, 2026

The position will be based on the Wallace Campus in Dothan.

More than one position in the same job classification may be filled from the applicants for this position should another vacancy occur during the search process.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Application Review and Validation

  • Review admissions applications and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with institutional requirements.
  • Utilize Banner, Axiom, Persona, and other institutional systems to validate applicant information and supporting records.
  • Verify residency documentation, demographic information, identification records, and admissions requirements.
  • Identify discrepancies, incomplete records, duplicate applications, or conflicting information and take appropriate action to resolve issues.
  • Communicate with applicants regarding missing or deficient documentation.
  • Process admissions records according to established policies, procedures, and timelines.
  • Maintain accurate applicant records and ensure information is properly reflected across institutional systems.
  • Monitor assigned processing queues and workflows to ensure timely completion of admissions activities.

Records Management and Compliance

  • Review electronic documents and records for accuracy and completeness prior to processing.
  • Maintain confidential student records in accordance with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) and institutional policies.
  • Conduct routine audits and quality checks to ensure data integrity within admissions systems.
  • Assist with records retention and records management activities.
  • Support compliance with state, federal, accreditation, and institutional requirements related to admissions records.

Customer Service and Communication

  • Respond to applicant inquiries regarding application requirements, deadlines, and admission procedures.
  • Provide assistance to students, parents, faculty, staff, and external stakeholders regarding admissions processes.
  • Answer telephone calls, emails, and in-person inquiries in a professional and courteous manner.
  • Refer complex admissions, residency, or records issues to appropriate staff members.

Administrative Support

  • Assist with admissions events, registration activities, and student onboarding processes as assigned.
  • Support office operations through filing, document management, correspondence, and general clerical duties.
  • Assist with special projects and other duties related to admissions and records operations.
  • Collaborate with advising, financial aid, and other student services personnel to ensure efficient processing of student records.

Qualifications

  1. High school diploma or GED required.
  2. One year of full-time general clerical experience in a business office or in a service-related field is required.

description:
Join us at the frontier of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements to support Amazon's long term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

- Discover, define, and apply scientific, engineering, and business best practices to customer problems

title: Principal Modelling and Simulation Engineer
description:
Principal Modelling & Simulation Engineer

Take a leading role in modelling and simulation with a Principal Modelling and Simulation Engineer position that blends hands-on technical delivery with visible technical leadership. At this company, modelling and simulation sits at the heart of complex engineering work, from aircraft systems and flight control laws through to submarine autopilots and next-generation platforms. You will get autonomy to shape approaches, define verification strategies, and help develop the next generation of engineers, all within a smaller, highly capable team where your input genuinely moves projects forward.

Due to Security clearance you must be a UK national to apply for this role.


What You Will Do as Principal Modelling & Simulation Engineer:

- Lead the development of system and vehicle-level models, including plant and control algorithms.

- Define modelling approaches, requirements, and verification strategies to drive confidence in outputs.

- Own delivery of technical activities or work packages end-to-end, from planning through to presentation.

- Present results and technical outputs clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

- Support and mentor junior engineers, helping bring structure and clarity to complex problems.

- Contribute to planning, task definition, and delivery prioritisation to keep momentum and deadlines on track.

What You Will Bring as Principal Modelling & Simulation Engineer:

  • Strong experience with Matlab and Simulink-based modelling and simulation, with the ability to model complex dynamic systems
  • Understanding of control systems, system performance modelling, and vehicle dynamics, alongside multi-domain simulation exposure
  • Demonstrable experience with advanced control techniques such as Kalman filtering and state estimation
  • Exposure to real-time modelling or code generation using Matlab, including auto coding and C/C++ where relevant

This Principal Modelling and Simulation Engineer role directly supports a mission focused on operational excellence, future-proofing and delivering high-quality engineering solutions across demanding sectors. With global engineering capability and a strong emphasis on integrity, diversity of thought, and responsible delivery, this company brings together aerospace and marine expertise to fast-track innovation through each step of the engineering value chain. Your work will help ensure projects progress with clarity, technical rigour and confident decision-making.

Location:

This Principal Modelling and Simulation Engineer role is based in the UK, supporting work across complex engineering programmes with a strong engineering community.

Interested?

If the idea of owning modelling approaches, leading verification strategy, and mentoring engineers excites you, apply now for this Principal Modelling and Simulation Engineer opportunity and take the next step in shaping high-impact engineering solutions.

title: Principal Auditor - IT 3rd Party

Description of the Role

Internal Audit is an independent, objective assurance function that is critical to meeting our business ambitions whilst also protecting the interests of our customers by ensuring that the internal control, risk and governance frameworks are always fit for purpose. We look beyond financial risks and statements to consider wider issues such as the organisation's reputation, growth, its impact on the environment and the way we treat our customers and employees.

As an IT Audit Assignment team member and sometimes leader, you will help deliver meaningful improvements across the business by engaging with Technology and other key stakeholders to identify risk and control improvements. You will primarily support audits across Technology, IT Third-Party Risk Management and operational processes, whilst helping to build confidence and presentation skills through exposure to Senior Management.

This is a key role within the Internal Audit function for individuals with significant experience in Technology Audit, Technology Risk, Internal Audit or External Audit. The successful candidate will have strong experience leading technology audits, a good understanding of technology security and third-party risk management practices, excellent communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with colleagues and stakeholders.

The role is intended to bring the role holder up to the level where they have:

  • a strong understanding of the workings of both a Financial Services Group and an Internal Audit function;
  • a strong understanding of technology risk domains including IT operations, technology security, change management, cloud services, operational resilience and IT third-party risk management;
  • confidence to lead technology audit assignments with minimal supervision;
  • the ability to quickly assess technology and supplier management processes and identify key risks, controls and improvement opportunities;
  • excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex matters clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences;
  • strong stakeholder management and influencing skills;
  • a collaborative working style and commitment to supporting team success; and
  • an ability and willingness to leverage technology, data analytics and AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot to enhance audit effectiveness and efficiency.

To Succeed You Will Need to Demonstrate the Following Qualities

  • be eager to learn, take ownership and embrace new challenges;
  • build strong relationships and work collaboratively across teams;
  • communicate clearly, confidently and effectively;
  • challenge constructively whilst remaining open to challenge from others;
  • be a strong team player who supports colleagues and contributes positively to team culture;
  • lead, motivate and develop others;
  • analyse information quickly and exercise sound judgement; and
  • demonstrate curiosity regarding emerging technology and third-party risks.

Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

Planning & Risk Assessment

  • Supporting the planning and scoping of technology audit assignments.
  • Identifying key technology, supplier and operational risks and controls.
  • Preparing audit planning documentation, risk assessments and testing strategies.
  • Leveraging data analytics, automation and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to enhance planning and risk assessment activities.

Audit Performance

  • Designing and performing risk-based audit testing across technology and operational processes.
  • Assessing the effectiveness of controls over technology services, outsourced activities and third-party providers.
  • Producing high-quality audit workpapers in accordance with Internal Audit standards.
  • Utilising technology, data analytics and tools such as Microsoft Copilot to improve audit delivery and productivity.
  • Delivering assignments to agreed quality, budget and timelines.

Audit Reporting

  • Communicating audit findings clearly and constructively to stakeholders.
  • Drafting high-quality audit observations and reports with minimal supervision.
  • Supporting discussions with management to agree actions and remediation plans.
  • Reviewing work performed by junior team members where appropriate.

Business Partnering

  • Building effective relationships with Technology, Information Security, Procurement, Supplier Management and business stakeholders.
  • Maintaining regular engagement with key stakeholders to understand emerging risks and strategic initiatives.
  • Acting with integrity, professionalism and objectivity in all interactions.

Team Management

  • Supporting, coaching and mentoring junior auditors.
  • Providing constructive feedback and helping to develop team capability.
  • Promoting collaboration, knowledge sharing and the effective use of technology across the team.

Audit Community

  • Participating in initiatives that support continuous improvement of the Internal Audit function.
  • Sharing knowledge and best practice relating to technology risk, third-party risk management and technology-enabled auditing.
  • Contributing to a positive and inclusive team environment.

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Experience delivering Technology Audits, Technology Risk Audits or IT Control Reviews within Financial Services.
  • Experience of auditing Third-Party Risk Management, outsourcing arrangements or supplier risk frameworks.
  • Good understanding of technology security controls and technology governance practices.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively within a high-performing team environment.
  • Experience using audit management, data analytics and productivity tools.
  • Experience using or willingness to leverage AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot to improve audit quality and efficiency.
  • Professional qualifications such as CISA, CISM, CRISC or equivalent would be advantageous

What we offer:


We’re dedicated to supporting your wellbeing and helping you thrive, both at work and beyond. Our benefits are designed to help you balance your professional and personal life, and financially plan for the future. Our UK benefits include:


  • A valuable pension scheme of up to 18% (13% made up of employer contributions and 5% employee contributions).
  • Access to our Share Save and Share Incentive Plan, alongside financial wellbeing and support services to help give you real confidence to put your money to work.
  • Enjoy 38 days annual leave (including bank holidays), with the opportunity to purchase up to five extra days. Our Time Off When You Need It policy gives you the flexibility - to balance work and personal commitments.

What you’ll work on:

  • Owning day-to-day coverage of Circle’s unmanaged country portfolio, ensuring priority markets continue to move forward even without dedicated in-country leadership.

  • Identifying and prioritizing the highest-potential countries, clients, and opportunities across the unmanaged portfolio, and ensuring they are routed to the right business and functional owners.

  • Rolling out light-touch, repeatable market motions across unmanaged countries, including client prioritization, market-entry planning, and agentic / AI-enabled execution tools.

  • Acting as the central coordinator for unmanaged-country execution across business, legal, compliance, policy, product, marketing, and operations.

  • Supporting one-off strategic projects such as launching a new country, building a business plan, pressure-testing a GTM model, preparing a market for future managed coverage, or coordinating response to new in-market opportunities.

  • Developing practical country-level views for unmanaged markets, including key metrics, regulatory posture, major client opportunities, and required next steps.

What you’ll bring to Circle:

Core Requirements:

  • 12+ years of experience in business development, growth, market expansion, strategy, program leadership, or general management.

  • Proven experience operating across multiple countries or markets with differing regulatory, commercial, and operational conditions.

  • Strong commercial instincts with a bias toward action, execution, and measurable outcomes.

  • Ability to quickly assess markets, identify the highest-value opportunities, and translate ambiguity into a practical action plan.

  • Experience working cross-functionally across Sales, BD, Product, Marketing, Policy, Legal, Compliance, and Operations.

  • Strong understanding of crypto markets, stablecoins, payments, financial infrastructure, or institutional financial flows.

  • Ability to operate independently across a broad portfolio while maintaining strong judgment on prioritization and escalation.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex market situations into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with generative AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) and prompt development.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience building or scaling international expansion programs, frontier-market motions, or multi-country growth portfolios.

  • Track record of creating repeatable operating playbooks, lightweight GTM structures, or market-entry frameworks.

  • Experience using data, automation, or AI-enabled workflows to improve execution across distributed markets.

  • Strong cultural fluency and experience working across distributed, cross-border teams.

  • Experience/familiarity with Slack, Apple MacOS, and GSuite.
