title: TSF Supervisor
description:
Position Description

Job Title: TSF Supervisor

Department: Engineering

Reports To: Capital Project Foreman

The TSF Supervisor is Responsible for the Global Industry Standard of Tailings Management (TMS) site standards and industry best practices.

Join our exceptional team and embody Barrick's core values as you work with us. We are in search of individuals who can champion Barrick's DNA by:

  • Communicating Honestly, Transparently, and Acting with Integrity

  • Exhibiting a Results-Driven approach

  • Delivering solutions that are Fit for Purpose

  • Dedicating themselves to Building a Sustainable Legacy

  • Taking Responsibility and being Accountable

  • Committing to Zero Harm

  • Cultivating strong and meaningful Partnerships

If you're ready to contribute to our world-class team while embracing these values, we encourage you to apply and become a valued member of our diverse workforce.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensures compliance to All Barrick’s policies and procedures

  • Coordinates all efforts through the Accountable Executive for an aligned approach to tailings governance for the Operator.

  • Implementing the Tailing Management Standard (TMS) (Section 2.3).

  • Establishing the input from appropriate personnel, a budget for approval by the Accountable

  • Executive or persons with delegated budget authority.

  • With input from the Accountable Executive or persons with delegated responsibility, establish an organizational structure with roles and responsibilities that meets the operational needs.

  • Establish a formal relationship with the EOR and Design Team to ensure that construction and

  • operation meet the design intent and are compliant with legal requirements (Sections 3.4, 3.5 and 3.6).

  • Ensure surveillance is undertaken in accordance with design intent, performance objectives and the risk management plan (Section 2.4).

  • Ensure the development of the tailings facility closure plan, implementation of progressive reclamation as practicable during the Operations phase, and implementation of the closure plan at the end of the Operations phase (Section 3.7).

  • Maintain records related to design, construction and OMS (Section 2.5).

  • Ensure inspections (eg dam safety inspections or DSRs) are completed (Section 2.6).

  • Review and update the OMS manual (Section 2.4).

  • Ensure that emergency response plans are developed, maintained and tested, either as stand-alone plans or as components of sitewide emergency response plans directly related to tailings management (Section 2.7).

  • Implement measures to remedy variances from performance objectives or criteria (Section 3.5, 3.6 and 3.7).

  • Implement a programme for reviewing tailings safety, including Independent Review (Section 2.6).

  • Identify when/where contemplated operational changes are a potential deviation from the design intent and engage the EOR or Design Team as part of the process to manage change (Sections 2.3, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6 and 3.7).

  • Participate in or provide input to community engagement activities related to tailings management (Section 2.2.5).

  • Review and update documentation on operation and design of dam.

  • Search for improved efficiency in the civil earthworks undertaken on the dam.

  • Monitor the results of the Vibrating Wire Piezometers installed on the dam

  • Demonstrate a high concern for health and safety

Qualification Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil or Geotechnical Engineering

  • Strong understanding of soil structural characteristics and methods of testing compaction and consolidation.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum 3+ years’ experience in a Civil Engineer role within the mining industry

  • Prior experience in tailings dam project engineering desirable added advantage

What We Can Offer You:

  • A comprehensive compensation package including bonuses and site-specific benefits

  • The ability to make a difference and lasting impact

  • Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team

  • Opportunities to grow and learn with industry colleagues

  • Access to a variety of career opportunities across the organization

  • Performing tasks under minimal supervision and monitoring

  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.

  • Demonstrate high working ethics and conduct at all time.

  • Committed and engaged employees who are enthusiastic and passionate about Barrick and carry the company DNA.

How to apply:

  • Applicants are invited to submit their CV’s/Resumes online.

Please forward applications before 13th August 2026

Zero Tolerance for Corruption: Barrick has a strict zero-tolerance approach to bribery, fraud, and corruption. Any attempt by a candidate to influence the recruitment process through bribery, illegal inducements, or offering gifts/favors to staff will result in the immediate disqualification of their application and may lead to legal action.

We are committed to a safe work environment, sending every person home safe and healthy every day and leaving a sustainable legacy on our host communities.

Thank you for your application; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

standards

title: Program Manager, AMZL Launch & Expansion
description:
Our Program Manager's are always thinking about the bigger picture. Every position at Amazon offers the opportunity for employees to influence business decisions and shape the future. But as a Senior Program Manager, pioneering new ways of thinking, designing and delivering is your mission. Collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders across the business, you’ll continuously be scoping out new solutions. You’ll conduct your own research and analysis, always with an eye on the long-term vision of the business. This is your opportunity to have a big impact on some of the most exciting new ideas that are shaping the future of Amazon.



Key job responsibilities
- Create innovative solutions using data and research to address wider challenges in your organization
- Take a big-picture approach in your analysis of business operations, driving improvements across a range of teams and organizations
- Work alongside senior leadership to establish and prioritize improvement programs, seeing them through from start to finish
- Enhance operational performance on every program in partnership with your stakeholders


A day in the life
As a Program Manager, you’ll drive and manage the implementation of creative, data-driven change in Amazon, leading improvement projects and programs. You’ll use strategic thinking to define and implement an efficient project plan. Some managers are based on-site while others work remotely, depending on the most suitable option for their team and tasks.

Program Managers have significant responsibilities, and you’ll deal with complex challenges with creativity, innovation, and leadership. With a responsibility extending beyond process improvements, you could also contribute to improving other areas of the business, like diversity, equity, and inclusion.

About the team
When you click on your screen, and know that your Amazon parcel will arrive with you on the next day, you’ve just use one of the world’s most sophisticated fulfillment networks. At AMZL Europe, we deliver millions of packages daily to customers at record speed and quality. The work that Launch and Expansion do is at the heart of that. Our relentless ambition is to make AMZL Europe more and more cost-effective and customer centric. We’re doing that by improving our existing network, inventing new and creative ways of making last-mile delivery more efficient, and optimizing the development of our Under the Roof and On Road Infrastructure. Within the team we have a variety of roles. Typical examples include program managers responsible for selecting and launching new sites, planners working out how we solve challenges such as low emission zones and EV charging, strategy teams looking at how we get the most out of our existing buildings, and analysts using data to deliver insights into how we work and how we should be working.

Help plan the future of the biggest last mile delivery network in Europe
Select, build and launch huge buildings and infrastructure with multi-million dollar budgets
Make decisions that shape Amazon’s fulfillment strategy across the globe
Work at the forefront of logistics innovation

title: Clinical R programmer Consultant
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Clinical R Programmer Consultant based in United States.

The Clinical R Programmer Consultant will support innovative clinical development programs by delivering high-quality programming solutions for clinical trial data and regulatory submissions.
This role focuses on developing and validating clinical datasets using R while ensuring compliance with industry standards.
The consultant will collaborate closely with biostatistics, data management, and clinical teams to support critical trial deliverables.
The position offers the opportunity to contribute to modern clinical programming workflows, automation initiatives, and reproducible reporting practices.
The ideal candidate combines technical expertise in R with strong knowledge of clinical data standards and regulatory expectations.
This is an opportunity to work in a collaborative environment while supporting impactful healthcare and life sciences projects.

Accountabilities:

The Clinical R Programmer Consultant will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining clinical programming deliverables that support clinical trials and regulatory requirements. The role requires strong technical execution, attention to quality, and collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Develop, validate, and maintain SDTM and ADaM datasets using R while following CDISC standards and clinical programming best practices.
  • Create and maintain efficient, reproducible R scripts for clinical data analysis, reporting, and automation workflows.
  • Support the generation of tables, listings, and figures (TLFs) using R and SAS when required.
  • Collaborate with statisticians, clinical data managers, and cross-functional teams to understand programming requirements and deliver high-quality outputs.
  • Perform quality control checks, investigate data discrepancies, and ensure programming deliverables meet regulatory expectations.
  • Support clinical trial programming activities, documentation, and version control processes.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of R-based programming pipelines and automation solutions.
  • Apply knowledge of regulatory standards, including FDA and EMA expectations, to ensure compliant clinical data outputs.
  • Utilize SAS programming capabilities to support legacy studies and additional programming needs.
  • Promote reproducible programming practices through structured workflows, documentation, and efficient code development.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate will have experience in clinical programming with strong R expertise and a solid understanding of clinical trial data standards. This role requires analytical ability, technical proficiency, and the ability to work effectively with scientific and operational teams.

    • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Life Sciences, or a related technical field.
    • 2+ years of experience in clinical programming, with a strong focus on R-based development.
    • Demonstrated experience creating SDTM and ADaM datasets using R.
    • Working knowledge of SAS programming in a clinical research environment.
    • Strong understanding of CDISC standards, including SDTM and ADaM.
    • Experience supporting clinical trial data, regulatory submissions, and quality control processes.

title: Principal Solution Architect, Enterprise API Platform
description:
Principal Solution Architect, Enterprise API Platform

Position Overview:

The Principal Solution Architect, Enterprise API Platform, is responsible for defining, scaling, and governing enterprise-wide or business solution architecture across platforms, domains, and delivery teams. This role shapes how technology solutions are designed, integrated, secured, and operated consistently across the organization. While architecture is foundational, the Principal Solution Architect will be responsible for designing solutions in close collaboration with the business and technology stakeholders. Where applicable, the role will be accountable to build solutions that scale and algin to business and technology requirements.

Operating at an enterprise or portfolio level, the Principal Solution Architect focuses less on individual solution delivery and more on establishing architecture patterns, standards, guardrails and building solutions that enable teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, and secure solutions at speed.

This role operates within a federated Enterprise Architecture (EA) model, partnering closely with business technology and platform teams to shape solutions in real time while improving accountability, speed, and delivery alignment. The architect remains connected to the central EA core through enterprise standards, governance, communities of practice, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure consistent, risk-aware technology decisions across domains.

This role partners closely with Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Product, Cybersecurity, and Platform teams to ensure solutions align to business strategy, are resilient and compliant, and can scale across multiple use cases—without becoming a bottleneck to delivery.

For the Enterprise API Platform, this role serves as the strategic and technical architecture partner to the Head of Enterprise API Platform, helping translate API modernization and transformation objectives into practical, value-generating modernization decisions, reusable architecture patterns, MCP-enabled platform direction, and executable engineering outcomes.

You Will (Key Responsibilities):

  • Own and shape enterprise or business solution architecture strategy, standards, and patterns across multiple platforms and domains
  • Define and maintain reference architectures and reusable design patterns (“golden paths”) for solution delivery
  • Establish architectural guardrails that enable scalable, secure, and consistent solution design across teams
  • Owns reusable solution patterns, reference architectures, golden paths, and cross-team design consistency
  • Work with Solution Architects to drive adoption; Head of Portfolio Architecture to tailor for BU context; Principal Enterprise Architect to align with enterprise standards
  • Lead enterprise-level or business-level design decisions for complex, high-impact initiatives that span multiple value streams or business units
  • Provide architectural oversight and guidance across portfolios, ensuring alignment to enterprise standards and long-term strategy
  • Drive early engagement on initiatives to identify cross-platform dependencies, systemic risks, and scalability constraints
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and platform teams to define build vs. buy guidance and integration patterns
  • Translate business and technology strategy into actionable architecture direction and solution designs
  • Partner with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to embed governance, security, and regulatory requirements into solution architecture
  • Define and promote best practices for operational resilience, scalability, performance, and maintainability
  • Escalate enterprise exceptions / non-standard patterns / enterprise-risk decisions
  • Influence and align stakeholders across engineering, product, and business leadership without direct authority
  • Mentor and coach architects and senior engineers to elevate architectural maturity across the organization
  • Represent solution architecture in enterprise forums, architecture review boards, and strategic technology discussions
  • Influences Value Stream leaders, Product managers, Product Owners and Tech Leads to align roadmaps, MVP scope, and technical trade-offs.
  • Where applicable, the role will be accountable to build solutions that scale and algin to business and technology requirements.
  • Available for production incidents with major impact to business operations
  • Balance strategic and tactical decisions across API modernization, API/MCP management, API lifecycle management, domain-aligned data models, reimplementation priorities, and AI-ready API capabilities.
  • Continuously evaluate now versus later, strategic versus tactical, reusable versus disposable, and modernization versus value delivery, ensuring meaningful outcomes through thin slices rather than broad, low-value transformation efforts.
  • Lead enterprise API architecture patterns, technical direction, and modernization alignment across API platform engineering, internal API delivery, external API delivery, and high-impact integration initiatives.
  • Drive API rationalization, reuse, and domain alignment by helping teams redesign APIs around business capability-based, domain-aligned data models and solve common problems once rather than repeatedly.
  • Guide reimplementation decisions for APIs coupled to non-performant or non-scalable data sources, balancing resiliency, scalability, maintainability, delivery urgency, and longer-term architectural direction.
  • Help shape Guardian’s API, MCP gateway, and context-layer strategy so APIs become trusted, discoverable, observable, and governed inputs into agentic AI, reusable business capabilities, and future AI-native experiences.
  • Serve as a critical daily and weekly architecture input to the Head of Enterprise API Platform, improving decision quality, decision velocity, modernization sequencing, and executive confidence in API transformation progress.
  • Translate complex API architecture decisions into business outcomes, helping senior technology and business leaders understand “what this means” in terms of value, risk, scalability, execution, AI enablement, and strategic platform direction.

Required Qualifications: You Have:

  • Deep experience designing and governing enterprise-scale solution architectures across multiple teams and domains
  • Experience modernizing API ecosystems, including API management platforms, API lifecycle platforms, gateway patterns, integration patterns, performance and scalability improvements, and domain-aligned API design.
  • Proven ability to define and drive adoption of architecture standards, frameworks, and reusable patterns
  • Strong understanding of modern technology ecosystems (application architectures, APIs and delivery, integration patterns, AI, cloud platforms, and data flows)
  • Experience balancing business priorities, technical trade-offs, and risk at an enterprise level
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels when needed
  • Strong experience influencing technical direction across distributed teams without direct reporting authority
  • Ability to bridge business and technology, translating strategy into clear architectural direction
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience working in regulated or risk-sensitive environments with strong awareness of governance and compliance needs
  • Track record of mentoring architects and engineers and elevating organizational capabilities
  • Experience collaborating within Agile / product-based delivery models.
  • Experience producing product-level and team-level technical design documentation.
  • Strong engineering background with the ability to operate as a credible technical partner to engineering leaders while also shaping enterprise-level API architecture strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance pragmatic delivery with disruptive architectural thinking, including sequencing modernization work around prioritized strategic initiatives, high-visibility outcomes, and critical high-transaction-volume integrations.
  • Strong understanding of MCP, agentic AI enablement, context-layer architecture, API observability, discoverability, governance, security, and the role of APIs as foundational inputs into AI-native enterprise capabilities.

Location:

  • Three days a week at a Guardian office in Holmdel, NJ< New York, NY or Bethlehem, PA.

$152,290.00 - $250,195.00

title: Associate Town Planner
description:
• WSP is looking for an experienced Town Planner to join our GCC team based in India to support town planning and consenting inputs on major and nationally significant infrastructure projects in the UK via the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, Planning Act 2008 and Transport and Works Act Order.

• The successful candidates will have demonstrable experience of working within multidisciplinary teams on major infrastructure projects.

• We work at all stages of the consenting process from early feasibility, application preparation and delivery of consents on a variety of projects across the rail, road, energy, water, and local government sectors.

• WSP employees the largest number of chartered town planners across the UK. We are leaders in securing consent for major infrastructure projects and have one of the largest teams of planning, land referencing, environmental and stakeholder engagement professionals specialising in consent applications across all types of infrastructure. Our key clients include National Grid as part of the Great Grid Partnership, National Gas as part of Project Union, Nuclear Waste Services, EET Fuels, Eni UK, SSE, Scottish Power Renewables, Severn Trent Water, Southern Water, United Utilities, Yorkshire Water, and many more.

• To find out more about our Infrastructure Planning business click on the following link and discover what awaits you at WSP: Infrastructure planning and consulting | WSP

• Be part of the Global Capability Centre (GCC) UK Infrastructure Planning team in India (Bengaluru / Noida), work in close collaboration with the UK Infrastructure Planning (IP) team, delivering high-profile projects for private and public sector clients across the UK.

• The selected candidate will contribute towards growing our Infrastructure Planning activities within our India-based team, working in close collaboration with colleagues in the UK to deliver high-quality, integrated outcomes.

• Provide consenting inputs on major infrastructure projects (DCOs, DNSs, TWAOs etc) and providing technical advice to clients and managing their consenting requirements as applicable. Co-ordinating the preparation and submission of consent applications which may include applications under the Town and Country Planning Acts, the Planning Act 2008 or other regimes (as listed above).

• Project management with effective budgetary control. Desk studies, research, data management and report writing. Leading and supporting business development activities, including the writing of technical components for bids and proposals. Explore various business opportunities.

Project Delivery

title: VP, Infrastructure & SDLC
description:
WHO WE ARE
At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide.
Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like.
Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays.

WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide.

Our Ambition: To build the world's most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like.

Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that's transforming the way the world pays.

ABOUT THE INFRA & SDLC TEAM

Trustly's SDLC & Infrastructure team shapes how every engineer at Trustly builds and ships software. The team owns the software development lifecycle globally — developer tooling, CI/CD, and incident management — and is leading Trustly's transformation toward an AI-optimized, developer-first engineering organization. The team also manages and optimizes the AWS infrastructure that everything runs on. As Trustly scales its engineering capacity and embraces AI-native ways of building, this team plays a pivotal role in making every engineer at Trustly faster and more effective.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As VP of SDLC & Infrastructure, you will own how Trustly builds and ships software in an AI-native world — the software development lifecycle, developer platform, and the cloud infrastructure beneath them — with a mandate to modernize, optimize, and AI-enable each. You'll lead a team of SDLC specialists, platform engineers, and infrastructure engineers, and you'll set the vision for developer productivity across the organization. This role is for an engineering leader who thinks deeply about how software gets built, operational excellence, and the future of software development.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own Trustly's AWS infrastructure strategy — driving cost optimization, architectural best practices, reliability, and scalability across a complex, globally distributed payment system.

  • Define and lead Trustly's AI-optimized SDLC — embedding AI-assisted coding, testing, code review, and deployment practices into the development lifecycle to increase engineering velocity and quality.

  • Own Trustly's incident management process — building a mature, blameless incident culture with clear escalation paths, effective runbooks, and rigorous post-mortem practices.

  • Build and lead the team responsible for developer tooling, CI/CD infrastructure, and internal platforms — creating a developer experience that makes Trustly engineers faster and less frustrated.

  • Drive infrastructure cost management and cloud optimization — establishing FinOps practices and ensuring Trustly's AWS spend is efficient and accountable.

  • Partner with Engineering leadership across teams to establish and enforce infrastructure standards, security practices, and architectural guardrails.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 15+ years of engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading infrastructure, platform, or DevOps teams in a high-scale cloud environment.

  • Deep AWS expertise — you understand the services, architecture patterns, and cost levers that matter for a complex, high-throughput financial services platform.

  • Strong perspective on AI-optimized development practices — you've already experimented with or implemented AI-assisted coding, testing, and deployment tooling and can articulate a clear vision for where this goes next.

  • Experienced incident commander — you've built incident response programs, led high-severity incident response in production, and driven meaningful improvements in MTTR and system reliability.

  • Developer experience advocate — you measure success by how fast and confidently engineers can ship, and you build the tools and processes that enable that.

  • Strong cross-functional leader — able to work across Product, Security, and Engineering to drive adoption of standards and practices without being a bottleneck.

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

Trustly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hr@trustly.com.

At Trustly, you’ll have the chance to solve meaningful challenges alongside some of the brightest minds in FinTech. Together, we’re shaping the future of payments in an environment that celebrates curiosity, collaboration, and innovation. You'll be challenged and empowered to grow, making a real impact every step of the way.
Our team is as diverse as the global footprint we serve, with colleagues across Silicon Valley, the U.S., Canada, Brazil, Europe, and beyond. At Trustly, we foster a workplace where everyone feels they belong—a place where teamwork thrives, ideas flourish, and we never forget to have fun along the way.

description:

Can you bridge the gap between how content performs and how decisions get made?

The Content Performance Analyst is embedded in Global Editorial Operations (GEO) Strategy and focuses on content performance, content integrity, and quality measurement for AI-assisted production. You will unlock data across GEO and adjacent functions (Finance, Product, and Technology) to produce decision-ready insights and executive-ready narratives that inform prioritization and leadership decisions. You will also help strengthen the QA and measurement systems required for AI-assisted content production at scale, ensuring outputs across all content verticals are consistently high-quality, defensible, and improving over time. This role serves as a key enabler of data fluency within GEO, supporting QA, training, and adoption of performance insights across the organization.

Success in this role requires strong analytical discipline, sound judgment, responsiveness, and the ability to synthesize information quickly for senior audiences.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage, structure, and validate data from multiple editorial and operational sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and governance compliance.

  • Develop and optimize recurring and ad hoc reporting processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

  • Translate strategic business questions into actionable metrics, analytical frameworks, and data-driven insights.

  • Conduct trend, variance, and performance analyses to identify key drivers, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

  • Create executive-ready dashboards, reports, and presentations that communicate complex findings in a clear and compelling way.

  • Monitor strategic KPIs, track initiative progress, and continuously refine performance metrics in line with evolving business priorities.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including Editorial Operations, Finance, Product, Technology, and Data Analytics, to gather insights and support decision-making.

  • Collaborate closely with the Head of GEO Strategy to prioritize analyses, align reporting with leadership needs, and support strategic planning.

Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in analytics, operations analysis, business intelligence, or a related field

  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with SQL or comparable querying tools

  • Proficiency with BI visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar) and dashboarding best practices

  • Experience building executive-ready presentations and visual narratives in PowerPoint

  • Uses AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis and drafting with rigorous QA and source traceability; comfort operating in an AI-enabled environment where processes evolve rapidly

  • Experience assessing or improving QA/measurement systems (including for AI-assisted workflows) using practical methods (sampling, rubrics, thresholds, error taxonomies)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting strategy or executive leadership functions

  • Exposure to content production, publishing, or knowledge-based businesses

  • Familiarity with KPI frameworks and operational performance measurement

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, and study assistance, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

title: Program Manager
description:
Title:

Program Manager

Program Manager

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

Why Join Us?

  • Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.

  • Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.

  • Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense.

Who You Are

KBR seeks a seasoned Program Manager who, with broad autonomy, will lead the administrative and operational facets of one or more government services projects determined customer needs and contractual obligations. This role demands a professional who has honed their skills over at least a decade in a management capacity, adept at navigating the complexities of project oversight and skilled at driving interdepartmental coordination to surpass review and approval benchmarks.

What You’ll Do

As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for all aspects of the deployment and management of contractor support personnel assigned to work on all Task Orders awarded under the IDIQ contract. You will be located in the DMV area and expected to be onsite 100% with occasional OCONUS travel.

The tasks include, but are not limited to:

  • Fully coordinate and collaborate on all tasks, activities, requirements and issues as they pertain to the support of the Customer

  • Identify issues and adapt program plans according to the Customer feedback on program cost, performance, quality, schedule and risk.

  • Develop plans and schedules, and define and document the implementation of requirements

  • Use established program management procedures to monitor cost, schedule, inventory, and performance; assess variances of the plan and take necessary corrective action.

The Staff Platform Architect, Data & AI will lead the evolution of enterprise data and AI platform architecture, ensuring reliability, scalability, governance, and usability across the organization. This role combines strategic technical leadership with hands-on design, prototyping, and collaboration to accelerate innovation.

  • Evolve existing batch processing, analytics, and MLOps platforms to improve reliability, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational performance.
  • Design and develop AI-ready data foundations, including semantic and ontology layers, governance tooling, lifecycle management, and catalog integration.
  • Build usage infrastructure such as APIs, libraries, and services that enable secure access to data capabilities for internal teams, external products, and AI agents.
  • Develop permission-aware semantic discovery solutions that improve how users and intelligent systems interact with enterprise data assets.
  • Guide engineering teams in adopting effective architectural patterns through clear recommendations, reference designs, and technical collaboration.
  • Lead research, experimentation, and prototyping initiatives with product and engineering teams to validate emerging AI and analytics capabilities.
  • Define and promote best practices for platform architecture, system design, and AI/ML infrastructure development.
  • Mentor engineers across the organization by sharing expertise in architecture, first-principles thinking, and scalable platform development.
  • Influence technical decisions across teams by building alignment through collaboration and demonstrated expertise.
  • Support the ongoing evolution of shared platforms while balancing innovation, security, governance, and operational requirements.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience designing and operating enterprise-scale data platforms, AI/ML systems, and cloud-native infrastructure. Success in this role requires strong architectural judgment, technical depth, and the ability to influence teams through expertise rather than formal authority.

    • 10+ years of software engineering experience focused on data platforms, analytics infrastructure, and AI/ML systems at enterprise scale.
    • Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, engineering, technology, or a related technical field.
    • Proven experience building and operating MLOps platforms, including data access, feature engineering, model deployment, and monitoring.
    • Strong understanding of data modeling, schema design, data quality, and platform engineering principles.
    • Experience designing AI agent-based architectures for governed data access, semantic discovery, and enterprise data retrieval.
    • Experience creating federated catalog architectures that enable unified access across multiple platforms and data sources.
    • Knowledge of security, compliance, governance, data residency, and access control considerations for AI/ML workloads.
    • Experience with distributed computing, cloud-native infrastructure, and large-scale data workloads on public cloud platforms.
    • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code and managing production-grade systems.
    • Demonstrated ability to evolve shared platform architectures over time.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to drive architectural alignment across diverse engineering teams.
    • Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or other data-intensive environments is a plus.

title: Cyber Threat Mgmt - Sr Professional II
description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Cyber Threat Mgmt - Sr Professional II

About your role:

As a member of Fiserv’s Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT), you will support investigation and response activities for cybersecurity events across the global enterprise environment. You will focus on the preliminary identification, triage, and analysis of potential cyber security incidents and review suspicious emails, analyze logs, investigate network traffic and endpoint activity, and escalate confirmed incidents to Tier 2 incident handlers. You will be required to work in a shift which includes work on holidays, nights, & weekends.

What you will do:

  • Monitor and triage security alerts and events generated by enterprise security tools, escalating validated or high-risk activity in accordance with established playbooks and service level targets.
  • Perform initial investigation of suspicious activity across endpoint, network, identity, email, cloud, application, and system log sources.
  • Analyze and investigate data in the SIEM/SOAR that originated from EDR, firewall, proxy, intrusion detection/prevention, email security, and other monitoring platforms to determine severity, impact, and required response actions.
  • Document investigations, findings, actions taken, and escalation details in the case management system with clear, complete, and timely notes.
  • Follow shift handoff procedures and communicate open issues, emerging threats, and significant events to team members and incident handlers.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring false positives, process gaps, and opportunities to improve alert quality, runbooks, and analyst efficiency.
  • This position requires the ability to work a shift schedule and support coverage efforts on a 24x7x365 (follow-the-sun model) basis which includes work on holidays, nights, & weekends.

What you will need to have:

  • 1-2 years experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, security monitoring, IT operations, networking, or a related enterprise technology environment.
  • Ability to support a 24x7x365 operating model, including day, evening, weekend, or holiday shifts as assigned.
  • Foundational knowledge of network protocols, operating systems, enterprise architecture, and common log sources used in security investigations.
  • Basic understanding of incident response processes, alert triage, threat indicators, and cyber security attack techniques.
  • Ability to prioritize work, follow documented procedures, and make sound decisions in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to collaborate effectively as part of a cross-functional team in a fast-paced, high-impact operational environment.
  • Strong critical thinking skills, strong puzzle-solving ability and an investigative mindset to analyze complex activity, connect related indicators, and identify potential security incidents.
  • Bachelor’s degree in cyber security, information technology, computer science, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience may be considered.

What would be great to have:

  • Industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CEH, GCIH, or similar foundational cyber security certifications.
  • Experience with scripting or programming languages to support automation, analysis, or incident response activities.
  • Direct experience with security technologies such as SIEM/SOAR, EDR, IDS/IPS, email security, firewalls, proxy tools, or case management platforms is preferred.

How you’ll work

  • This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.

Travel

  • Approximately 10% travel off-site or to other office locations is expected.

title: Vulnerability Management Analyst
description:
• Manage and support enterprise vulnerability management activities across Windows Server and Windows workstation environments.
  • Perform regular vulnerability assessments using approved scanning tools (e.g., Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management).
  • Analyze vulnerability scan results, validate findings, and prioritize remediation activities based on risk, severity, and business impact.
  • Coordinate with infrastructure, server, desktop, application, and security teams to ensure timely remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
  • Track, monitor, and report vulnerability remediation progress against organizational SLAs and compliance requirements.
  • Lead monthly vulnerability review meetings and provide recommendations for risk reduction.
  • Investigate and resolve false positives, exception requests, and vulnerability-related operational issues.
  • Support security audits, regulatory compliance assessments, and internal governance requirements.
  • Develop remediation plans for critical and high-risk vulnerabilities affecting Windows operating systems and Microsoft technologies.
  • Work closely with SCCM/MECM, Intune, and Windows Operations teams to ensure effective patch deployment and compliance management.
  • Monitor emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and vendor advisories affecting Microsoft platforms.
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring vulnerabilities and recommend preventive controls.
  • Create and maintain vulnerability management procedures, remediation runbooks, and technical documentation.
  • Generate executive dashboards, compliance reports, remediation metrics, and risk-based reporting for leadership teams.
  • Support vulnerability remediation projects, security initiatives, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Participate in incident response activities related to security vulnerabilities, malware outbreaks, and zero-day threats.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience

  • 3-7 years of experience in Vulnerability Management, Windows Infrastructure, Cybersecurity Operations, or Endpoint Security.
  • Hands-on experience managing vulnerabilities in enterprise Windows Server and Windows desktop environments.
  • Experience working with vulnerability scanning and assessment tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
  • Experience coordinating remediation activities across multiple technology teams.
  • Strong understanding of patch management, security compliance, and risk management processes.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Windows Server and Windows 10/11 operating systems.
  • Experience with vulnerability assessment, risk prioritization, and remediation tracking.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Defender Vulnerability Management.
  • Experience with SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune, and Windows patch management processes.
  • Knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, Entra ID (Azure AD), DNS, DHCP, and Windows security configurations.
  • Understanding of CVSS scoring, Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE), and security risk assessment methodologies.
  • Experience reviewing security advisories from Microsoft and other vendors.
  • Familiarity with security hardening standards and frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks, NIST, and ISO 27001.
  • Basic scripting knowledge using PowerShell for automation, reporting, and remediation activities.
  • Understanding of endpoint security, malware protection, and vulnerability lifecycle management.

Preferred Qualifications

​​ Summary of Position:

​

​At Alcon, we aspire to lead the world in innovating life-changing vision products because when people see brilliantly, they live brilliantly. As a global leader in eye care, we believe in innovating especially through cutting edge technology. We are on a journey to offer the widest array of eye care and eye health offerings with products that can treat the entire eye at each stage of life.

​Our Digital Health team is harnessing technology to build a leading portfolio of digital health solutions that will transform the eye care experience for medical professionals to patients and enable improved patient outcomes – from a predictive health care delivery platform harnessing ML and analytics to innovative medical device software.

​

​As Principal Data Scientist – Digital Health, you will be responsible for applying expertise in AI/ML and advanced analytics to design and build analytics products and services in digital health, partnering with a cross-functional team of digital product managers, data engineers, and solution architects in an agile environment. In addition, you will collaborate with business partners to define and translate the business problems into structured analytic approaches and drive actionable insights from data to support digital product development and critical business decisions. We are a fast-growing team, which will give you the opportunity to shape our ways of working and culture - think start-up, but inside a global leader in eye care. We are looking for someone who is a strategic thinker and problem solver.

​​

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop and operationalize reusable and modular data analytics products on Alcon digital health data platform.

  • Collaborate with data product team to define requirements for data pipelines, products and analytics use cases.

  • Collaborate with data engineering team to build data products and analytic use cases.

  • Partner with business stakeholders to define business problems, and design and build advanced analysis and ML models that drive actionable insights from data to support business decisions

  • Advocate and educate on the value of data-driven decision-making, with a focus on solving problems

  • Stay updated with AI/ML innovations and best practices and continue driving improvements of our analytics capabilities.

  • Foster a culture of creativity, collaboration, speed, innovation, and engineering excellence.

  • Coach and mentor junior data scientists and data analysts.

Key Requirements/Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or above in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field).

  • ​Hands-on experience with GenAI application development, including Chatbots and AI agents using both unstructured and structured data.

​Preferred Qualifications:

title: LR_Coordinator - Expat Permit Management (370448)
description:

2.2. Highlight urgent cases that require immediate action.

2.4. KPI Reporting:
2.4.1. Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as permit processing time, compliance rate, and renewal efficiency.
2.4.2. Develop dashboards in Excel for real-time monitoring of expatriate permit metrics.

3. Compliance & Regulatory Adherence
3.1. Ensure all expatriate employment documentation complies with local labor and immigration laws.
3.2. Conduct internal audits of expatriate files to confirm compliance with legal requirements.
3.3. Assist in resolving compliance-related issues with government authorities.

4.2. Coordinate with expatriates on document submissions, medical clearances, and other prerequisites for permits.

Skilled in maintaining accurate, up-to-date records of expatriate permits, visas, and legal documents.

title: Weekend Sign Installer - Dover, DE
description:
Artisan Direct is seeking an independent contractor to place and pick up temporary weekend signs in the Dover, DE area in the community Brookfield.

The contractor will be responsible for installing signs between Friday at 5:00 PM and Saturday at 10:00 AM. The same signs must be picked up between Sunday at 6:00 PM and Monday at 8:00 AM. The work may be performed at any time within those windows, as long as all signs are placed by Saturday at 10:00 AM and removed by Monday at 8:00 AM.

The signs are lightweight corrugated plastic, and are installed on wooden stakes. Artisan Direct provides the signs and stakes and provides replacement inventory as needed.

Job Duties:

  • Use Artisan Direct's mobile application to report installation and pickup of signs at specific locations
  • Install signs every weekend between Friday 5 PM and Saturday 10 AM
  • Pickup the same signs between Sunday 6 PM and Monday 8 AM
  • Store signs and extra stakes safely during the week
  • Submit a weekly invoice and order replacement inventory after completing pick up- using our website
Pay Information:
  • Starting compensation is $88 per weekend
  • Pay is issued via direct deposit every two weeks
  • $20.00 Signing bonus
  • $100.00 bonus after 4 weeks of completed work

Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license and current auto insurance
  • 18+ years old
  • Reliable vehicle with enough space to transport 30+ signs
  • A smartphone (Android or iPhone), roughly four years old or newer, capable of running our mobile app
  • Ability to lift and place signs and work outdoors
  • Ability to hammer stakes 6–8 inches into the ground during the first weekend only
  • Dependable and able to complete routes within the required time windows each weekend

Independent Contractor Notice

This is a 1099 independent contractor position. Contractors are not employees of Artisan Direct and are responsible for their own fuel, expenses, taxes and insurance. Contractors determine their own driving order, provide their own vehicle and mobile device, and complete the work within the placement and pickup windows provided. No benefits, minimum hours, or employment guarantees are offered. Contractors may accept or decline routes but must complete any route they commit to.

Additional Information

The starting pay is for the current work available in this location. As more work comes available our contractor support team will offer additional work to increase earnings. This role is a great fit for delivery and rideshare drivers, couriers, retirees, veterans, or anyone looking for flexible supplemental income. The work is straightforward, independent, and recurring each weekend. Contractors who enjoy driving, being outdoors, and working solo tend to enjoy this role and find it a dependable way to earn extra income on their own schedule.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About the Role

As a Data Analyst at NOV Downhole Broadband Solutions, you will serve as the primary technical and analytical support for our real-time and memory-based drilling services. Acting as a key focal point across up to three rigs at a time, you will monitor operations, interpret complex downhole datasets, and provide timely recommendations that enhance drilling performance, manage risk, and protect wellbore integrity.

You will support Project Managers as an in-house drilling advisor, own critical analytical workflows (from optimization reporting to post-well reviews), and act as a technical escalation point for both internal teams and clients. This role combines deep drilling domain knowledge with strong analytical skills and offers the opportunity to contribute directly to new software solutions, advanced tools, and industry-leading technical publications.

About the Company

NOV Downhole Broadband Solutions is a business group within the NOV Energy Products and Services segment, specializing in drilling automation and optimization through the use of real-time downhole data. By deploying Wired Drill Pipe (WDP) technology and Along-String Measurement (ASM) tools, we enable the transmission of high-density, low-latency data from downhole systems to surface teams. This includes key metrics such as temperature, pressure, rotation, and vibration data, which contribute to smarter, safer, and more efficient drilling operations. As demand grows, we continue to expand our operations and analytics teams to drive innovation and excellence for our customers.

What We Offer

Joining National Oilwell Varco means becoming part of a dynamic, international team committed to delivering outstanding results. We provide:

  • Challenging Assignments: Work on complex, high-impact drilling and well construction projects where advanced analytics directly influence operational decisions.
  • Career Development: Access strong technical career paths, mentoring, and opportunities to grow as a Data Analyst across drilling dynamics, data analytics, and digital solutions.
  • Collaborative Atmosphere: Thrive in an open and informal work environment where teamwork, innovation, and personal responsibility are valued.
  • Global Exposure: Collaborate with world-class clients, internal experts, and third-party partners on regional and global projects.

At NOV, your contributions make a difference. We look forward to welcoming motivated individuals ready to take their careers to the next level.

Why Join Our Global Family

We are a purpose-driven company on a mission to empower the global energy industry. At NOV, we foster a culture of inclusion where every employee is valued for their unique background, experiences, and perspectives. We believe in recognizing talent and providing opportunities for growth, and we are committed to making a positive impact on the communities where we live and work.

If you are passionate about drilling data, optimization, and technical excellence—and want your work to directly shape safer, more efficient operations for our customers—we would be excited to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the main focal point for technical and analytical support across assigned rigs.
  • Provide daily technical oversight for real-time operations and tool performance.
  • Generate optimization reports with key events, mitigations, and recommendations.
  • Deliver operational intervention support on drilling dynamics, pressure management, and wellbore integrity.
  • Conduct BHA and operational design reviews, trajectory advice, and scope-of-work reviews.
  • Perform detailed performance and failure analysis using high-frequency memory data.
  • Support field testing and rollout of new tools, software, and technical changes.
  • Own the peer review process for technical service delivery and reporting.
  • Develop and deliver internal and customer technical training; mentor senior operations staff.
  • Collaborate with client engineering and subsurface teams and contribute to technical publications.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Degree in Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • Preferably 3-5 years’ experience in drilling operations, including significant exposure to DD/LWD and drilling optimization, or equivalent combination of field and analytical experience.
  • Strong expertise in drilling dynamics, BHA design, trajectory management, and well integrity concepts.
  • Demonstrated experience in performance analysis, high-frequency data interpretation, and failure investigation.
  • Proven ability to translate complex datasets into clear operational recommendations and client-ready reports.
  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams (operations, subsurface, engineering, quality, and software).
  • Comfortable presenting technical findings to internal stakeholders, clients, and at industry forums; experience authoring technical papers is an advantage.
  • Proficient in standard data analysis and visualization tools; experience with advanced analytics, scripting, or programming languages is a plus.
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal; additional languages are an asset.

title: Sr Analyst
description:
Description:

Will be responsible to Lead Collections Operations for recovery of outstanding debts and payments of American Express Cards in Delhi and North India out locations markets by managing the outside agency partner network.
They will be leading outside agency collection teams, develop strategies to maximize recovery rates, minimize delinquencies, and ensure compliance with regulatory and legal standards

Further provide feedback to management to improve strategy and governance customized to the local market of operation.

The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of banking/NBFC regulations, excellent legal literacy, and exceptional negotiation skills to secure overdue payments ethically.

  • Strategy Development: Design and implement highly effective collection procedures to improve recoveries and reduce delinquencies.

title: Director, Digital Solution Architecture
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

The Director, Digital Solution Architecture is a strategic technology leadership role responsible for defining and governing the future-state architecture of the organization's global commercial technology ecosystem. This individual will serve as the principal architecture leader for CRM, omnichannel engagement, customer experience, digital enablement, and commercial data integration platforms supporting Commercial, Medical Affairs, Marketing, and Customer Engagement functions worldwide.

As a trusted advisor to IT and business leadership, the Director will drive technology strategy, influence investment decisions, evaluate emerging industry trends, and establish scalable architecture frameworks that accelerate business growth and digital transformation. This role requires a unique blend of deep Life Sciences expertise, commercial and medical technology leadership, architectural excellence, stakeholder influence, and organizational change leadership.

The successful candidate will possess extensive experience across Life Sciences CRM platforms, omnichannel ecosystems, customer engagement technologies, and enterprise integrations while demonstrating the ability to align diverse stakeholders, manage competing strategic priorities, and translate complex business challenges into innovative technology solutions.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Strategic Technology Leadership

  • Define and own the long-term architecture vision, technology roadmap, and target-state capabilities for the global commercial technology ecosystem.
  • Partner with Commercial, Medical, Marketing, Data & Analytics, and IT leaders to align technology investments with strategic business objectives.
  • Serve as the technology advisor for CRM modernization, omnichannel transformation, customer engagement innovation, and digital enablement initiatives.
  • Influence enterprise technology strategy and investment planning through architecture-driven decision-making and business case development.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, market trends, and industry innovations to identify opportunities that improve customer engagement, operational effectiveness, and business outcomes.

Commercial Technology & Omnichannel Strategy

  • Establish architecture standards and strategic direction for CRM, omnichannel engagement, digital marketing, customer experience, and field force enablement platforms.
  • Lead architecture decisions across critical commercial technology investments including CRM, content management, customer data platforms, identity and consent management, digital engagement, analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Drive the evolution of customer engagement models by integrating field, digital, medical, and marketing channels into a unified omnichannel ecosystem.
  • Ensure solutions support evolving commercial models and future industry requirements.

Enterprise Architecture & Integration Leadership

  • Govern architecture across a complex ecosystem of enterprise platforms, integrations, data services, and customer engagement technologies.
  • Define enterprise integration strategies and architecture patterns that support scalability, interoperability, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technology assessments, vendor evaluations, and platform selection initiatives.
  • Ensure all solutions adhere to enterprise standards for security, compliance, data governance, performance, and maintainability.

Executive Stakeholder Management & Influence

  • Build strong partnerships with stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
  • Facilitate alignment among senior leaders with competing priorities and differing perspectives.
  • Lead architecture governance forums, steering committees, and executive decision-making processes.
  • Present strategic recommendations, architecture roadmaps, investment options, and risk assessments to senior leadership and executive committees.
  • Drive organizational alignment around technology modernization and transformation initiatives.

Innovation & Transformation Leadership

  • Champion innovation across the commercial technology landscape, leveraging emerging capabilities including AI, advanced analytics, automation, and next-generation customer engagement platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify technology landscapes, reduce technical debt, and improve speed-to-market.
  • Lead strategic transformation initiatives supporting CRM modernization, digital engagement, and commercial platform evolution.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and architectural excellence.

Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Provide leadership and mentorship to developers, technology leaders, and delivery teams.
  • Establish architecture best practices, governance models, and technology standards across the organization.
  • Build organizational capabilities to support evolving business needs and future technology requirements.
  • Influence and guide cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority when necessary.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • May have direct people management responsibilities, including hiring, performance management, and development of architecture, omnichannel enablement, or CRM resources.
  • Provides strategic and operational leadership to platform teams, data and analytics partners, and cross-functional contributors supporting omnichannelcapabilities.
  • Oversee vendor and system integrator resources supporting CRM, marketing automation, omnichannel enablement, data warehouse, among others.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience with at least 10 years supporting Life Sciences commercial organizations.
  • Proven experience leading enterprise architecture, solution architecture, or digital transformation initiatives at a Director level.
  • Extensive experience supporting Commercial, Sales, Medical Affairs, Marketing, and Customer Engagement functions within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or Life Sciences organizations.
  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale CRM modernization, omnichannel transformation, and enterprise platform initiatives.
  • Deep understanding of Life Sciences commercial and medical business processes, customer engagement models, and regulatory considerations.
  • Expertise in CRM platforms including Veeva CRM, Veeva Vault CRM, Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Salesforce Sales Cloud, Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Data Cloud, digital integration tools, and associated commercial technology ecosystems.
  • Strong knowledge of omnichannel engagement, digital marketing, customer data platforms, content management, consent management, medical/MedInfo, and commercial analytics solutions.
  • Experience architecting complex enterprise integrations across CRM, ERP, Data & Analytics, Marketing Automation, Customer Experience, Data Warehouse, Data Lakes, and Content Management platforms.
  • Understanding of emerging technologies including AI, machine learning, customer intelligence, and digital engagement capabilities.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Executive presence with the ability to influence senior business and technology leaders.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and consensus-building capabilities.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority strategic initiatives simultaneously.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technology investments to measurable business outcomes.
  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and executive storytelling skills.
  • Ability to lead through influence in highly matrixed global organizations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • TOGAF, Salesforce, Veeva, or other relevant architecture certifications.
  • Experience supporting global commercial operations across multiple regions and markets.
  • Experience leading technology evaluations and platform selection initiatives for next-generation CRM and customer engagement solutions.

Success Measures:

  • Establishment of a scalable, future-ready commercial technology architecture.
  • Successful execution of CRM modernization and omnichannel transformation initiatives.
  • Increased alignment between business strategy and technology investments.
  • Accelerated delivery of innovative customer engagement capabilities.
  • Improved stakeholder satisfaction and executive confidence in technology decision-making.
  • Reduction in platform complexity, technical debt, and integration challenges.
  • Measurable business value realization from strategic technology investments.

Travel:

  • Minimal to moderate travel required.
  • Estimated 10–20%, primarily for key planning sessions, vendor engagements, or major platform milestones.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

title: Technology Advisory Analyst
description:
The Technology Advisory Analyst serves as the fundamental pillar of AI-native advisory teams, empowering clients to navigate the critical junction of strategy and technical execution.

Collaborating with senior leadership and technical specialists, you will anchor the delivery process by framing challenges, validating hypotheses, and quantifying trade-offs to produce deliverables that are truly decision-ready for the executive level.

By blending top-tier consulting rigor with an AI-native workflow, you enable senior teams to perform with unprecedented speed and depth, ensuring every strategic insight is backed by robust evidence and structural accuracy.

This role transcends traditional requirements documentation; you are the engine of execution that translates high-level strategic intent into measurable, high-impact business outcomes.

What You'll Do

1. Drive Research and Analysis

Perform core advisory and consulting activities including:

  • Industry and market research
  • Technology landscape assessments
  • Business process analysis
  • Data analysis and interpretation
  • Competitive benchmarking
  • Opportunity identification

Leverage AI-enabled tools to accelerate research and analysis while maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy.

2. Translate Business Problems into Actionable Insights

Work with clients and engagement teams to:

  • Understand business objectives and challenges
  • Gather and synthesize qualitative and quantitative information
  • Structure complex problems into manageable workstreams
  • Identify patterns, risks, opportunities, and trade-offs
  • Develop evidence-based recommendations

3. Support Client Engagements

Contribute to client-facing advisory work by:

  • Preparing executive-ready presentations and deliverables
  • Facilitating workshops and discovery sessions
  • Documenting business and technology requirements
  • Supporting strategic assessments and roadmap development
  • Helping clients evaluate technology options and transformation opportunities

4. Apply AI to Enhance Delivery

Use AI responsibly to improve the speed and quality of advisory work by:

  • Accelerating research and information synthesis
  • Supporting analysis and content development
  • Developing repeatable prompts and workflows
  • Validating AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevance
  • Continuously improving how advisory work is delivered

5. Ensure Quality and Delivery Excellence

Review work products to ensure they are:

  • Accurate
  • Well-structured
  • Insightful
  • Client-ready
  • Supported by evidence

Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and risks before deliverables are shared with clients.

6. Contribute to Continuous Improvement

Help strengthen the Technology Advisory practice by:

  • Capturing reusable frameworks, templates, and methodologies
  • Sharing lessons learned across engagements
  • Improving research approaches and analytical methods
  • Contributing to internal knowledge assets and AI-enabled delivery practices

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  • Delivering high-quality analysis that enables better client decisions
  • Producing clear, structured, and actionable deliverables
  • Using AI effectively to increase team productivity without compromising quality
  • Supporting Technology Advisory engagements that deliver measurable client value
  • Building reusable knowledge and practices that improve future engagements

Who You Are

Experience

Typically 2–6 years of experience in one or more of the following:

  • Management or technology consulting
  • Business analysis
  • Technology strategy
  • Product or digital transformation
  • Data, research, or analytics

Experience working on technology-enabled business initiatives is highly valued.

Capabilities

Business & Technology Analysis

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Ability to connect business needs with technology solutions
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and complex problems

Structured Problem Solving

  • Breaks down complex challenges into logical components
  • Synthesizes information into clear recommendations
  • Thinks strategically while remaining detail-oriented

Communication

  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Creates executive-ready presentations and documentation
  • Able to explain technical concepts to business stakeholders

AI-Enabled Ways of Working

  • Comfortable using AI tools to enhance research, analysis, and content creation
  • Understands how to validate AI-generated outputs
  • Continuously explores new ways to improve productivity through AI

Collaboration

  • Works effectively across multidisciplinary teams
  • Partners closely with Technology Advisors, architects, designers, engineers, and client stakeholders
  • Builds trusted relationships with clients and colleagues

What Makes This Role Different

Technology Advisory Analysts help clients navigate strategic technology decisions by combining analytical rigor, business understanding, and modern AI-enabled delivery practices.

Rather than simply documenting requirements, you help shape strategic recommendations, uncover insights, and accelerate advisory engagements. By combining consulting fundamentals with AI-powered ways of working, you enable teams to deliver deeper analysis, faster execution, and greater value for clients.

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a global technology consultancy that integrates strategy, design and engineering to drive digital innovation. For 30+ years, our clients have trusted our autonomous teams to build solutions that look past the obvious. Here, computer science grads come together with seasoned technologists, self-taught developers, midlife career changers and more to learn from and challenge each other. Career journeys flourish with the strength of our cultivation culture, which has won numerous awards around the world.

Join Thoughtworks and thrive. Together, our extra curiosity, innovation, passion and dedication overcomes ordinary.

title: Data Solutions Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

The Digital Transformation and Data Intelligence team is looking for a Data Solutions Engineer. This role will build scalable data products, automation, and AI-enabled solutions that improve how CAO teams operate.

This individual contributor role requires deep data engineering expertise and strong product thinking. The candidate can turn ambiguous business problems into practical, production-ready solutions. The foundation of the role is data engineering, but the scope extends into APIs, automation workflows, AI-enabled capabilities, and lightweight applications that help teams make better decisions, reduce manual work, and unlock value from data.

You will partner with business collaborators, analysts, program leaders, architects, and engineers to translate business needs into scalable solutions. You will also help improve the team’s engineering standards and encourage adoption of modern development practices.

What you'll Do
