title: Demand Gen Marketer
description:
About your role 👀

As a Demand Gen Marketer at Pogo, you'll own B2B paid acquisition for a narrow, high-value audience - across digital, out-of-home, and unconventional channels.

Specifically, you will:

  • Run B2B paid acquisition across paid social (LinkedIn, Meta), out-of-home (billboards, direct mail), and other B2B channels

  • Get creative with targeting - geo-targeted campaigns around industry events, hyper-targeted ads by company and title, timing-based plays that reach the right person at the right moment

  • Contribute to channel and budget strategy alongside the team - work together to figure out what to test, scale, and cut

  • Apply analytical rigor to every spend decision - CAC, ROAS, pipeline contribution, attribution

  • Partner with marketing, sales, and design on landing pages, ad creative, and full-funnel optimization

  • Test, iterate, and scale what works

About you 👩‍🚀

  • Likely 3–6 years of B2B paid acquisition experience at a SaaS company with meaningful paid spend. You've owned real budget, not a small line item.

  • You've run multiple paid channels. LinkedIn, Meta, and beyond - you know how to make them work.

  • You back every spend decision with data. CAC, ROAS, pipeline contribution, attribution - you have the rigor to defend your calls.

  • You've worked at a fast-growing organization with real ownership. You don't need to be told what to do.

  • Bonus: experience with AI tools in marketing workflows; out-of-home, billboard, or direct mail experience; experience marketing to data/insights buyers, market researchers, or brand teams.

Why you might be excited about this opportunity 🙌

  • Own B2B paid acquisition across multiple channels. You’ll run and shape paid strategy across digital and offline channels - from LinkedIn and Meta to billboards and direct mail - with real ownership over budget and performance.

  • Work on a product with strong market pull. You’ll help scale a product that already has growing enterprise demand, giving you the opportunity to optimize and accelerate something that customers genuinely want.

  • Blend strategy with execution. This role is not just campaign management. You’ll influence channel mix, budget allocation, landing pages, creative, positioning, and full-funnel conversion strategy alongside the broader GTM team.

  • Experiment beyond traditional B2B channels. We're excited about unconventional distribution and creative marketing ideas, especially across out-of-home, direct mail, and high-attention brand moments.

  • Solve a real targeting challenge. Our buyers are a specific, senior audience - you won't scale through volume alone. This role rewards creative, precision targeting over brute-force spend.

  • Join a highly analytical and product-minded team. We care deeply about measurement, iteration, and craft. You’ll work with people who think rigorously about growth and care about building excellent customer experiences.

Why you might not be excited about us 👎

  • This is not a pure “media buyer” role. We expect paid marketers to think beyond campaign execution - into positioning, landing pages, creative strategy, attribution, and pipeline impact.

  • We care deeply about efficiency and accountability. Every dollar spent is scrutinized through CAC, ROAS, attribution, and pipeline contribution. You need to enjoy operating with rigor and defending decisions with data.

  • Things change quickly. Budgets, channels, and priorities may shift rapidly based on performance and market feedback. We optimize aggressively and don’t get overly attached to past strategies.

  • You'll need to thrive with autonomy. There won't be overly structured playbooks or layers of management. We're looking for someone who can independently identify opportunities, make decisions, and execute quickly.

  • We expect more than 9 to 5 - raw hours make an impact at our current stage. That said, we trust each team member to create a flexible work schedule that allows them to be most productive while accommodating other priorities outside of work. We also strongly encourage time off to recharge the batteries: in addition to unlimited PTO, we've implemented a minimum 20 days vacation policy 🌴

description:

About the Role

The Threat Intelligence and Detection Engineering (TIDE) team is seeking a Security Engineer to design and build the automation, tooling, and engineering capabilities that improve CrowdStrike's internal security operations.

As part of CrowdStrike's internal Cyber Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT), TIDE partners closely with Incident Response Operations to ensure responders have the detections, data, tooling, automation, and infrastructure they need to rapidly detect, investigate, and respond to security threats.

In this role, you'll partner with Incident Response Operations to understand operational challenges and engineer scalable solutions that improve the effectiveness of the team. Whether it's automating repetitive workflows, building new detections, reducing false positives, integrating security platforms, or developing new response capabilities, your work will directly improve how CrowdStrike detects and responds to threats within its own environment.

This role is ideal for engineers with hands-on incident response experience who enjoy solving operational problems through software engineering, automation, and modern DevOps practices.

What You'll Do

Improve Incident Response Operations

  • Partner with Incident Response Operations to identify operational challenges and engineer scalable solutions.

  • Automate repetitive investigative and response workflows to reduce manual effort and accelerate incident handling.

  • Design solutions that improve investigative efficiency, enrich security data, and simplify analyst workflows.

  • Build capabilities that improve visibility, reduce operational overhead, and enable responders to focus on high-value investigations.

Enhance Detection & Response

  • Design, implement, and maintain security detections across a variety of technologies and data sources.

  • Improve detection fidelity by reducing false positives and increasing actionable alert quality.

  • Develop and maintain detection, enrichment, and response pipelines that support scalable security operations.

  • Collaborate with Threat Intelligence to operationalise threat intelligence through detections and automation.

Build Security Engineering Capabilities

  • Develop automation, integrations, and internal tooling that improve security operations.

  • Build and maintain integrations between security platforms, cloud services, and internal systems.

  • Engineer reliable, cloud-native capabilities using CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and modern software engineering practices.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Experience

  • Hands-on experience investigating and responding to cybersecurity incidents in a SOC, CSIRT, or Incident Response team.

  • Experience developing software using Python, Go, or another modern programming language.

  • Experience building automation, APIs, or systems integrations.

  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • Understanding of Linux, networking, authentication, and enterprise security technologies.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar platforms.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or other Infrastructure as Code technologies.

  • Experience with SIEM, EDR, SOAR, identity, or cloud security platforms.

  • Experience with security telemetry, log analytics, or detection engineering.

  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, threat hunting methodologies, or threat intelligence.

  • Experience applying AI or machine learning to improve security operations and engineering workflows.

Desired Characteristics

Successful candidates combine the mindset of an incident responder with the skills of an engineer. They understand the challenges of modern security operations and are motivated to solve them through thoughtful engineering, automation, and continuous improvement.

They are naturally curious, collaborative, and pragmatic, with a passion for building scalable capabilities that make security teams more effective.

title: Senior Product Analyst — A/B Platform
description:
InDrive is a global ride-hailing and transportation company that emphasizes freedom and user-centered choice. We are running hundreds of experiments to make our products even better and the experimentation platform is at the heart of this rapidly evolving process.

We are looking for a Senior Experimentation Platform Analyst who will significantly improve InDrive’s experimentation platform, enhance our A/B testing capabilities and make our data-driven decisions more reliable and trustworthy.

    • A/B and multivariate testing
    • Switchback testing
    • Regional causal inference approaches
  • Solve complex causal inference problems:
    • Network effects, interference, non-compliance
    • Long-term and delayed effects
    • Heterogeneous treatment effects across markets
  • Partner closely with engineers to translate statistical logic into scalable, production-ready systems
  • Enable product teams by creating clear decision frameworks, metrics standards, and experiment review processes
  • Drive adoption of advanced tools (e.g. CUPED, variance reduction, causal models)
  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, data science, or experimentation-heavy roles

  • Advanced SQL and Python (experience with experimentation or causal libraries is a plus)
  • Ability to explain complex statistical ideas to non-technical stakeholders
  • Product mindset: you care about decisions, not just numbers
  • Curiosity, rigor, and the courage to challenge “obvious” conclusions
  • Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 1100+ cities in 48 countries
  • Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs

title: Lead Telecommunication Engineer (Offshore)
description:
Title:

Lead Telecommunication Engineer (Offshore)

"Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR !

The KBR team of teams delivers future-forward science, technology and engineering solutions and mission-critical services that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most important objectives, while also helping achieve their sustainability goals.

KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions provides holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design and engineering capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets."

Job Description - Lead Telecommunication Engineer

Title: Lead Telecommunication Engineer

Company: KBR - Inhouse Engineering

Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE - KBR Office

Key Consideration:

Preference will be given to candidates holding valid OPITO-approved T-BOSIET/BOSIET and H₂S certifications with a minimum validity of six months. The selected candidate will be required to travel ADNOC offshore on a rotational basis to conduct site surveys, support brownfield assessments, verify existing installations, and obtain project-specific engineering data necessary for design and execution.

Job Purpose

  • Lead, direct, and oversee all Telecommunication engineering activities for onshore and offshore oil & gas developments across the full project lifecycle, including Concept Studies, FEED, and Detailed Engineering.
  • Serve as the discipline technical authority, providing engineering leadership to ensure the delivery of safe, reliable, maintainable, and cost-effective telecom system solutions that comply with client requirements, applicable standards, project schedules, and quality expectations. Act as the focal point for telecommunication and security systems while facilitating effective multidisciplinary coordination.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership for telecom engineering during FEED and Detailed Engineering of onshore and offshore oil & gas facilities.
  • Develop telecom system architectures, design philosophies, specifications, and implementation-ready engineering deliverables in compliance with ADNOC standards and international codes.
  • Perform site surveys, brownfield assessments, telecom adequacy studies, and evaluations of existing telecom infrastructure to define upgrade, expansion, and integration requirements.
  • Design and integrate telecommunications systems including:
    • Fiber Optic, SDH, OTN, DWDM, and Ethernet Networks
    • LAN/WAN Systems
    • HF/VHF/UHF/TETRA Radio Systems
    • CCTV Systems
    • Access Control Systems
    • PA/GA Systems
    • Telephone and Information Systems
    • Wireless Communication and Structured Cabling Systems
  • Prepare and review telecom engineering deliverables, including design basis documents, philosophies, system architectures, specifications, datasheets, layouts, cable schedules, tie-in documents, and material take-offs.
  • Perform and review telecom studies, including network capacity assessments, fiber optic calculations, radio and CCTV coverage studies, power consumption, and heat dissipation analyses.
  • Develop telecom interfaces between telecom, IT, control, F&G, and security systems.
  • Ensure compliance with ADNOC standards, project specifications, and applicable international standards.
  • Participate in design reviews, HAZID, HAZOP, constructability reviews, value engineering, and risk assessment workshops.
  • Provide technical support during procurement, vendor evaluation, system integration, construction, commissioning, and project handover.
  • Lead and mentor a team of engineers and designers, ensuring consistency, quality, and compliance across all engineering activities.
  • Interface effectively with Project Management, Engineering Management, Clients, Operations teams, and Vendors to achieve successful project delivery.
  • Review, approve, and monitor engineering deliverables prepared by discipline team members, consultants, and subcontractors.
  • Support proposal preparation, technical bid evaluations, manpower estimation, cost forecasting, and discipline planning activities.
  • Conduct offshore and onshore site surveys, field verification activities, data collection, constructability assessments, and brownfield feasibility reviews.
  • Ensure full compliance with ADNOC specifications, standards, and project-specific requirements.
  • Facilitate design reviews, technical assurance activities, and value engineering initiatives to optimize project outcomes.
  • Coordinate closely with Electrical, Instrumentation and other engineering disciplines to ensure seamless integration of design solutions.
  • Monitor discipline progress against approved schedules, budgets, and project milestones.
  • Identify technical and execution risks and implement effective mitigation strategies.
  • Support project planning, forecasting, progress reporting, and resource management activities.
  • Lead interdisciplinary design reviews, technical workshops, and engineering resolution meetings.
  • Ensure timely resolution of technical issues and effective implementation of Management of Change (MOC) processes.
  • Liaise with Clients, Vendors, OEMs, and third-party stakeholders to ensure technical compliance and resolve engineering challenges.
  • Ensure adherence to QA/QC procedures, engineering standards, calibration philosophies, datasheet quality requirements, and procurement documentation standards.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging telecom technologies, digitalization initiatives, and industry best practices, promoting innovative and value-enhancing solutions where appropriate.

Experience

  • Minimum 15+ years of telecommunication engineering experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, LNG, or Energy sectors.
  • Minimum 5 to 8 years in a Lead Engineer, Senior Lead Engineer, or equivalent leadership capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering both offshore and onshore brownfield and greenfield projects.
  • Extensive working knowledge of ADNOC Group projects, engineering practices, and technical standards.
  • Proven experience across FEED, Detailed Engineering, EPC, PMC, Construction, and Commissioning environments.
  • Strong exposure to offshore production facilities, wellhead platforms, central processing facilities, and related infrastructure.
  • Experience leading telecom infrastructure upgrades, network modernization, digital transformation initiatives, and brownfield integration projects is highly desirable.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications or Electronics & Communication Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Professional memberships and relevant certifications such as PE, Chartered Engineer or equivalent industry-recognized qualifications will be considered advantageous.

Technical Skills

  • Experience in telecom adequacy assessments, brownfield modifications, and integration of existing telecom systems.
  • Strong understanding of industrial communication networks, telecom infrastructure planning, and system lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with telecom room layouts, control room layouts, field layouts, and 3D model reviews.
  • Knowledge of OT cybersecurity principles and telecom system integration within industrial facilities.
  • Experience with Telecom System Integrator (TSI) management, technical bid evaluations, and vendor coordination.
  • In-depth knowledge of hazardous area classification, equipment selection, certification requirements (IECEx/ATEX), and installation practices for hazardous zones.
  • Proven experience in telecom system design, telecom architecture development, brownfield integration, and telecom adequacy studies.
  • Good knowledge of ADNOC AGES and AGPS, ITU-T, IEEE, IEC, ANSI/TIA, NFPA, and ATEX/IECEx requirements.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing telecom studies, engineering calculations, specifications, and FEED deliverables.
  • Strong leadership, communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proactive, delivery-focused professional with sound technical judgment and strong attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and technical decision-making capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.

What We Offer:

  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
  • Engaging and collaborative work environment with a commitment to safety and sustainability.

title: Test Engineer

About the Company

Noble Gas Systems is an innovative manufacturing company specializing in the design, development, and production of comfortable high-pressure compressed gas storage and delivery systems. Our technology supports applications across energy, transportation, and advanced industrial markets.

As we continue to scale, we are focused on strengthening our infrastructure, improving operational execution, and building a team that can support long-term growth.


About the Role

The Test Engineer is responsible for ensuring the safe and timely execution of all testing. This includes conducting high-pressure tests on various components, equipment, and systems to ensure they meet safety, quality, and performance standards.

This role requires a strong understanding of high-pressure testing procedures, equipment operation, and adherence to safety protocols. The engineer will work closely with R&D and quality control teams to ensure products meet or exceed industry standards.

Key Responsibilities include:

  • Define preventive maintenance plans and perform routine maintenance and calibration of testing equipment

  • Manage the definition/installation of new test equipment and upgrades to existing test equipment

  • Inspect and verify the integrity of components before and after testing

  • Responsible for the definition and maintenance of testing procedures

  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of tests performed, including pressure levels, duration, and results

  • Identify and resolve technical issues that may arise during testing processes

  • Stay up to date with industry regulations, codes, and standards related to high-pressure and Hydrogen testing

  • Establish and promote adherence safety protocols for use in the testing area

About You

  • Bachelor of Science in Engineering or equivalent

  • Proven experience in high-pressure testing or a related field

  • Familiarity with high-pressure testing equipment and systems

  • Strong understanding of safety protocols and procedures

  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications

  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in record-keeping

  • Effective communication skills

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry heavy equipment (up to 50 pounds)

  • Comfortable working in confined spaces if required

  • Ability to stand, bend, and kneel for extended periods

We deliver innovative technology solutions in cloud computing, data analytics, AI, embedded software,IoT, and more to global industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Join us to create technology that drives real change for businesses and people across the world.

Our client is a leading online car marketplace group operating across Europe and North America, bringing together market-leading brands to shape the future of our industry by combining the best of both regions.

About the Role: Join our client's Platform Engineering team, where they build the internal platform that 600+ developers rely on to ship software quickly and safely: centralized Kubernetes, managed CI/CD, project templates, and developer tooling running on AWS.
A big part of that today is making developers more productive with AI — secure environments for AI coding tools, AI-assisted CI, agentic workflows on AWS (Bedrock, Agent Core), and MCP-based integrations. AI is the means, not the end: what we care about is a faster, smoother day-to-day for every engineer.

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer who works fluently with modern AI tooling and uses it to move fast — someone who'd rather build something and learn from it than research it forever, and who brings solid infrastructure/AWS fundamentals along with the product thinking and communication skills to own a topic end to end.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and operate the internal AI platform: secure AI coding environments, AI in CI/CD, agentic workflows on AWS (Bedrock / Agent Core), and reusable building blocks teams adopt by default.
  • Own products end to end — design, build, run, and improve them with a product mindset, treating fellow engineers as your customers and shaping interfaces that are genuinely easy to build with.
  • Start from the developer's day: figure out where the real friction is, decide what would actually make their work easier, and measure whether people adopt it once it ships.
  • Take ownership of a topic, plan the work, drive it to done, and keep stakeholders in the loop.
  • Set the bar for how we build with AI — turn an interesting idea into tooling people can actually rely on, and bring the rest of the team along with you.
  • Shape architecture and technology choices for our platform foundations (Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC on AWS) and for the AI capabilities on top, and share your perspective in technical discussions.
  • Keep the platform reliable, secure, observable, and cost-aware. You'll join the on-call rotation and help troubleshoot production incidents.
  • Capture reusable patterns, templates, and blueprints so the whole organization moves faster.

Requirements:

  • Senior-level experience (5+ years) building and operating infrastructure or platform products.
  • Hands-on GenAI experience — you've built with LLM APIs, tool/function calling, retrieval, agents, or agent frameworks and put them into real workflows.
  • Modern AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) are part of how you work day to day.
  • Strong AWS fundamentals and a genuine appreciation for Infrastructure as Code and Pipeline as Code.
  • A real feel for developer experience — you can look at a feature and tell whether it'll make a developer's life easier or just add another thing to learn, because you've lived that friction yourself.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills — you work well in a team, share your opinions clearly, and can move a topic forward with people across functions.
  • Solid engineering fundamentals: testing, debugging, code quality, and getting things production-ready.
  • Familiarity with SRE / DevOps principles and observability concepts (CloudWatch, Datadog, OpsGenie, or similar).
  • Proficiency in at least one language, ideally Python, Go, or TypeScript.
  • A bias for shipping — you're comfortable taking something ambiguous and turning it into a working solution with sensible scope.

We offer*:

title: Quality Control Inspector

description:

In tale ruolo, le Tue Responsabilità saranno:

  • Promuovere un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, collaborativo e inclusivo.


Chi sei:

Affronti nuove sfide e opportunità con energia, proattività e spirito di iniziativa. Costruisci relazioni collaborative e lavori efficacemente con colleghi e stakeholder per raggiungere obiettivi condivisi. Ti assumi la responsabilità dei risultati e rispetti gli impegni presi. Sai adattarti rapidamente ai cambiamenti e sei disponibile ad apprendere e utilizzare nuove tecnologie, strumenti e processi per migliorare qualità e performance.

Per questo Ruolo, richiediamo:

  • Diploma tecnico o esperienza equivalente maturata in ambito manifatturiero o ingegneristico.

  • Esperienza in attività di controllo qualità in contesti manifatturieri, industriali o produttivi.

  • Capacità di leggere e interpretare disegni tecnici, specifiche e documentazione di controllo.

  • Conoscenza dei processi di qualità e delle metodologie di ispezione, inclusi i principi dei controlli non distruttivi.

  • Familiarità con strumenti di misura e tecniche di verifica dimensionale.

  • Conoscenza dei materiali e dei processi produttivi.

  • Buona capacità Buona conoscenza degli strumenti Microsoft Office.

  • Conoscenza della lingua inglese.

  • Attenzione ai dettagli, capacità di problem solving e orientamento alla qualità e alla sicurezza.

  • Disponibilità a collaborare con fornitori e stakeholder interni quando necessario.di gestione della documentazione e delle segnalazioni di non conformità.

Requisiti preferenziali

  • Certificazione di II Livello nei controlli non distruttivi.

  • Esperienza nell'utilizzo di sistemi di misura tridimensionali, inclusi strumenti FARO o equivalenti.

  • Conoscenza di strumenti per la verifica dell’analisi chimica (PMI).

  • Esperienza nell'utilizzo di sistemi ERP.

  • Conoscenza dei principi Lean e delle metodologie di miglioramento continuo.

  • Esperienza nella gestione di ispezioni cliente, enti notificati o organismi terzi.

Our Culture & Commitment to You

In Emerson, i valori di innovazione, integrità, collaborazione e inclusione guidano tutto ciò che facciamo. Promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro in cui ogni persona possa contribuire con competenze, esperienze e prospettive differenti. Accogliamo candidature provenienti da percorsi professionali diversi e incoraggiamo a candidarsi anche chi possiede molte, pur non tutte, delle qualifiche indicate. Crediamo che il talento possa svilupparsi attraverso esperienze differenti e ci impegniamo a offrire opportunità di crescita, apprendimento continuo e sviluppo professionale.

La nostra filosofia retributiva è semplice: offriamo una retribuzione base competitiva, allineata al mercato locale in cui operiamo, e valorizziamo i risultati individuali attraverso il nostro processo annuale di revisione salariale. Per questa posizione, la RAL prevista è compresa tra 26.000 e 38.000 EUR lordi annui, in funzione delle competenze, del talento, delle capacità e dell’esperienza che ciascun candidato apporterà al ruolo. La posizione è regolata dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro (CCNL) per l’Industria Metalmeccanica, che definisce la struttura retributiva e i relativi percorsi di progressione professionale (CCNL Metalmeccanici – Assolombarda).

title: Head of Wholesale Management Italy (On Trade)
description:
Seniority Level: Mid-Senior Level

Joining AB InBev as a Head of Wholesale Management Italy (On Trade) means contributing to the growth of iconic brands such as Bud, Stella Artois, and Corona, gaining valuable professional experience, and accelerating your career faster than you might expect.

Brewing the world’s most loved beers and building brands consumers love, AB InBev is where ownership, ambition, and action thrive. We empower you to dream big, lead change, and create a long-lasting legacy. We value relentless problem-solvers who take accountability, embrace challenges, and turn bold goals into results through resilience and hard work.

That’s Who We Are: Come and OWN IT.


Purpose of the Role

Lead the Wholesale Management function for the Italian On Trade business, driving sustainable growth through strategic partnerships with national and regional wholesalers. The role is responsible for defining and executing the wholesale strategy, strengthening route-to-market effectiveness, expanding distribution, and delivering commercial excellence across the On Trade channel.

As a member of the commercial leadership team, this role plays a key part in accelerating market share growth, expanding the premium portfolio, and leading a high-performing Wholesale Management organization.


Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Business Growth

  • Define and execute the national wholesale strategy aligned with commercial priorities.
  • Deliver volume, revenue, profitability and market share targets.
  • Identify growth opportunities and develop Joint Business Plans with strategic wholesale partners.
  • Lead commercial negotiations and investment planning to drive sustainable growth.

Wholesale Customer Management

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with national and regional wholesalers.
  • Act as the senior commercial contact for key wholesale partners.
  • Increase distribution, availability and execution of priority brands across the On Trade channel.

Route-to-Market Excellence

  • Optimize route-to-market effectiveness and commercial execution.
  • Monitor performance through execution KPIs and customer insights.
  • Partner with field sales teams to maximize execution quality and customer activation.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, coach and develop the Wholesale Management team.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Build organizational capability through talent development and succession planning.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Sales, Trade Marketing, Revenue Management, Category Management, Sales Intelligence, Supply Chain and Finance to deliver commercial priorities and business objectives.


Success Measures

Business Performance

  • Volume, Net Revenue and Market Share growth.
  • Distribution expansion and premium portfolio performance.
  • Delivery of annual business plan targets.

Customer Excellence

  • Joint Business Plans execution.
  • Strategic wholesaler engagement.
  • Distribution, availability and execution KPIs.

People & Leadership

  • Team engagement.
  • Talent development and succession readiness.
  • Performance of direct reports.


Candidate Profile

Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics or a related field (Master's degree is a plus).
  • 8-12 years of commercial leadership experience within FMCG, beverage or consumer goods.
  • Proven experience managing wholesale, distributor or route-to-market organizations.
  • Strong track record of delivering profitable growth and negotiating strategic commercial agreements.

Skills

  • Strong strategic and commercial mindset with execution focus.
  • Deep understanding of wholesale and route-to-market dynamics.
  • Excellent customer relationship, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen.
  • Proven leadership, coaching and people development capabilities.

Leadership Expectations

  • Demonstrates ownership and accountability.
  • Builds high-performing teams and develops talent.
  • Makes data-driven decisions with a customer-first mindset.
  • Drives collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Acts with agility and delivers sustainable business results.

WHY JOIN AB INBEV

As a Head of Wholesale Management Italy (On Trade) at AB InBev, you will have the opportunity to grow both professionally and personally. You will receive the tools, training, and support needed to achieve your development goals in a merit-based environment where your contribution is recognized.

We will encourage you to believe in yourself, challenge your limits, express your creativity, and build an international network. You will be in charge of your career and the direction you choose to take.

We are building a more inclusive, collaborative, and supportive team, with diverse backgrounds, skills, and experiences.

So, if you dream big but feel you may not meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the right person to help us build a future with more Cheers.

As the world’s leading brewer, we are committed to bringing people together for a better and more equitable world. At AB InBev, we value diversity in culture, perspective, skills, and experience, and we strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans to apply.

title: Senior Manager - Vendor Security Risk
description:
About Us

SBI Card is a leading pure-play credit card issuer in India, offering a wide range of credit cards to cater to diverse customer needs. We are constantly innovating to meet the evolving financial needs of our customers, empowering them with digital currency for seamless payment experience and indulge in rewarding benefits. SBI Card is proud to be an equal opportunity & inclusive employer and welcome employees without any discrimination on the grounds of race, color, gender, religion, creed, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, caste etc. SBI Card is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees are treated equally with dignity and respect which makes it a promising place to work.

Join us to shape the future of digital payment in India and unlock your full potential.

What’s in it for YOU

  1. SBI Card truly lives by the work-life balance philosophy. We offer a robust wellness and wellbeing program to support mental and physical health of our employees
  2. Admirable work deserves to be rewarded. We have a well curated bouquet of rewards and recognition program for the employees
  3. Dynamic, Inclusive and Diverse team culture
  4. Gender Neutral Policy
  5. Inclusive Health Benefits for all - Medical Insurance, Personal Accidental, Group Term Life Insurance and Annual Health Checkup, Dental and OPD benefits
  6. Commitment to the overall development of an employee through comprehensive learning & development framework

Role Purpose

Responsible for conducting vendor risk assessments from information security perspective based on, ISO27001:2013, PCI-DSS, Cloud security control framework etc. and to ensure identified risks are addressed appropriately in timely manner. The role is also responsible for assessing and identifying risks associated with third parties part of SBI Card extended echo system, analyzing identified risks and ensure timely reporting and remediation of the same and working closely with cross-functional teams within SBI Card and vendor /partner teams to manage security risks associated with third parties and get the same addressed within a agreed timeline.

Role Accountability

  1. Conduct vendor risk assessments from information security perspective using, ISO27001:2013, PCI-DSS, Cloud security control framework etc.
  2. Ensure identified risks are addressed appropriately
  3. Track and report status of open observations, remedial plan and timelines for resolution
  4. Perform remediation testing once identified observations have been marked as resolved
  5. Review and establish secure processes and systems at vendor's end for integration with SBI Card
  6. Prepare and update assessment questionaries basis various applicable standards and industry good practices such as ISO 27001, PCI-DSS etc.
  7. Monitor vendor compliance, undertake vendor evaluations based on various industry standard and regulatory compliance perspective and suggest feedback / recommendations to the - business / vendor for mitigating identified risk
  8. Work with appropriate business users to ensure that for any identified risk require mitigating action along with timeline is agreed and tracked the same for successful closure
  9. Act as a subject matter expert to assist the business in identifying and mitigating risks pertaining to their vendor relationships
  10. Deliver continuous training and awareness to Business partners on various compliance requirements such as ISO 27001, PCI-DSS etc.
  11. Perform process documentation and compliance adherence

Measures of Success

  1. Number of vendor risk assessments conducted successfully
  2. Timely and accurate identification and reporting of information security risks pertaining to third parties/vendors
  3. Timely and accurate delivery of updates, presentations, assessment reports etc. to relevant stakeholders
  4. Tracking of audit findings and driving to closure within defined timelines
  5. Process Adherence as per MOU

Technical Skills / Experience / Certifications

  1. Knowledge in multiple information security technologies and their strengths and shortcomings
  2. Knowledge of common assessment control techniques
  3. Understanding of security controls from people, process and technology perspective
  4. Understanding of security architectural principles and standards
  5. Experience in system security, network security and information security, control objectives part of ISMS, Technology risk and compliance, BCP & DR planning, Security operations and Cloud security
  6. Knowledge of standard security processes and guidelines
  7. Experience in implementing or accessing compliance against PCI-DSS, ISO27001 requirements
  8. Industry-standard certifications such as ISO27001:2013 LA, CISA, CISM, Cloud Security etc.

Competencies critical to the role

  1. Detail Orientation
  2. Process Orientation
  3. Stakeholder Management
  4. Analytical ability

Qualification

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science / Information Security or any other relevant discipline

Preferred Industry

FSI

title: Senior Conductor - Future Vacancies
description:
Join the Grand Central Team as a Senior Conductor!


Organisation – Grand Central


Contract – Future vacancies – please note this is a talent pool vacancy for when positions become available in the future


Working Hours – rota basis, you must be able to work shifts as working times vary, start times can be as early as 0500, finish times could be 23:30 so you would need to be flexible. Rosters are usually provided in advance therefore you can plan ahead!


Location – Bradford


Salary – training salary £31,020.82, on completion of training ££38,776.03 per annum

About Us:


Grand Central which is part of the Arriva Group, are an open-access train operator linking the North East and West Yorkshire with London. This means we don't get any sort of help from the government and our only loyalty is to our customers - it's in our interest to give you the best journey possible. We've been connecting London Kings Cross, Yorkshire and the North East since 2007, and our customers consistently rate us as one of the best train companies in the country. Calling at the smaller stations which other operators might miss, which means we're always looking to be active in the local community, through our various social responsibility programs and helping local organisations.

Grand Central Benefits:

  • Contributory Pension Scheme: Arriva Workplace Pension Plan (AWPP) provided by Standard Life

  • Unlimited Free Travel for you and your immediate family on all Grand Central services. In addition, we currently offer concessionary travel on other Arriva Trains UK franchises.

  • Employee Assistance Programme provided by Health Assured: free, confidential 24-hour telephone counselling and information services.

Benefits available upon completion of probation period (3-6 months):

  • Friends & Family Passes pro-rata allocation of return standard class journeys (terms & conditions apply)

  • • Company Medical Insurance provided by AXA PPP Healthcare (taxable benefit)

  • • Company Wellness Package (including dental/optical treatment) provided by WPA (taxable benefit).

  • • Child Care Vouchers Scheme

  • • Cycle to Work Scheme

  • • Arriva Village employee rewards and benefits scheme

The Role:


As a Senior Conductor safety is at the forefront of everything you do, you will be responsible for undertaking Train Guard responsibilities inline with industry and company standards, rules and policies in a safe, punctual manner. You will lead the on-train team to ensure exceptional customer service is delivered daily, even when things don’t quite go to plan!


The Senior Conductor Training Programme includes modules on rules and regulations, route learning, fire safety and track safety, followed by on-going training and assessments. The first 6 weeks will consist of a classroom learning approach of the theory. This is followed by practical learning under the guidance of a Senior Conductor Mentor during which you will be regularly assessed to develop and maintain competence.

What You’ll Do:

  • Revenue Duties – selling and checking tickets and travel documents

  • Delivering exceptional customer service- ensuring our customers have a safe, comfortable and memorable journey and resolving issues promptly where we can

  • Ensuring personal safety and that of others at all times

  • Comply with all relevant rules, procedures and policies

  • Undergo competence/proficiency assessments as required by company procedures and the Safety Management System (SMS)

  • Manage on-train requirements such as seat reservations, ensuring appropriate train presentation, timely and appropriate on-train customer announcements

  • Ensuring having received and understood any notices, bulletins or other information relating to the job and where required, confirm receipt of these in the prescribed manner (usually on a tablet device)

  • Communicate effectively with and assist staff and customers in the interests of safety and customer service


Full job description available on request

What You Bring:

To be successful in the role, you will need to be highly motivated and proactive with excellent organisational and interpersonal skills. If you are an enthusiastic individual who enjoys facing new tasks and challenges each day, this may be the position for you!


Previous experience of providing excellent customer service and cash management is an essential attribute for this role. You must also be able to demonstrate that you can work as part of a team. In return you will be provided with all of the classroom and on the job training to learn the rules, regulations, and route learning that is involved in transporting customers on our Class 180’s.

You don’t need any previous conductor experience to apply as we offer full training as part of the role.

To be successful during the training period you’ll need to have a willingness to learn, both during working hours and at home too, as it’s an intense course requiring 100% commitment from you. In return our Training Team will give you all of the support and encouragement you need to succeed at the ongoing assessments and knowledge checks.

In your role as a Senior Conductor, you will work shifts from the early hours of the morning until late at night, weekends and Bank Holidays. You will work an average of 35 hours per week and receive your rosters in advance. You will also be required to lodge on occasion in London overnight.

To be eligible to apply, you must;

  • Be able to comply with the relevant Rail Industry Standard for the role.

  • Currently reside within 60 minutes drive of the depot

  • Pass a Rail Safety Medical

Please note this is a safety critical role and subject to random Drugs and Alcohol testing


Ready to start your next journey?


If you’re passionate about making a difference and supporting Grand Central we want to hear from you!

Let’s build the future together!

Due to the energising nature of our vacancies, application close dates, when stated, are indicative and may be subject to change so please apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment. Shortlisting and interviewing will take place whilst the advert is open and will close once a successful candidate has been identified.


At Arriva we acknowledge the importance of our people's diverse experiences, talents, and cultures. Embracing diversity and creating inclusion is a key component of our talent strategy. The creation of a diverse, inclusive workforce is central to our ability to unlock potential and enhance our success...

title: AI Data & utomation Lead, AWS, Data Lakes, Automation, Outside IR35, Part Remote
description:

Initially you will be walking into a bit of a mess! Lots of ‘behind the times’ technology, lots of spreadsheets, manual data and manual processes…and it will be your job to fix it all, taking this organisation into the New World! If it was all fixed, it would be boring…right?!


Our client is undertaking a significant transformation of its Investment Data & Operations capability, modernising the way investment data is captured, governed, consumed and leveraged across the organisation. As part of this journey, we are seeking a highly capable AI Data & Automation Lead to help shape and deliver the next generation of data-driven investment operations.

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in the evolution of this company’s data platform, automation strategy and AI-enabled operating model. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with excellent stakeholder engagement skills, operating as both a hands-on delivery lead and strategic advisor to the business. The role centres on investment data modernisation, data lakes, automation and AI-assisted workflows. Read on for more details…

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and evolution of a modern data architecture, leveraging cloud-based data lake technologies and scalable data engineering practices.
  • Define and deliver a roadmap for transforming investment operations through automation, workflow modernisation and AI enabled solutions.
  • Build and oversee data pipelines integrating portfolio management, market data, reporting, operational and financial systems.
  • Partner with technology, data and operational stakeholders to establish robust governance, monitoring, controls and data quality standards.
  • Identify manual processes across investment operations and redesign them into efficient, automated workflows.
  • Develop reporting, analytics and operational intelligence capabilities using modern data platforms and automation tooling.
  • Drive adoption of AI and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions to improve productivity, insight generation and process efficiency.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and prioritise opportunities that deliver measurable value.
  • Establish sustainable governance frameworks ensuring long-term scalability, reliability and maintainability of data assets and automated processes.
  • Act as a trusted advisor across both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex concepts into practical business outcomes.

Experience Required

  • Heavy and hardened tech background in Development and Data – ideally you will be a Computer Science graduate (or something like for like) and your tech journey would have started out around there.
  • Strong experience designing and delivering enterprise data lake environments, ideally using AWS, Databricks or similar modern cloud platforms. Azure and GCP backgrounds are acceptable too.
  • Proven background in data engineering, data architecture, integration or large-scale data transformation programmes.
  • Experience building automated workflows, operational tooling and data driven business processes.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills with the ability to work hands-on where required.
  • Experience designing integrations across multiple enterprise platforms, APIs and external data sources.
  • Knowledge of AI, machine learning or Large Language Model use cases within operational environments.
  • Ability to operate across strategy, architecture and delivery while remaining pragmatic and outcome-focused.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organisation.
  • Experience within investment management, asset management, financial services or similarly data-intensive environments would be highly beneficial, but not essential.

What is on offer…

  • Outside IR35 contract.
  • Initial three-month rolling engagement.
  • Expected contract duration of approximately 12 months.
  • Opportunity to shape a significant data and AI transformation programme.
  • High-profile stakeholder exposure across investment, operations, data and technology functions.
  • Daily rate expected to be highly competitive and dependent upon experience.

This is an excellent contract opportunity and rate is dependent upon experience. Apply now for more details…

title: Process Engineer | Packaging & Finishing Operations
description:
Why this role matters

As a Process Engineer, you will work close to production, supporting our packaging and inspection area where quality, efficiency and process stability are critical to our success.

A significant part of the role will be focused on an upcoming supplier transition, where you will help secure a successful implementation of new manufacturing solutions. This includes planning and executing industrial trials, validating process performance, coordinating cross-functional activities and ensuring production readiness.

If you enjoy solving technical challenges, working with data and driving improvements from idea to implementation, this could be the role for you.

Your assignment

As a Process Engineer you will:

  • Develop, optimize and standardize manufacturing processes to improve safety, quality, delivery performance and productivity.
  • Lead and support implementation of new supplier solutions, materials, equipment and production methods.
  • Plan, coordinate and execute industrial trials, process validations and production readiness activities.
  • Analyse production and process data to identify trends, variation and improvement opportunities.
  • Drive continuous improvement using Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma methodologies and structured problem solving.
  • Apply risk management tools such as FMEA, process capability analysis and control plans to create robust and sustainable manufacturing processes.
  • Participate in and lead cross-functional projects related to process development, industrialisation and operational excellence.
  • Create and maintain process standards, work instructions and technical documentation.
  • Support digitalisation, automation and data-driven ways of working.
  • Coach and support production teams in technical methods and continuous improvement practices.

We are looking for someone who

  • Has an Engineering degree or equivalent experience within manufacturing or industrial production.
  • Has experience in process development, process optimisation or continuous improvement.
  • Has experience working with Lean Manufacturing and/or Six Sigma methodologies.
  • Enjoys working close to operations while also driving long-term improvements.
  • Has strong analytical skills and enjoys making decisions based on facts and data.
  • Has experience from implementation projects, supplier transitions, industrialisation or process validation activities.
  • Is comfortable collaborating with stakeholders across different functions.
  • Communicates fluently in English and Swedish, both written and spoken.

Who you are

You are curious, structured and motivated by solving complex challenges.

You enjoy turning analysis into action, building strong relationships and seeing improvements become reality on the shop floor. You take ownership, challenge existing ways of working when needed and contribute to an environment where continuous improvement is part of everyday life.

Most importantly, you share our IKEA values and believe that great results are achieved together.

What we offer

At IKEA Industry, you'll have the opportunity to work in a modern and international manufacturing environment where innovation, sustainability and continuous improvement are part of everyday life.

You'll join a business that invests in technology, people and development, and where your contributions can have a direct impact on the future of our production processes.

Sounds like you?

Submit your application via Smart Recruiters no later than 25 August. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we review applications continuously throughout the recruitment process.

title: Biological Laboratory Subject Matter Expert (SME) & Government Liaison
description:
The Biological Laboratory Subject Matter Expert (SME) will provide specialized expertise in biological laboratory operations, scientific research methodologies, and project management. This role will support the development, design, and implementation of laboratory infrastructure, biosafety protocols, and project delivery for biological research facilities. The SME will ensure the quality, safety, and functionality of laboratories by working closely with multidisciplinary teams including engineers, laboratory personnel, and contractors to meet scientific, regulatory, and operational requirements.

As a Government Liaison, this position will serve as the primary in-country interface between the Program Management Office and the in-country government stakeholders, including the Department of Health, Department of the Interior and Local Government, and partner laboratories/institutes. The roles ensures that stakeholder coordination, host-nation compliance, and partner engagement are conducted effectively and in accordance with the task order requirements.


Duties & Responsibilities

As BioLab SME:

  • Provide technical and management expertise in designing, constructing, and commissioning biological and chemical research laboratory facilities.
  • Lead the development of specifications for laboratory spaces, including containment laboratories (BSL-2/3), to align with safety, performance, and operational standards.
  • Oversee installation, testing, and commissioning of laboratory equipment and environmental systems, ensuring compliance with laboratory and environmental safety regulations.
  • Review and approve laboratory operational plans, procedures, and protocols related to safety, workflows, and functionality.
  • Conduct risk assessments for laboratory operations, including identification and mitigation of biosafety hazards, to comply with regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams to integrate engineering, architecture, and laboratory workflows into seamless and functional facility designs.
  • Serve as an interface between clients, laboratory operators, contractors, and design/build teams to ensure alignment with project objectives.
  • Inspect laboratory build-outs to verify adherence to design, specifications, and operational requirements.
  • Lead troubleshooting processes for system or equipment malfunctions during construction, commissioning, and operational start-up phases.
  • Review cost estimates, timelines, and project risks to ensure adherence to project deliverables without compromising safety or standards.
  • Develop and deliver training programs for laboratory management and personnel on biosafety protocols, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and emergency response plans.
  • Participate in developing project submittals, proposals, and technical documents related to biological laboratory projects.
  • Provide input on procurement planning for laboratory equipment, consumables, and materials, ensuring alignment with operational needs.
  • Maintain awareness of global and regional regulatory standards (ISO, WHO, CDC, NIH) related to laboratory design, biosafety levels, and operational compliance.

As a government liaison:

  • Act as the day-to-day point of coordination between the PMO and GPH stakeholders
  • Facilitate the scheduling, coordination, and documentation of meetings, site visits, training events, and engagements with GPH stakeholders, supporting the preparation of itineraries, agendas, and minutes.
  • Track, expedite, and record government approvals, concurrences, and flag emerging coordination or compliance issues.
  • Advance partner coordination to support facility access, training delivery, and sustainment objectives, and support GPH concurrence for the Transfer of Property processes.
  • Advise the Project Manager on the host-nation political, regulatory, cultural, and protocol considerations affecting program execution.
  • Prepare correspondence and briefing materials, and coordinate translation/interpretation support as required.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

  • Advanced degree in biological sciences, microbiology, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience working in biosafety or biological research laboratories, including BSL-2/3 facilities or equivalent.
  • Deep understanding of laboratory design standards, biosafety principles, and regulatory guidelines for biological safety containment.
  • Hands-on experience in project management, laboratory commissioning, and quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) processes.
  • Strong understanding of HVAC, filtration, and waste management systems specifically designed for biological laboratories.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with a clear ability to assess risks and recommend effective solutions.
  • Proficiency in preparing technical reports, operational plans, and biosafety documentation.
  • Experience in team leadership, cross-disciplinary collaboration, and stakeholder communication.
  • Familiarity with training development and delivery for laboratory staff on operational procedures and safety protocols.
  • Ability to travel or relocate, as needed, for project assignments and execution.
  • Employees must read, speak, and comprehend English to the extent that they can perform the contract requirements and comply with installation emergency procedures

Highly Desired Skills and Experience

  • Certifications or qualifications in biosafety, such as RBP (Registered Biosafety Professional), CBSP (Certified Biological Safety Professional), or equivalent.
  • Experience working with facilities applying for or maintaining WHO/CDC/NIH certification for BSL facilities.
  • Demonstrated experience in retrofitting, upgrading, or decommissioning existing hazardous containment laboratories for new operational requirements.
  • Research expertise in areas such as virology, microbiology, or biotechnology, with publication experience in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Experience consulting or working on international laboratory projects.
  • Proficiency in using modeling and design tools for facility layout or operational workflow optimization.

Travel Requirements

  • Regular travel to project locations with periodic extended stays may be required during key stages of laboratory design, construction, or commissioning.
  • OCONUS-based; willing to travel CONUS 10%
  • Willing to work rotating shifts as needed, including nights and weekends

Additional notes


  • The ideal candidate will demonstrate a deep understanding of biological laboratory design and operation while ensuring compliance with regulatory and safety standards. Candidates with experience in multidisciplinary coordination and working on complex facility infrastructure projects are highly encouraged to apply.
  • Ability to travel or relocate, as needed, for project assignments and execution
  • Applicants must have authorization to work in host country.

OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES

Safety:Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks, and serving on safety committees and teams.

Quality:Quality is the foundation of our business and the keystone of our goal of customer satisfaction. It is our policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Each employee is required to conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts.

Procedure Compliance:Each employee must read, understand, and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality, and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures, and policies pertaining to their job.

title: Principal Lead, AI Platform & Solutions
description:
JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION

  • To lead the strategic design, architecture, and enterprise build-out of the bank's AI & Agentic Platform capability, ensuring it serves as a trusted, scalable, and governed foundation for AI-driven decisioning, agentic automation, and enterprise knowledge across the Group.
  • The role is pivotal in shaping how AI capability is built, integrated, and adopted across business units, partnering with senior business and technology stakeholders to translate the bank's AI ambition into a coherent platform and solution architecture aligned with FAB's digital, agentic, and AI roadmap, regulatory expectations, and Group strategy.

  • The role combines deep technical authority on AI platform architecture with the strategic judgement and stakeholder reach required to direct enterprise AI capability across a tier-one bank.

    KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define and own the target architecture for the AI & Agentic Platform, covering the agentic runtime, action gateway, control plane, knowledge foundation, model gateway and abstraction, evaluation, and observability layers.
  • Set and evolve the cloud architecture for AI workloads across Azure and AWS, including hybrid model serving, inference economics, network and identity design, data residency, and the build-versus-buy positioning across managed services and bank-built capabilities.
  • Lead the integration architecture between the AI Platform and the bank's core estate, including core banking, risk and credit systems, treasury and finance platforms, the enterprise data platform (Azure and Cloudera), enterprise APIs, ESB, and identity services.
  • Establish and govern the engineering, architectural, and AI engineering standards adopted across the AI Platform team, including reference patterns, agent and tool contracts, runtime governance hooks, evaluation discipline, and integration with model risk.
  • Shape FAB's multi-year AI capability direction, including build-versus-buy positioning, foundation model strategy, proprietary capability investment, and platform evolution in response to changes in the agentic AI and regulatory landscape.
  • Partner with the Senior, Platform Engineering and Architecture lead in a two-in-a-box operating model, with a clear separation between platform direction, target architecture, and enterprise positioning (this role) and platform engineering execution and run-state.
  • Build enterprise AI capability across the Group through reference architectures, standards, communities of practice, internal forums, and direct mentorship of senior engineers and architects across DAAI and the wider technology function.
  • Engage business heads and their CIOs across Wholesale Banking, Personal Banking, Private Banking, Treasury, Risk, and Group Finance to shape how AI is integrated into their operating models, beyond individual use cases.
  • Represent the AI & Agentic Platforms function in forums with Group Technology, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber, Model Risk, Internal Audit, CBUAE, and external regulators on matters of AI architecture, governance, and trusted agentic operations.
  • Manage strategic technology partnerships with hyperscalers, foundation model providers, agentic framework vendors, and SI partners on terms that protect
  • FAB's intellectual property, capability, and optionality.

  • Represent FAB externally in industry forums, regulator working groups, and peer banks, contributing to the Group's thought leadership on enterprise agentic AI.

    REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS

    Technical Expertise

  • Deep, current architectural knowledge of agentic AI systems, including the layered protocol stack (MCP for tool access, A2A for inter-agent coordination, ACP and emerging agentic standards), orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, Google ADK, LlamaIndex, Autogen, CrewAI, or equivalent), planning and reasoning patterns, multi-agent systems, evaluation, observability, and runtime governance.
  • Strong working knowledge of foundation model architecture and integration patterns, including managed model APIs (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI), open-weight model serving, model gateway design, prompt and context management, RAG, fine-tuning, and the cost-quality-latency trade-offs across model selection.
  • Cloud architecture fluency on Azure and AWS at enterprise scale, covering networking, identity, data, model serving, inference cost management, and hybrid deployment patterns.
  • Proven expertise in integrating AI and data platforms into the core estate of a bank or comparably regulated enterprise, including core banking systems, risk and credit platforms, enterprise data platforms (Azure, Databricks, Cloudera), APIs, ESB, and identity layers.

  • Strong grounding in software and platform engineering, with ongoing hands-on credibility in architecture reviews, prototyping, and critical design decisions.
    Working knowledge of AI governance, model risk management, and regulatory expectations applicable to AI in financial services, including CBUAE, EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and equivalent global frameworks.

    Strategic & Leadership Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to influence at executive level, including business heads, Group CTTO / CIO, board-level forums, and external regulators.
    Strong stakeholder management across business, technology, risk, audit, and external partner ecosystems.

  • Track record of building enterprise capability through standards, communities of practice, and the development of senior engineering and architecture talent.
    Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities across multiple business units, and translate strategic intent into deliverable platform architecture.
    Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage equally credibly with engineers, business heads, and regulators.

    Minimum Experience

  • 12+ years in software, platform, or AI engineering and architecture, with significant time spent at principal, staff, or distinguished engineer / architect level.
  • Demonstrated architectural ownership of at least one large-scale AI, data, or platform programme in production at enterprise scale.
  • Substantive experience in financial services, banking, or another comparably regulated industry.

  • Track record of partnering with executive-level stakeholders across business and technology functions.

    Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.
    Preferred / Beneficial
  • Master's degree (MSc / MTech / MEng) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related discipline preferred.
    Relevant professional certifications such as cloud architecture (Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional), TOGAF, or equivalent considered an advantage.
  • Doctoral qualification (PhD) in a relevant discipline considered an advantage but not required.
