title: CCB Risk Modeling Data-Scientist Sr Associate Fraud Prevention
description:
In this role, you will serve as a hands-on individual contributor. You will help shape the technical direction of the team and build long-term, firmwide capabilities to identify and prevent fraud, leveraging cutting-edge techniques and modern cloud-based tools in an AWS environment.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop, train, and deploy machine learning models for fraud prevention and risk management.
  • Research and implement novel architectures, including Graph Networks, Agentic AI, and Large Language Models.
  • Build and test AI agents, iterating designs to enhance functionality and user experience. Conduct rigorous testing to ensure reliability and effectiveness of AI solutions.
  • Use tools like Databricks and PySpark to create data pipelines and dashboards that support AI-driven insights and decision-making.
  • Monitor and optimize model performance in real-world environments, adapting to evolving fraud patterns.
  • Lead technical strategy and guide analytical direction within the team, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor and support junior team members, sharing best practices and technical expertise.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including product, engineering, and data science—to align modeling solutions with business objectives and firmwide priorities.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable, reusable machine learning solutions and best practices that strengthen the firm’s overall fraud prevention capabilities.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimal 5-year of experience in developing and managing predictive risk models in financial institutions.
  • Deep understanding of machine learning theory and algorithms, with hands-on experience in both classical and deep learning methods.
  • Proficient in Python, SQL or PySpark with experience in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and classical machine learning tools like XGBoost or Scikit-learn.
  • Knowledge of graph analytics including GSQL will be an added bonus.
  • Experience working with large datasets and building data pipelines using Databricks, PySpark, or similar technologies.
  • Experience working in AWS cloud environments.
  • Ability to build and test AI agents, iterate designs, and conduct rigorous testing for reliability and effectiveness.
  • Experience mentoring or coaching junior team members.

Preferred/Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience or strong interest in Graph Analytics and Agentic AI.
  • Knowledge of GSQL.
  • Deep technical understanding of the mathematics behind algorithms, not just library usage.
  • Product-first mindset, with a focus on the role models play in the user experience and overall product responsibility.
  • Versatility in handling both tabular and non-tabular data using classical machine learning (e.g., trees/forests) and modern deep learning techniques.
  • Driven by impact and energized by the responsibility of having your models make decisions on live financial transactions.
  • Demonstrated ability to build scalable, reusable solutions that contribute to firmwide capabilities and long-term strategic goals.

title: Internal Communications Junior Business Partner
description:
At M&G, our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

Through telling it like it is, owning it now and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for any of our roles and offer workplace adjustments to ensure you have the support you need to succeed in your role.

Context for the role:

Internal Communications and Engagement is a key function within our Corporate Affairs, Brand and Sustainability (CABS) team. Our role is an important one - we help M&G achieve its ambitions by making sure all of our colleagues are crystal clear on what we’re aiming to achieve together, how we want to do it, and what their part is in making it happen.

You’ll primarily work within our Life business and spend a significant amount of your time building relationships in this space, creating content and communications plans and initiatives that support the delivery of the Life strategy.

You won’t do that alone. You’ll report directly into the Internal Communications and Engagement Business Partner for Life, and work closely with the rest of our Internal Communications team, wider CABS team, and key stakeholders across Life.

Together, you’ll be part of a team helping shape how we communicate with our teams at M&G.

Key accountabilities for this role:

  • Contributing to the delivery of our Internal Communications strategy – under the direction of our Internal Communications and Engagement Business Partner, you’ll support the delivery of our functional communication plans. This will be through a variety of activity, including: finding, writing and publishing great stories, helping to organise key colleague events and getting creative with communications campaigns. All with the purpose of helping to inform colleagues on how we’re performing as a business and the progress we’re making together against our strategy.
  • Shaping your own communications agenda - you’ll have the opportunity to partner with key areas of the Life business and drive your own communications plans for key strategic deliverables. These plans should help engage the wider Life business with our strategy and how their roles support this.
  • Driving colleague engagement through data – you’ll use the data and insight available to better understand the needs of our colleagues and make sure that we’re listening and reacting to what our colleagues need - evolving a communications plan that ultimately drives engagement at all levels of our business.
  • Building great relationships – you’ll forge tight relationships with a number of key people across M&G – whether that’s members of our leadership team, key stakeholders within the Life business, teammates in our CABS team, or fellow business partners from our other support functions, such as the HRBPs, Finance BPs, etc who support our business.

Some of the skills and experience you’ll need:

  • Experience working as part of an Internal Communications team, or in a role where you’ve worked as part of a team to deliver communications activity
  • A creative thinker who knows how to spot a really great story and how best share it with people - whether this is through written communications, events, videos or ongoing campaigns.
  • The ability to explore and understand complex topics and create engaging content that links back to our corporate narrative.
  • The ability to work well with a range of stakeholders to understand their agenda and needs, and in turn how to support them with the communication and engagement challenges they face.
  • A reputation for getting stuff done – sometimes on your own, sometimes with your team, sometimes with people from across the business… but always to a high standard, on time and with a good attention detail.
  • The ability to make good use of data and analytics to inform decisions and actions so that we can improve our approach and create proof points that demonstrate our impact and create insight that helps us evolve our approach and manage expectations effectively.
  • An interest in developing a broad network, both internally and externally, to make sure our communications and engagement plans are relevant and informed, with an eye on industry trends and capabilities.

What we offer:


We’re dedicated to supporting your wellbeing and helping you thrive, both at work and beyond. Our benefits are designed to help you balance your professional and personal life, and financially plan for the future. Our UK benefits include:


  • A valuable pension scheme of up to 18% (13% made up of employer contributions and 5% employee contributions).
  • Access to our Share Save and Share Incentive Plan, alongside financial wellbeing and support services to help give you real confidence to put your money to work.
  • Enjoy 38 days annual leave (including bank holidays), with the opportunity to purchase up to five extra days. Our Time Off When You Need It policy gives you the flexibility - to balance work and personal commitments.
  • Our market-leading Inspiring Families policy includes comprehensive support and paid parental leave covering maternity, adoption, surrogacy, and paternity leave - because supporting families is an important part of our inclusive culture.
  • Health & Protection cover includes Private Healthcare, Critical Illness cover and Life Assurance for you, with additional family options - for peace of mind.

To explore more about life at M&G and our full benefits offering, visit Life at M&G


At M&G we strive to have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, underpinned by our policies and employee-led networks that offer networking, support and development opportunities for the diverse communities our colleagues represent. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds – across gender, ethnicity, age, disability, sexual orientation and more – including neurodivergent individuals, career returners and those with military service experience.


M&G is proud to be Level 3: Disability Confident Leader under the UK Government Disability Confident employer scheme, and we welcome applications from candidates with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you would like to participate in the initiative, you will have the opportunity to indicate this on your application.


We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process. All candidates have the opportunity to request reasonable adjustments when applying. If you need any additional support at any stage, please contact us at: careers@mandg.com

title: 15233 - Service Operations Distribution Specialist - TX, On Site
description:
We are a proud work-from-office company. If you're ready to work on-site in a dynamic, global company, we'd love to hear from you.
About Us Vensure Employer Solutions is the largest privately held organization in the HR technology and service sector, providing a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including HR/HCM technology, managed services, and global business process outsourcing (BPO). The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. As a "One Employer Solution” headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Vensure helps thousands of businesses streamline and grow their operations with custom strategies that benefit both employers and employees. Find out more by visiting .
Position Summary The Service Operations Distribution Specialist is responsible for delivering exceptional service in a high-volume payroll provider environment by ensuring accurate, timely, and secure distribution of payroll materials. This role plays a key part in supporting client satisfaction by managing the end-to-end printing, packaging, and preparation of payrolls for the organization’s entire client base. The Specialist ensures all distribution tasks meet quality standards, adhere to strict timelines, and align with company procedures and compliance requirements
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Assemble and prepare payroll packages according to client numbers, ensuring all required materials—such as registers, departmental reports, worksheets, liability reports, checks, vouchers, and miscellaneous documents—are accurately included and meet quality and production timeline standards.
Operate a variety of office and production equipment, including mailing systems, shipping PCs, printers, sealers, and related machinery to ensure timely processing of payroll and client packages.
Inspect printed payroll checks, performing quality checks, sorting, and packaging as required for secure pickup or delivery.
Coordinate and complete daily posting of mail and overnight shipping labels, ensuring adherence to distribution schedules.
Accurately complete package confirmations, logs, and checklists to maintain precise tracking, security, and visibility of all package movement and location throughout the workflow.
Follow all security, confidentiality, and audit protocols to protect sensitive client and payroll information in accordance with company policies.
Identify, document, and escalate discrepancies or issues to appropriate personnel to ensure no output is missing, incorrect, or delayed.
Stage and replenish packaging supplies to maintain continuous production readiness and support workflow efficiency.
Load and unload paper stock and related materials to support optimal functioning of printers and production equipment.
Execute daily processing and printing tasks across multiple platforms, ensuring accuracy and timeliness of all printed outputs.
Coordinate and monitor computer processing jobs, verifying successful completion and promptly addressing any interruptions or errors.
Regular, on-site attendance is an essential job function due to the need for secure access to systems, collaboration on sensitive technical matters, participation in operational meetings, and hands-on involvement in activities.
Marginal Functions
Build, maintain and promote relationships with team members, peers across disciplines, and all other company team members ensuring effective coordination of communications and services affecting clients.
Provide light administrative support, such as filing digital documents, maintaining shared drives, and archiving vendor or training records.
Help maintain cleanliness and organization of the production and storage areas.
Attend webinars and training to stay up to date on best practices related to the company and department.
Complete projects and other duties as assigned by supervisor.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and build positive working relationships.
Strong time management skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast paced environment.
Flexibility to perform a variety of assignments within the print room, including operating different equipment, running varied production jobs, and learning new machinery or processes as needed.
Strong ability to collaborate effectively with internal departments to support seamless operations and workflow coordination.
Strong work ethic and commitment to teamwork, contributing positively to a collaborative and supportive work environment.
Sound decision making abilities, including evaluating complex information and determining appropriate actions.
Working knowledge of shipping and logistics vendors, including FedEx, UPS, and other courier services, with the ability to coordinate shipments, evaluate service levels, manage vendor relationships, and identify cost-saving opportunities.
High level of professionalism, reliability, and enthusiasm, contributing to a positive workplace culture.
Exceptional attention to detail, including the ability to thoroughly review printed documents and ensure they meet quality and accuracy standards.
Education & Experience
High School Diploma preferred or equivalent combination of experience, skills, education (including other relevant non-traditional degree programs, or job training programs) required.
One (1) or more years’ of experience with cloud-based printing solutions preferred.
One (1) or more years’ of experience with administrative and clerical procedures.
Experience in Microsoft Office software (Outlook, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint) and demonstrated ability to learn other applications as needed
Physical, Mental, & Communication Demands
Physical Demands:
Sedentary Work: Primarily involves sitting for extended periods, often at a desk or computer.
Manual Dexterity: Frequent use of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment.
Mobility: Occasionally walking or traversing throughout the office to meet with leaders and other employees.
Visual Acuity: Ability to read and analyze data on a computer screen (or to read and analyze data with reasonable accommodation) and in printed materials.
Lifting & Carrying: Minimal physical lifting required, but may involve handling documents, and lifting light office supplies.
Mental Demands:
Sustained Attention: Requires continuous focus to accurately assemble, inspect, and verify payroll packages and printed materials to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with strict timelines.
Attention to Detail: Performs precise quality checks on payroll checks, reports, and documentation to identify errors, discrepancies, or missing materials.
Process Monitoring: Monitors computer processing jobs, printing workflows, and equipment operation to confirm successful completion and quickly identify interruptions or issues.
Problem-Solving: Identifies, documents, and escalates production or distribution issues to prevent delays, incorrect output, or security risks.
Time Sensitivity: Maintains productivity and accuracy while working in a high-volume, deadline-driven payroll production environment.
Task Sequencing & Multitasking: Manages multiple production and distribution steps simultaneously while following established procedures and security protocols.
Communication Demands:
Verbal Communication: Communicates clearly with supervisors and team members to report issues, confirm priorities, and support coordinated workflow during payroll processing.
Written Communication: Accurately completes logs, checklists, confirmations, and documentation required for tracking, audit, and security purposes.
Operational Coordination: Shares timely updates regarding production status, discrepancies, or equipment issues to support uninterrupted payroll distribution.
Professional Interaction: Maintains clear, respectful, and effective communication while working closely with team members in a production-focused environment.
Cultural Sensitivity: Communicate with individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds, demonstrating cultural awareness and sensitivity.
Confidentiality: Regularly handles and communicates sensitive payroll, employee, client, acquisition, and business information, requiring the ability to maintain strict confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and ensure compliance with company policies and applicable privacy requirements.
Environmental Conditions This position is performed in a professional office environment and requires regular use of computers and standard office equipment. The work setting is climate‑controlled with typical office lighting and moderate noise levels. The role involves extended periods of screen time, in‑person collaboration and meetings, and minimal exposure to physical hazards

title: Solutions Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Solutions Specialist to join the Green Data Products Solutions team to help design, implement, and maintain custom solutions for our customers.


You are a customer-focused domain expert in weather and energy forecasting, capable of building strong relationships and acting as a trusted advisor to customers. In this role, you will identify and respond to opportunities to extend the value of our Green Data Products, helping customers address complex challenges as they accelerate the Energy Transition.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the sales team to deliver technical product demonstrations and presentations, identifying and advising potential customers whose requirements may benefit from custom solutions.

  • Work closely with customers to understand their needs and design, cost, and propose solutions that address those requirements.

  • Provide training and guidance to the sales team on technical and industry-related concepts.

  • Represent DNV at conferences and other industry or scientific events, including speaking engagements where appropriate.

  • Provide technical support and guidance to customers and prospects, helping them maximize the value of their solutions.

  • Support the Customer Success and Sales teams by troubleshooting technical issues, helping resolve customer challenges, and providing feedback to the Product Director and product team on potential product improvements.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation for products and solutions, ensuring clarity, usability, and alignment with established best practices.

  • Stay up to date with product developments and industry trends, sharing relevant insights and recommendations with customers.

  • Monitor, test, and validate solutions to ensure they meet performance, reliability, and quality standards.

We value all our people and the contributions they make to our business, so it’s important that our rewards make us all feel valued here. That’s why we offer a flexible reward and benefits package, allowing you to choose the things that matter most to you, including;

  • Non-contractual Profit Share Scheme.
  • Lifestyle benefits: 26 days annual leave + bank holidays, opportunity for up to 10 days unpaid leave, sabbatical leave, flexible working options.
  • Wellbeing benefits: (incl. Private Medical, Dental Insurance, Health Assessments, Gym allowance). Company contribution towards eye tests and glasses (for computer/laptop users), and Flu. Vaccinations. Also, our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) provides free and confidential support for issues including work, family, relationships, money and health and we provide free fruit in our offices.
  • Financial Benefits: including a Pension Scheme with employer pension contributions up to 9%, Life Assurance and Income Protection.
  • Re-imbursement of relevant Professional Membership Fees (up to £570),
  • Access to employee retail discount site for high street and on-line shopping.
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

We are looking for someone who can:

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of weather and energy forecasting products and the ability to translate customer needs into realistic technical requirements and solutions.

  • Build trusted customer relationships and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Identify opportunities for additional products and solutions through customer engagement and analysis of relevant sales and business data.

  • Collaborate effectively with data scientists, software engineers, and other stakeholders to design, develop, and deliver customer solutions, including coordinating project activities when required.

  • Work successfully across teams and functions, sharing knowledge, experience, and best practices.

  • Monitor solutions after implementation and identify opportunities for continuous improvement to enhance reliability, performance, and customer value.

  • Adapt to changing priorities and project requirements while maintaining a high standard of delivery.

  • Take initiative in troubleshooting and resolving technical challenges.

  • Demonstrate a continuous learning mindset and commitment to developing technical, industry, and communication skills.

  • Manage tasks effectively, delivering solutions within agreed timelines and budget expectations.

    Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Meteorology, Physics, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in weather and energy forecasting, including solar forecasting; experience with wind forecasting is an advantage.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in scientific computing, with strong programming skills in Python or a similar language.



Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.

title: Senior Telecommunication Engineer (Offshore)
description:
Title:

Senior Telecommunication Engineer (Offshore)

"Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR !

The KBR team of teams delivers future-forward science, technology and engineering solutions and mission-critical services that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most important objectives, while also helping achieve their sustainability goals.

KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions provides holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design and engineering capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets."

Job Description-Senior Telecommunication Engineer

Title: Senior Telecommunication Engineer

Company: KBR – Inhouse Engineering

Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE — KBR Office

Key Consideration:

Preference will be given to candidates holding valid OPITO-approved T-BOSIET/BOSIET and H₂S certifications with a minimum validity of six months. The selected candidate will be required to travel ADNOC offshore on a rotational basis to conduct site surveys, support brownfield assessments, verify existing installations, and obtain project-specific engineering data necessary for design and execution.

Job Purpose

  • Provide technical leadership for telecommunication systems within FEED and Detail Engineering projects in the Oil & Gas sector.
  • Define telecommunication design basis, standards, and deliverables to ensure safe, reliable, and cost-effective solutions.
  • Oversee integration with electrical, Instrumentation and multi-discipline interfaces; ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Mentor engineers, drive quality and schedule adherence, and ensure robust telecommunication deliverables across the project phases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the engineering, development, and implementation of telecommunication systems, including Optical Fiber Communication Systems, LAN and Structured Cabling Systems, Telephone Systems, TETRA Systems, Microwave Radio Systems, Public Address and General Alarm (PAGA) Systems, Access Control Systems (ACS), Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) Systems, Perimeter Intrusion Detection Systems (PIDS), and Entertainment Systems in accordance with client and project requirements.
  • Participate in offshore and onshore site visits for data gathering, field verification, brownfield assessments, and preparation of detailed site survey reports.
  • Coordinate and participate in OEM system adequacy assessments, review study findings, and approve adequacy survey reports to ensure technical compliance and suitability.
  • Coordinate and participate in third-party vendor workshops and technical studies for CCTV, PAGA, Radio Coverage, and related systems; review and approve study reports and engineering recommendations.
  • Prepare and review FEED and Detailed Engineering deliverables including design basis documents, technical specifications, equipment datasheets, engineering calculations, block diagrams, location layouts, cable routing drawings, interconnection diagrams, scopes of work, RFQs, and material requisitions.
  • Perform technical bid evaluations and review, comment on, and approve vendor documents and engineering submissions.
  • Conduct site surveys, equipment selection assessments, and vendor coordination activities to support successful installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and operation of telecommunication systems.
  • Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams including electrical, instrumentation, and project engineering disciplines to ensure integrated and optimized system design solutions.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary design reviews including plot plan reviews, 3D model reviews, constructability reviews, and model validation activities.
  • Interface with clients, vendors, licensors, and third-party stakeholders to ensure full compliance with project requirements and timely resolution of technical issues.
  • Support preparation, monitoring, and control of discipline budgets, schedules, resource plans, and project execution strategies to achieve key project milestones.
  • Ensure compliance with international standards, industry best practices, client specifications, and regional regulations including IEC, IEEE, ITU, NFPA, and oil and gas telecommunications standards.
  • Provide technical leadership in troubleshooting complex engineering issues, performing risk assessments, evaluating design alternatives, and guiding project teams toward effective solutions.
  • Ensure compliance with QA/QC procedures, engineering standards, drawing requirements, technical specifications, datasheets, and procurement documentation.
  • Remain current with emerging telecommunication technologies, digital transformation initiatives, and industry advancements, and recommend value-added and innovative solutions to enhance project performance.

Experience

  • Minimum 12 years of overall experience, including at least 8 years of dedicated telecommunication design engineering experience within the oil and gas industry, covering both onshore and offshore facilities in the Middle East.
  • ADNOC EPC and/or PMC project experience will be considered a distinct advantage.
  • Demonstrated track record in delivering telecommunication system design, integration, and implementation for FEED and Detailed Engineering projects.
  • Proven experience supporting brownfield and greenfield developments across oil and gas production, processing, and infrastructure facilities.
  • Strong familiarity with ADNOC engineering standards, specifications, project execution procedures, and telecommunication system requirements.
  • Extensive exposure to offshore production facilities, wellhead platforms, central processing facilities, utilities, and associated infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, or an equivalent engineering discipline.
  • Professional memberships and relevant certifications such as PE, Chartered Engineer or equivalent industry-recognized qualifications will be considered advantageous.

Technical Skills

  • Strong technical expertise in the design, specification, and integration of Telecommunication and Security Systems for oil and gas facilities.
  • Extensive knowledge of hazardous area requirements, including equipment selection, certification (IECEx/ATEX), and installation practices for classified areas.
  • Thorough understanding of applicable international standards and codes including IEC, ITU, ISO, IEEE, NFPA, TIA, EN, and operator-specific standards such as ADNOC.
  • Telecom and Operational Technology (OT) Systems: SDH/PDH, DWDM, Microwave Radio, Fiber Optic Networks (OSP/ISP), VSAT, TETRA, DMR, LTE-P, Private 5G Networks, PAGA Systems, CCTV Systems (including VMS and video analytics), ACS, PIDS, IP Telephony, Unified Communications, and Time Synchronization Systems.
  • Strong understanding of FEED and Detailed Engineering deliverables, Management of Change (MOC) processes, change control procedures, and document management systems.
  • Proven capability in performing and reviewing Radio, CCTV, and PAGA coverage studies to meet client operational and safety objectives.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and engineering decision-making capabilities.
  • Strong communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.

What We Offer:

  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
  • Engaging and collaborative work environment with a commitment to safety and sustainability.

title: Senior Director of Network
description:
Position Overview

Omni Fiber is seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior Director of Network Engineering & Operations to lead the design, implementation, optimization, and operational support of our rapidly growing fiber broadband network.

This executive-level leadership position is responsible for establishing the technical vision, engineering standards, operational excellence, and long-term network strategy that support Omni Fiber's continued expansion. The Senior Director will oversee Network Engineering, Network Operations, Architecture, Tier 3 Support, and Network Deployment functions while ensuring industry-leading network reliability, scalability, security, and performance.

The ideal candidate combines deep ISP engineering expertise with proven leadership in broadband network operations, large-scale infrastructure deployments, and cross-functional team management.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Network Leadership

  • Develop and execute Omni Fiber's network engineering and operational strategy.
  • Establish short-term and long-term roadmaps for network growth, scalability, resiliency, and technology evolution.
  • Partner with executive leadership to align technical initiatives with business objectives.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that support future expansion.
  • Lead capacity planning, network expansion planning, and infrastructure investment strategies.

Network Engineering & Architecture

  • Provide executive oversight for network design, engineering standards, implementation methodologies, and operational readiness.
  • Direct architecture, engineering, and standards development for backbone, transport, peering, broadband access, and service delivery networks.
  • Approve engineering templates, deployment standards, and technical operating procedures.
  • Ensure consistent engineering practices across all network platforms and operating regions.
  • Drive innovation through lab validation, proof-of-concept testing, and technology evaluations.

Network Operations & Reliability

  • Oversee Network Operations Center (NOC), Tier 3 Engineering Support, and service assurance functions.
  • Establish operational metrics focused on network uptime, service availability, customer impact reduction, and incident response effectiveness.
  • Lead major outage response efforts and executive communications during critical incidents.
  • Ensure effective escalation management and root cause analysis processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on operational efficiency and customer experience.

Technical Leadership & Team Development

  • Build, mentor, and lead high-performing engineering and operations teams.
  • Develop leadership succession plans and talent development strategies.
  • Establish performance expectations and accountability measures across all network organizations.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, operational discipline, and continuous learning.
  • Serve as the senior technical authority for complex engineering decisions and network initiatives.

Vendor & Technology Management

  • Manage strategic relationships with equipment manufacturers, carriers, transport providers, and technology partners.
  • Lead hardware and software platform evaluations and selections.
  • Negotiate technical requirements and service expectations with vendors and partners.
  • Oversee lifecycle management for network infrastructure and technologies.

Operational Excellence

  • Establish KPIs, SLAs, and executive reporting frameworks for network performance.
  • Drive process improvements related to incident management, change management, deployment standards, and network maintenance practices.
  • Ensure documentation standards are maintained across engineering and operational teams.
  • Support compliance, security, and audit requirements across the network organization.

Financial Management

  • Develop and manage departmental budgets, capital expenditures, and operational expenditures.
  • Support network investment planning and capital forecasting.
  • Evaluate cost-saving initiatives while maintaining service quality and reliability.
  • Provide executive reporting regarding network performance, expenditures, and strategic initiatives.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Equivalent industry experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.

Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience within a broadband ISP, telecommunications carrier, fiber provider, cable operator, or service provider environment.
  • 5+ years of senior leadership experience managing engineering, network operations, architecture, or technical organizations.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale broadband network deployments and operations.
  • Experience managing multiple engineering disciplines and operational teams.
  • Demonstrated success building scalable networks in high-growth environments.

Technical Expertise

Deep knowledge of:

  • BGP
  • MPLS
  • OSPF and/or IS-IS
  • IPv4 and IPv6
  • Carrier-grade NAT (CGNAT)
  • VPN technologies
  • Broadband subscriber services
  • Peering and Internet transit architectures
  • Fiber access network technologies
  • ISP backbone design and operations
  • Network resiliency and redundancy planning
  • Service provider security architectures

Platform Experience

Hands-on or leadership oversight experience with:

  • Cisco
  • Juniper
  • Nokia
  • MikroTik
  • Ciena
  • Adtran
  • Calix
  • Similar carrier-grade network platforms

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's Degree (MBA, Engineering, Telecommunications, or Technical Discipline).
  • CCIE Service Provider, JNCIE, NRS, MEF Professional, or equivalent advanced certifications.
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed engineering and operational teams.
  • Experience supporting high-capacity fiber broadband networks.
  • Knowledge of CDN architectures, peering optimization, and network security initiatives.
  • Experience implementing automation, orchestration, and network management platforms.
  • Familiarity with software-defined networking and modern broadband architectures.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Business Acumen
  • Executive Presence
  • Talent Development
  • Change Management
  • Financial Management
  • Organizational Planning
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Decision Making
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Why Join Omni Fiber?

As the Senior Director of Network Engineering & Operations, you will directly influence the future of Omni Fiber's network infrastructure and customer experience. This is a unique opportunity to lead the technical foundation of one of the fastest-growing fiber broadband organizations while building teams, processes, and technology that fuel long-term success.

What Success Looks Like

✅ Industry-leading network reliability and uptime

✅ Scalable engineering standards that support rapid expansion

✅ Highly engaged and productive engineering and operations teams

✅ Proactive network performance and capacity management

✅ Reduced outage frequency and faster incident resolution

✅ Strategic technology investments that support growth and innovation

Join Omni Fiber and help build the future of fiber broadband connectivity.

title: 530A Outreach Design Contractor (Part-Time) - New America Chicago
description:
The Get My Payment Coalition is led by New America Chicago and Economic Awareness Council. The coalition was started in 2020 when it became clear that the people who needed pandemic stimulus checks most were least likely to receive them. Our team helps ensure that low-income individuals and families have access to free tools and information to claim federal and state tax credits with confidence.

New America Chicago is a nonpartisan policy innovation lab and local hub of New America. Based at The Chicago Community Trust, we tackle challenges facing Illinois communities and partner with New America’s DC teams to shape federal and regional policy recommendations grounded in lived experience.

We are seeking an experienced contractor with a background in project management and user research to support an outreach project for one year, with the opportunity to provide support on other design-related projects as funding becomes available.

In response to the development of a new form of tax-advantaged savings vehicles for children, commonly known as 530As or Trump Accounts, the coalition has been asked to help low-income families in Chicago take advantage of the one-time investment contributions from the federal government. Our team will create messaging and materials for distribution in the community, conduct social media and traditional media outreach, and provide outreach support to help ensure low-income parents are able to access 530A accounts (also known as Trump Accounts) for their children. The team will also collaborate with the New Practice Lab and other external partners to ensure messaging is tested with target audiences to increase action-taking and uptake of 530A accounts in the Chicago region.

Families in low-income communities already face structural barriers to wealth building, including lower pay, assets, and cash reserves, limited access to trustworthy financial guidance, and skepticism toward the new programs. If the policy is not translated into accessible, culturally competent materials and delivered through trusted community intermediaries, it may exacerbate rather than reduce disparities in intergenerational wealth.
This project addresses the urgent need for clear, accurate, community-based education about these new child investment accounts, ensuring that eligible families in high-need communities can make informed decisions and, where appropriate, access and utilize this tool as part of broader financial planning.

PRIMARY FUNCTION: The Get My Payment Illinois Coalition seeks a focused, self-starting contractor to support our 530A and tax credit education efforts. This person will be responsible for implementing core activities for this project and coordinating work with partner organizations, including our main coalition partner, EAC. The contractor will help keep track of changes to the 530A program and IRS tax credit rules and regulations and develop online and social media messaging to ensure more low-income communities are able to access these assets for their families. The contractor will ensure materials and outreach activities are executed well in partnership with the work of our main coalition partner, Economic Awareness Council. The contractor must live in the Chicago area.
  • This contractor will play a vital role in keeping information up-to-date, and materials and media outreach are geared towards the needs of low-income parents in the area.
  • This may include interacting with the public.
  • The work schedule is flexible
  • This does not include benefits.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Keeping track of changes to IRS regulations concerning 530A elections, taxes, and tax credits that may impact low- and moderate-income communities, in collaboration with contractors from EAC.
  • Creating and tracking project timeline.
  • Working with staff from both organizations to coordinate completion of deliverables.
  • Working with the team and financial experts to translate complicated program guidelines into clear, simple marketing materials to test with low-income parents, and other low-income populations.
  • Collaborating with other New America teams and coalition members to ensure message testing is properly implemented into project outreach materials.
  • Coordinating with media consultant to make sure media outreach language is correct and up-to-date.
  • Outreach to government agencies to share marketing materials, engage them in outreach, and get answers to questions.
  • Coordinating development of informational video with studio team and partner organization.
  • Anticipating questions people in different situations may have and creating brief, clear, plain language explanations.
  • Finding and testing free resources for community members, as needed.
  • Setting up simple, creative methods to collect output and outcome data from all partners.
  • Tracking outputs/outcomes and sharing with development team for fundraising reports.
  • Tracking receipts, completing, and filing expense reports.
  • Organizing and filing electronic and paper documents.
OTHER DUTIES:
  • May be asked to perform additional duties and take on other responsibilities as dictated by events and circumstances.
QUALIFICATION:
  • Ideally, a Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s Degree
  • User research or design research training and 3+ years relevant experience
  • Experience quickly getting up to speed on complicated financial or tax related topics and translating in a compelling way for a general audience
  • Organized and efficient work style
  • Skilled at managing timelines for diverse teams with differing schedules
  • Ability to listen deeply and connect with diverse, low-income community members
  • Comfortable working closely with and coordinating work among diverse team members from different organizations
Compensation and Benefits: This position is a contractor role, and hours may vary over the course of the project. The contractor will be expected to work for an average of 15 hours per week for the first month, going down to 7-8 hours per month over the remaining months, with no benefits. There will be the option for additional hours should other already submitted funding proposals be approved. While a retainer arrangement is preferred, the hourly rate will be between $75.00 - $110.00, depending on experience.

Location: Hybrid mode in New America’s Chicago office

Application Process:
Please submit a resume, cover letter, and work sample or portfolio. The deadline to apply is August 27, 2026. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

No phone calls or emails will be answered

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENT:
  • This position is hybrid, working from home and in an office environment, and sits at a desk for extended periods of time and requires dexterity to operate general office equipment;
  • The person in this position will frequently communicate with peers, management, company partners/vendors, government officials, and the general public, and must be able to exchange accurate and timely information verbally and in writing.
  • This position may require walking, bending, kneeling, and standing, and will require sitting for extended periods of time.
WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Originality and Transparency: At New America, we value authentic voices and intellectual property rights. All application materials, including cover letters, writing samples, and any other submissions, must be solely your own original work. The use of AI text generation tools like ChatGPT, language models, or other artificial intelligence writing assistants is strictly prohibited for any part of your job application. Submissions found to contain AI-generated content will be immediately disqualified from consideration. title: PMO Coordinator
description:
Build a career powered by innovations that matter! At Novanta, our innovations power technology products that are transforming healthcare and advanced manufacturing—improving productivity, enhancing people’s lives and redefining what’s possible. We create for our global customers engineered components and sub-systems that deliver extreme precision and performance for a range of mission-critical applications—from minimally invasive surgery to robotics to 3D metal printing.

Novanta is one global team with over 26 offices located in The Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Looking for a great place to work? You have found it with a culture that embraces teamwork, collaboration and empowerment. Come explore Novanta.

Business Unit Overview

Novanta offers highly reliable, precise and safe solutions that enhance system performance and improve patient outcomes. Insufflators, pumps and disposable tube sets, along with medical visualization and operating room integration technologies are the preferred solution for minimally invasive surgery applications.

Summary

This position as PMO Coordinator is part of the Project Management Office (PMO) and reports directly to the Sr. Director PMO. The role owns the operating system of the PMO: the project management processes, templates, tools, master data and KPIs that the Project Managers apply in their daily work. The PMO Coordinator works in close, daily cooperation with the Program and Project Managers of PMO, keeps the portfolio data complete and reliable, produces the consolidated status and KPI reporting for management, administers the project management toolset, and ensures that the agreed governance and gate standards are applied consistently across all projects. The focus of the position is administrative governance, process discipline and data quality rather than technical or engineering content. The position has no disciplinary responsibility for employees.

Primary Responsibilities

Process and Governance

  • Maintain and further develop the PMO process landscape: project management procedures, work instructions, templates, checklists and gate criteria, dashboards.
  • Monitor whether running projects apply the defined governance standards; document deviations and follow up with the responsible Project Managers.
  • Prepare and coordinate gate reviews, portfolio boards and PMO meetings: scheduling, agendas, documentation templates, minutes and action item tracking.
  • Drive continuous improvement of PMO processes and coordinate the lessons learned process across projects.
  • Support Project Managers in the application of agile and hybrid project management methodologies
  • Drive optimization of agile development practices within the established stage-gate framework.

KPIs, Reporting and Analytics

  • Define, collect and maintain the PMO KPI set (e.g. schedule adherence, on-time gate performance, budget variance, resource utilization, change and deviation rates).
  • Safeguard data quality and completeness; identify gaps and inconsistencies and follow up with the Project Managers until resolved.
  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc analyses, management summaries and presentation material for the Sr. Director PMO and senior management.
  • Track and report progress of PMO improvement initiatives and portfolio level action items.

Resource and Capacity

  • Maintain the consolidated resource and capacity plan across the project portfolio together with the Project Managers and line managers.
  • Organize regular reviews to ensure accurate data

Tools and Systems Administration

  • Act as key user and administrator for the project management toolset (MS Project, Azure DevOps).
  • Manage user accounts and permissions, project structures, templates and tool configuration.
  • Maintain the portfolio data model, naming conventions and structures so that reporting stays consistent and comparable.
  • Support the rollout of new tool functionality: requirements collection, testing, user documentation and release communication.
  • Onboard and train Project Managers and project team members on PMO processes and tools; act as first level support for tool and process questions.

General Tasks

  • Strict compliance with the quality, occupational safety and environmental regulations.
  • Discreet and confidential handling of project, financial and personnel related data

Required Experience, Education, Skills, Training and Competencies

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management or a comparable qualification. A technical or engineering degree is not required.
  • Professional experience in a PMO, project office, project controlling, business administration or a comparable governance and coordination role is an advantage.
  • Practical knowledge of project management methods and governance models (stage gate, classic and agile).
  • Project management certification is an advantage (e.g. IPMA Level D, PMI CAPM/PMP, PRINCE2 Foundation, Scrum).
  • Confident handling of project management and collaboration tools (MS Project, Azure, SharePoint) and willingness to take over key user and administrator responsibility.
  • Very good MS Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with dashboard and reporting tools such as Power BI is an advantage.
  • Good knowledge of AI tools and how to apply AI to automate repetitive tasks (e.g. automation of KPIs)
  • Basic technical understanding of product development in a regulated environment is welcome, but engineering expertise is explicitly not required.
  • Strong affinity for data, numbers and KPIs; accurate, structured and process oriented way of working.
  • Service oriented mindset towards the Project Managers, paired with the persistence to follow up on open items across departments and hierarchy levels.
  • Very good communication and moderation skills; able to explain processes clearly and to gain acceptance for standards.
  • Good communication skills in English; English GER-B2*. German language skills are welcome but not a requirement.
  • Strong organizational skills and systematic way of working.
  • Flexible and open to change.
  • Independent and self-motivated.
  • Reliable and able to work under pressure.

title: Security Engineer, Google Threat Intelligence
description:

  • Identify, analyze, and document network signals, malware behaviors, and threat reports related to trends and developments in adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

  • Own the analysis efforts of multiple threat actors, and serve as a subject matter expert on how those actors might impact Google and our users.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Very strong communication and documentation skills.

Backed by Trinity Hunt Partners and recognized as one of Accounting Today’s fastest-growing firms, we’re creating a place where ambitious people can build rewarding, long-term careers.

About the Role

As a Tax Supervisor, you’ll oversee day‑to‑day engagement execution, review complex tax returns, and support tax planning and compliance across a diverse client base. This role requires strong technical tax knowledge, the ability to manage multiple engagements simultaneously, and regular interaction with clients.

The Tax Supervisor provides guidance and coaching to senior and staff‑level team members, ensuring accuracy, quality, and timely delivery of all work products. You’ll also help identify process improvements, maintain consistency in workpapers and deliverables, and stay current on evolving tax laws to support informed decision‑making and compliance.

What You’ll Do

  • Review and prepare certain Federal and state income tax returns.
  • Maintain understanding of United States tax reform legislation and guidance.
  • Navigate and utilize tax research tools and resources.
  • Learn and/or perform tax research, writing, and analysis.
  • Research and navigate Federal and state, Sales & Use, and Property tax matters.
  • Review financial statements for accuracy and compliance.
  • Prepare tax schedules, payments, and other reports, as necessary.
  • Determine and provide solutions for complicated tax issues or erroneous tax filings.
  • Help with the preparation of quarterly and annual tax reports.
  • Ensure that clients comply with federal, state and local tax regulations.
  • Supervise and mentor Interns, as well as Staff and Senior Staff Accountants.
  • Quickly learn various cloud-based software solutions.

About You

  • 3 – 5 years accounting experience.
  • Bachelors degree in Accounting or related field.
  • CPA license (or progress plan towards CPA license) preferred.
  • Knowledge of acceptable accounting practices and procedures.
  • Experience with various tax theories and how to apply.
  • Client management experience.
  • Ability to multi-task while working independently or within a group environment.
  • Excellent problem solving, critical thinking, and analytic skills.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, organized, detail-oriented, and willing to learn from experienced professionals.
  • Proven ability to work in a deadline-driven environment and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (or similar software), Adobe Acrobat, and accounting software (QuickBooks and UltraTax preferred).
  • This position is remote; with a combination of in-office and travel as needed. Travel will be determined by Cg management and/or client needs.

Why Join Us

We’re growing rapidly and evolving, allowing our team members to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We’re committed to supporting your happiness, health, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks, including:

  • Flexible Work Environment: Flexible work location. This flexibility allows you to balance your work and personal life while contributing to an exciting vision and team.
  • Dynamic and Innovative Work: An opportunity to play a critical role within a rapidly growing firm with a supportive and collaborative culture.
  • Growth Opportunities: A dynamic and supportive environment where your contributions will directly impact the firm’s growth and success and share in the rewards.
  • Collaborative Culture: A team-oriented culture that values innovation, entrepreneurial spirit, and growth mindset.
  • Competitive Compensation: A comprehensive salary and benefits package, including performance-based incentives and growth opportunities.

The expected base compensation range for this role is $90,000 - $120,000 annually. Final title and salary will be based on experience, scope, and overall qualifications.

title: Product Designer
description:
About your role 👀

As the second Product Designer at Pogo, you'll help lead the product design and creative direction for our new consumer insights product, which allows brands/retailers to connect with millions of purchase-verified consumers. This platform will ultimately be used by some of the largest companies in the world.

Specifically, you will:

  • Design core product experiences end-to-end, from early exploration through launch and iteration for our up-and-coming B2B platform and consumer app with 3 million users (and growing)

  • Craft polished, delightful interfaces that build trust and showcase the power of our data and AI technology

  • Sweat the details - layout, typography, spacing, color, motion, interactions

  • Help define the product roadmap and lay the foundations for our design language, systems, and culture.

  • Find creative ways to ship high-quality work in a fast-paced, often ambiguous, startup environment

  • Be 1 of 2 designers (for now), working cross-functionally with engineering and GTM

💎 We're looking for the best talent out there, so we're offering above-market salaries & equity.

About you 👩‍🚀

  • Experience designing software products.

  • Bonus if you’ve done this at a startup, or have designed AI interactions before!

  • Bonus if you have experience designing enterprise-grade products.

  • You design quickly and efficiently, using Figma to gain super powers and reach “escape velocity design”. When needed, you make near-term tradeoffs and take shortcuts - even though you have strong design vision and awareness of how to improve the product later.

  • You’re a design nerd at heart. You have a very high bar for design quality and strong opinions about what “great” looks like. You actively seek out the best-designed best products/designers, constantly collecting references from Twitter, Mobbin, and beyond. And you bring that level of rigor and polish into your own work.

  • You actively use LLMs like as ChatGPT or Claude in your design workflow.

  • You’re relentless in pursuing the best solution - willing to explore, iterate, and even scrap a lot of your own work if it means creating a stronger product.

  • You’re a full-stack designer. You've designed experiences from scratch and know how to bring it to life working cross-functionally with product and engineering.

  • You have strong product intuition and have a knack for creating experiences that index on simplicity and clarity. At the same time, you're willing to re-consider your initial intuition as you get more user data.

Why you might be excited about this opportunity 🙌

  • Work on the design for an up-and-coming enterprise product. Our enterprise demand is growing, and we are in the early stages of building a product that will ultimately be used by some of the largest companies in the world. You’ll use qualitative interviews and direct customer feedback to shape product decisions and design solutions tailored to enterprise needs.

  • Design matters a lot to us. You won't be fighting uphill battles to convince people why design matters, and you'll be joining a team that values best-in-class design. Fun fact: one of our co-founder’s first dream jobs was to be a furniture designer (and has designed a lamp!).

  • Be surrounded by amazing product thinkers. We believe product thinking is critical for everyone on our team at our stage. From our engineers and our customer support to our co-founders - our entire team has a unique obsession and knack for product thinking.

  • Quick feedback loops. Unlike designing enterprise software or working in big tech, launch and get user feedback on what's working and what's not in a matter of hours.

  • Shape our design culture from the ground up. As one of our early team members, you'll play a huge role in defining our culture, processes and traditions.

Why you might not be excited about us 👎

  • Priorities may shift quickly. Oftentimes, we're tackling very ambiguous problems that don't have clear-cut answers. While we make calculated bets, we have a strong culture of experimentation and we'll pivot as necessary based on what we're seeing in the data and what we're hearing from our users.

  • You will be one of two designers (for now!). While we have an extraordinary Lead Product Designer (former Figma, Slack & Glean), we don't have the typical design management overhead or user researchers. We're looking for someone that gets energized by learning independently and working in tiny teams.

  • At times, you’ll need to design things in a day. We live and breathe a value called “Calculated Speed”, which involves iterating and shipping weekly, rather than spending months going through complex processes or lengthy builds. Our engineers are some of the best in the world, which means anything you design today may be shipped next week.

  • We expect more than 9 to 5 - raw hours make an impact at our current stage. That said, we trust each team member to create a flexible work schedule that allows them to be most productive while accommodating other priorities outside of work. We also strongly encourage time off to recharge the batteries: in addition to unlimited PTO, we've implemented a minimum 20 days vacation policy 🌴
